author: DougWhitley
body:
## Summary

This PR updates the `/questions` and `/comments` endpoints to allow us to enable requiring start and end date on those endpoints.

## How to Test

### Basic state
1. Ensure the comments endpoint is enabled [local link](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_IsCommentContentFeedEndpointEnabled)
2. Ensure the new setting is turned off [local link](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_TimeBasedPagination_Enabled)
3. Make a request without start and end dates to the [questions endpoint](https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/questions)
4. Validate that you receive a 200 response
5. Repeat steps 3-4 for the [comments endpoint](https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/content-feeds/comments)
6. Make a call to a deep page of the [comments endpoint](https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/content-feeds/comments?page=1000) 
7. Validate that you do not get an error message about exceeding maximum items allowed

### With Site Setting
1. Turn the new setting on [local link](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_TimeBasedPagination_Enabled)
2. Set the [questions time range site setting](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_TimeBasedPagination_MaxDayRangeWindowForQuestions) 
3. Set the [comments time range site setting](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_TimeBasedPagination_MaxDayRangeWindowForComments) to a different value than the questions site setting
4. Make a request to the questions endpoint without a `to` parameter
5. Validate that you receive a bad request error
6. Repeat Steps 4-5 with the `from` parameter
7. Make a request with a date range that is larger than the window created in Step 2
8. Validate that you receive a bad request error
9. Make a request that is within the range from Step 2
10. Validate that you receive a 200 response
11. Make a request to the comments endpoint without a `creationto` parameter
12.  Validate that you receive a bad request error
13.  Repeat Steps 11-12 with the `creationfrom` parameter
14.  Make a request with a date range that is larger than the window created in Step 3
15. Validate that you receive a bad request error
16.  Make a request that is within the range from Step 3
17.  Validate that you receive a 200 response



---------------------------------------------------
title: Update time based pagination to require dates at all times

author: juanrodriguezcen
body: Last month https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23278 introduced support for server side rendering in the StackOverflow application, which requires NodeJS. The installation of NodeJS was added in the final stage (`run`) which is shared by all the applications (StackOverflow, ApiV2, ApiV3, ChannelsDBApi, etc), although only StackOverflow needs it. The downside of this approach is that it increases the sizes of the images for applications that don't need Node.js, and it adds another dependency which increases the attack surface. This PR updates the docker file so that Node.js is only installed in the StackOverflow image. It does so, by creating a different "base app runtime" for StackOverflow. This is the [StackOverflow image](https://cloudsmith.io/~stackoverflow/repos/cr-dev/packages/detail/docker/stackeng%252Fstackoverflow%252Fstackoverflow/4c4417b0fe8b7f9dd90cf3ff91e3be2f00aeb1076d67c3a83a9a8470e25cf052/#layers) from another PR, the size is 596.5MB and it has the node.js layer: This is the [StackOverflow image](https://cloudsmith.io/~stackoverflow/repos/cr-dev/packages/detail/docker/stackeng%252Fstackoverflow%252Fstackoverflow/434d2b7af295d71e4e1efade128ee82e222a2aa72aaf5c42384ceffd74f82fd0/#layers) from this PR, the size is also 596.5MB and also has the node.js layer: There is no change there, which is expected, Node.js should still be installed in the StackOverflow image. However, when looking at APIv2, things are different. This is [APIv2's image](https://cloudsmith.io/~stackoverflow/repos/cr-dev/packages/detail/docker/stackeng%252Fstackoverflow%252Fstackoverflow.api/996f27a236e2dc3f940a035e7423c7a9cc166d8bb2490dd95f8b1d4eba68a174/#layers) from another PR, the size is 288.5 MB and has the node.js layer: This is the [APIv2's image](https://cloudsmith.io/~stackoverflow/repos/cr-dev/packages/detail/docker/stackeng%252Fstackoverflow%252Fstackoverflow.api/ec36f5e5153c54f322859fea3a15068e6a83dde5db26c9096ebaaf1ac6afb8c8/#metadata) from this PR, the size is 227.9MB and doesn't have the node.js layer. ## How to test You can deploy this PR to any of the dev environments by creating a release in Octopus called `pr-23682`, it's currently deployed to SOE AKS instance. Then you can connect to the instance and shell into the different pods and run `node -v`. Only the StackOverflow should return a version, the rest should return `command not found`.

author: SteffiPeTaffy
body:
## Summary  
This PR introduces a **comment spam risk heuristic** that evaluates whether a user is likely engaging in spammy behavior based on their flagged comments in the last 7 days. The score is computed and logged, but not yet used for enforcement.  

## Details  

### New Method  
- **`CalculateCommentSpamRiskScoreAsync(long? userId)`**  
  - Computes a 0–100 score for spam risk based on user’s comments and associated spam flags.  
  - Hopefully performant enough with a **single SQL query** fetching aggregates on every comment submit
  - Currently uses `Flags.FlagTypeId IN (20,45)` (spam/offensive) to identify risky comments.  

### Scoring Logic  
- **Ratio Score (0–60):**  
  - Proportion of flagged comments vs. total comments.  
  - Tiers:  
    - ≥ 75% flagged → +60  
    - ≥ 50% flagged → +40  
    - ≥ 25% flagged → +20  
    - else → 0  

- **Volume Score (0–40):**  
  - +10 points per flagged comment, capped at 40.  

- **Small Sample Dampening:**  
  - If user has fewer than 3 comments in the 7-day window, score is scaled down proportionally.  
  - Prevents users from being misclassified as high-risk based on a single flagged comment.  

### Behavior  
- Returns **0** if:  
  - `userId` is null, or  
  - user has **no comments** in the past 7 days.  
- Final score is **clamped between 0–100**.  
- At this stage, the score is only **logged in AEH events** for evaluation, not yet tied to moderation actions.  

### Performance & Design Note  
- It’s **not ideal** to query the database on every comment submit.  
- However, until we build a **dedicated trustworthiness domain/service**, this is a pragmatic and **performant enough compromise** (single aggregate query, limited to 7 days of data).  
- This allows us to start evaluating the usefulness of the score immediately while planning a more scalable design later.  

## Why This Matters  
- Helps detect **human spammers** who post many comments that quickly get flagged.  
- Complements the **Dormant-Burst Score** (focused on sleeper accounts).  
- Adds another signal we can use in evaluating **trustworthiness and spam risk**.  

## Next Steps  
- Evaluate logged data and calibrate thresholds.  
- Consider integrating with automated restrictions (e.g., temporary comment cooldowns).  
- Extend heuristic to include **comment deletion patterns** if needed.
title: Add Comment Spam Risk Score

author: elcart
body:
## Summary

We have a load of comment links in a mod dashboard somewhere, some/all of which will be deleted (can't remember).

Thus we need these links to actually show the deleted comments in question.

Sorting this required
- providing a `currentUserIsMod` to Svelte from the backend
- passing this through to the check whether the linked comment exists
  - (because if you're not a mod, and you try to follow a deleted comment link, it _doesn't_ exist, technically, for you
- ensuring that if the link is to a deleted comment, and you are a mod, then `showDeleted` is true

## How to Test

1. Jones on, be a mod
2. Find a deleted comment (or delete one), get its id, construct a share link (easiest to do this using an adjacent comment and replacing the first id after the `#`)
3. Stick that link in a new tab - you should be scrolled to the deleted comment, which is visible (i.e. deleted comments are shown)
4. Grab the link for a non-deleted comment in the same container
5. Stick that in a new tab - you should be scrolled to it, but deleted comments are not shown)
6. Be a non-mod
7. Go to the first link again (deleted) - you should get the toast that comment doesn't exist
8. Go to the second link - should work as before
title: [CE-1834] share links for deleted comments should work for mods

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
When we migrated SOE to K8s, we had to pass the Azure storage account to the SO app for loading/saving images. At that opportunity, instead of adding the storage account name as a variable, we set it using the same convention that was used in the TF to create such account, which was `{resourcegroupname}stdstorage`. 

That worked well until the cell architecture came into the picture. Now, we are dealing with 2 resource groups, one containing the K8s cluster, shared by multiple customers, and another one specific for each customer that holds customer specific resources, such as the SQL databases and the **storage account**. 

The problem is that when we deploy, now the resourcegroup variable is the one that holds the K8s cluster, which is the shared one, not the one that contains the customer's storage account. This broke our deployments. 

@SanderKnape added the a new deployment target variable called `storage_account_name` ([src](https://github.com/StackEng/infrastructure-metadata/blob/main/landing-zones/azure/soe/dev/deployment-groups/soe%20canary%20devmaster1/deployment-targets/10-eastus/deployment_target.version.1.yaml#L54)), which we are grabbing into the deployment variables into `deploymentTarget.vars.deployment_target_metadata.storage_account_name`

This PR uses that new variable for both, the `AzureAccountName` setting, and also for the blob storage egress used by the dotnet monitor sidecar.
title: PRODPLAT-25 Update storage account name in SOE deployments

author: SteffiPeTaffy
body:
# PR: Add dormant-burst risk score for users

## Motivation
We’ve seen in the past that *pre-registered sleeper accounts* can suddenly reactivate and start spamming (human bot farms).  
To help detect these patterns early, we’re introducing a **dormant-burst heuristic** that scores accounts based on their age, inactivity, and visit history.  
This score can be used to gate comment creation, throttle risky users, or flag suspicious accounts for moderation.

## What’s new
- **Introduced `UserScoreService`** implementing `IUserScoreService`.
- Added `CalculateDormantBurstScore(ICurrentUser)` method:
  - Returns a **risk score (0–100)** where higher = more suspicious.
  - Based on three simple, explainable signals:
    - **Account age**
      - +30 if account is **old** (≥ 90 days).
    - **Inactivity gap**
      - +30 if **last access ≥ 60 days ago** or user has **never accessed**.
    - **Visit history**
      - +40 if ≤ 1 total day visited.
      - +20 if ≤ 5 days visited.
      - +0 if ≤ 20 days visited.
      - −20 if > 20 days visited (lowers risk for steady users).
- Score is **clamped between 0 and 100**.

## Example outcomes
- **New, active users** → score ~0.
- **Older, sporadic users** → score in the 20–50 range.
- **Dormant sleeper accounts** (old + long inactive + never visited) → score up to 100.

## Why this matters
- Provides a **transparent and tunable** way to assess trustworthiness.
- Helps distinguish between:
  - Legitimate new users experimenting with comments.
  - Low-effort spammers.
  - Potential bot farm accounts waking up after long dormancy.
- This is a **first step** in building a broader trust / spam-resistance framework for comments.

## Next steps
- Integrate this score into comment throttling / mod review pipeline.
- Combine with other heuristics (reputation, penalty history, content checks).
- Calibrate thresholds after observing real traffic.
title: First skeleton for user scores

body:
## Summary

This PR fixes a bug related to creating non-Staging Ground questions in Ask V3.

Previously, if you tried to ask a question with [StagingGround.AllowSGUsersToOptInOrOut](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=StagingGround.AllowSGUsersToOptInOrOut) set to `false` (which is the default), you would be presented the opt out controls, but they wouldn't do anything. You might be forced into Staging Ground even though you chose to post publicly.

Now, we check the Site Setting and pass it into the Svelte island. If the site setting is `true`, we show the controls and they work as expected. If the site setting is `false`, you're not presented the controls at all.

When we launch Ask V3, we should set `https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=StagingGround.AllowSGUsersToOptInOrOut` to `true` in production so that the controls will show.

## How to Test

1. Set [StagingGround.AllowSGUsersToOptInOrOut](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=StagingGround.AllowSGUsersToOptInOrOut) to `false`
2. Ask a question. You should not be presented with the option to opt out of Staging Ground.
3. Set [StagingGround.AllowSGUsersToOptInOrOut](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=StagingGround.AllowSGUsersToOptInOrOut) to `true`
4. Ask a question. You should see the opt-out controls.
    1. If you ask a question with Staging Ground selected, it should go to Staging Ground
    2. If you ask a question without Staging Ground selected, it should go to the public site
title: KRAKEN-2428 Fix staging ground opt-out not respecting site settings

author: juanrodriguezcen
body: PubPlat's and SOE's CNAB invocation images, are pretty stable, after all they implement deployment pipelines which should be fairly stable. With this in mind, I thought this would be a good candidate to start trying out Docker layer caching and avoid rebuilding every layer if nothing really changed. This is using Github's cache, which is pretty restrictive (10GB max). The result is that in Enterprise, the CNAB image build step drops from 3 minutes, to 15-60 secs: In Public and Teams, as Pubplat's CNAB image is build in parallel as part of the same docker bake that the app images are built, the impact on the runtime is not noticeable, however in the logs it can be seen that it was cached: As part of the test, I tried caching the `nuget-cache` step, which does all the restores, and although it works it takes a lot of space in the cache and we are constantly getting over the 10GBs, evicting thing and making the whole cache unstable (lots of unexpected misses). There is an alternative, where you can cache the layers to a registry. I haven't tried it, but it seems that it builds a cache image and uses the registry as the cache storage. Given the cost issues that we have with Cloudsmith, I don't think using them would be a good idea, but wonder if maybe using another registry (Azure or GCP) to store caches could work.
title: Cache CNAB image layers

author: elcart
body:
## Summary

OK so this ended up a fair bit bigger than I expected; but to be fair I was hoping for a single prop change somewhere ha.

Essentially showing deleted comments when hitting the button next to the post wasn't working for Svelte, and the mechanism it was attempting to use was just lifted from the TS i.e. a separate call made to fetch all comments again including deleted.

This PR alters that mechanism to always return all comments (including deleted) on first load, then use a client-side filter to show or hide them. This annoyingly needed to be replicated in the Razor view, including deleted thread replies) as we have some things that happen based on option defaults in the viewmodel construction that I didn't want to mess with. It also meant that bits of other logic (e.g. the count displays) had to now take into account the presence of deleted comments.

Once this was done, it became apparent that we actually had a live bug whereby the click handler on the show deleted comments button wasn't being re-initialised when another action causing a refresh was done (e.g. show more, edit etc), so its reference to the container was being lost. This should now also be sorted.

Once we go full Svelte, we can drop the `showDeleted` argument in the backend altogether and handle everything in the client.

## How to Test

1. New UI etc, no Jones
2. Question page with answers
3. Find a post with deleted comments (or just delete some)
4. Check they are shown when clicking the 'show deleted' button (we don't need to hide them again, we _were_ toggling previously but the current UI doesn't actually do that)
5. Find a post with deleted comments _and_ more than 5 undeleted comments
6. Check that the counts look right
7. Check that hitting 'show deleted' causes all comments (not just top) _and_ deleted to be shown
8. Refresh & check that hitting 'show more' still works
9. Check that hitting show deleted _after_ hitting 'show more' works
10. Do some threading
11. Delete a comment at the end of a thread
12. Check it can't be seen on refresh
13. Check it can be seen on hitting 'show deleted'
14. Delete a comment in the _middle_ of a thread (i.e. has a non-deleted reply)
15. Check it can be seen but shows as `[deleted] [deleted]`, when deleted comments are not shown _and_ shown
16. Breathe
17. Now switch Jones on
18. Check all the above work the same in Svelte, including the counts in SSR followed by rehydration (throttle your network to be able to check this)
title: [CE-1824] deleted comments in Svelte

## Summary
This PR updates the cache key for requests that use API keys to only factor in the request's IP. Currently, the cache key considers both the IP and API application ID. 

This change mirrors the behavior in API v2 and helps prevent spammers from drastically increasing the amount of requests they can perform with a single IP but multiple API applications (which we allow).

https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/a5f009b52dd4a9d436000edcf0e493ae83c0678d/src/StackOverflow.Common.Api/Helpers/ApiThrottle.cs#L83-L88

I have renamed several tests for what's hopefully easier reading. We currently skip these tests but with the recent improvements to API v3 integration tests we may be able to start running these again. 

## How to Test
Enable the identity rate limiter https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_IdentityRateLimit_Enabled
1. Get API keys for two different applications
   - Make sure neither of these applications are marked as OverflowAPI in https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_OverflowAPI_AppIds_DbValue, otherwise the requests will fall into a different rate limiting scheme
2. Perform a request with one key and record the value of the `x-rate-limit-calls-left` header
3. Perform a request with the other key, the value of `x-rate-limit-calls-left` should be one less. 
4. Run the new integration test `PerIP_ShouldReturnSameRateLimitAcrossDifferentApps` - You'll need to remove the `[Skip]` attribute

author: juanrodriguezcen
body: In https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23278 enable Svelte SRR. As part of it, this was added to the **final** stage of the Dockerfile for all apps: ```dockerfile # Here we are going to bring through the entire project folder, # before doing some specific copying of SSR stuff, in the case of # the StackOverflow project only COPY --from=build /app/${PROJECT} /app/temp-project RUN if (echo "$PROJECT" | grep -q 'StackOverflow'); then \ mkdir -p /app/ssr && \ find /app/temp-project/_Scripts/islands -type f -name 'entry-server.js' -path '*/dist-ssr/*' | while read filepath; do \ islandFolder=$(basename $(dirname $(dirname "$filepath"))); \ mkdir -p "/app/ssr/$islandFolder"; \ cp "$filepath" "/app/ssr/$islandFolder/"; \ done; \ fi RUN rm -rf /app/temp-project ``` This copies the entire project folder to `/app/temp-project` and then copies only stuff from the `/_Scripts/islands` folder to the final image. Finally it removes the `/app/temp-project` folder from the final image. This runs for every project image (StackOverflow, ApiV2, ApiV3, ChannelsDBApi, etc), although it only really does stuff in StackOverflow. What is the problem if the image temp folder is removed? That each docker command is an immutable layer that ends up in the final image. So, when we do `COPY --from=build /app/${PROJECT} /app/temp-project`, all that content ends up in the final image, although it's removed later. This hugely increase all the monolith's images size. This PR uses a different stage (`ssr-copier`) to filter out the files that need to be copied, and then the final stage only copies the filtered files <10MB from that intermediate stage. These are part of the [layers ](https://cloudsmith.io/~stackoverflow/repos/cr-dev/packages/detail/docker/stackeng%252Fstackoverflow%252Fstackoverflow.enterprise/70da05007bf69b3f57f9cd958447ceb9efd887cd91cfd15f005340cb90352726/a=amd64;xpo=linux/#layers)of a recent `stackoverflow.enterprise` image that was created by another PR. This image has a size of **757.7MB** . I highlighted the layer that copied the whole project: This is the same `stackoverflow.enterprise` image built out by this PR, using the intermediate stage. This image has a size of **339.8 MB**. Here you can see that the layer that copied the whole project is no longer there:
title: PRODPLAT-21 Decreasing docker image sizes

author: juanrodriguezcen
body: The SOE's shared infrastructure project moves multiple customers into the same cluster. We are planning to use prefixed namespaces to isolate customers applications within the cluster. The prefix is going to be the customer's ticker, so for example for Microsoft, all the K8s deployments would be under namespaces prefixed with `msft-`, like `msft-stackoverflow` or `msft-apiv2`. In https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23444 I updated for the monolith: - The app deployments to use the ticker prefixed namespace - All the urls that used the `{application}.{namespace}` referencing monolith's apps to be `{application}.{ticker}-{namespace}`. @SanderKnape is looking at updating the external services (ide extension, SO Search, etc) to be deployed with prefixed namespaced. This PR updates all the urls that use the `{service-name}.{service-namespace}` to use `{service-name}.{ticker}-{service-namespace}`. There were 2 places that had to be updated: - The `Search.SearchService.Endpoint`. As this url now has a dynamic component to it (ticker) that gets resolved in at deployment time, it can no longer be hardcoded in `environmentsettings.Prod.Enterprise.json`. So this it was updated as an override to that file at deployment time, something that happens in `Get-EnvironmentSettingsFileContent` during the CNAB deployment. - The `fragment-proxies.Prod.Enterprise.json` file can no longer be a static one, because all the `baseUrl`s now have a dynamic component as well. So I used a similar approach to the one that we used for `environmentsettings.Prod.Enterprise.json`, which is to generate the file at deployment time, add it as part of a K8s ConfigMap, and mount the file to the pod so the app can read the file. Here you can see the new entry in the ConfigMap: Here I shelled into the stack overflow pod and confirmed that the file was properly mounted and that the prefix was correctly added:
title: PRODPLAT-12 Support SOE external services in new cell based architecture

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
**Note: Please read https://swagger.io/docs/specification/v3_0/authentication/ to learn more about defining security in an OpenAPI API.**

This PR fixes structural OpenAPI errors in both the Teams and SE API. All existing errors are related to the way we define security. The main issues were:
- A `null` scope on each operation that uses the `oauth2` security scheme. `null` is an invalid value and it has been omitted. 
- On PubPlat, one of our security schemes was invalid due to spaces in the name. That security scheme has been renamed to `ApiKeyAuth`.

While the items below are not errors, I have also addressed them in this PR to more accurately describe endpoints:
- `RequiredWriteAccess` now maps to `write_access` which is the actual name of the scope.
- On PubPlat, the `/stacky` endpoint does not require authentication. The API definition now specifies this which removes up the lock icon on the UI.

These items are not covered in this PR:
- I'm not familiar with Teams auth requirements but the security definition can be extended to always require the `access_team` scope.

## How to Test
### Teams
1. Visit https://api.stackoverflowteams.local/v3 
2. Spot check the UI. All authenticated routes should have sample responses for auth related errors such as 400, 401 and 403. 
3. Make a few calls to the API using the `oauth2` scheme
4. Visit https://api.stackoverflowteams.local/v3/swagger.json
5. Spot check the output. The `oauth2` is defined near the bottom and applied at the root level. Non-GET operations will have an overriding security definition on the operation. This override shows that the operation requires OAuth with a `write_access` scope.
6. Paste the output into https://editor.swagger.io/ and verify there are no OAPI violations

### PubPlat
1. Visit https://api.stackexchange.local/v3 
2. Spot check the UI. All authenticated routes should have sample responses for auth related errors such as 400, 401 and 403. 
3. Make a few calls to the API using the `ApiKeyAuth` scheme
4. Make a few calls to the API using the `oauth2` scheme
5. Verify `/stacky` no longer has a lock icon since it is a public endpoint with no security
7. Visit https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/swagger.json
8. Spot check the output. The security definitions are at the bottom. Both schemes, `oauth2` and `ApiKeyAuth` are applied at the root level. Non-GET operations will have an overriding security definition on the operation. This override shows that the operation requires OAuth with a `write_access` scope. `/stacky` should be overridden to specify that it does not require auth.
9. Paste the output into https://editor.swagger.io/ and verify there are no OAPI violations
10. Repeat for the Mods and OAPI view
title: YETI2-95 - Fix OpenAPI spec violations in API v3

author: dionrhys
body:
Slack context: https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/CNAE3JWEP/p1754605298090239

This PR decouples `RedirectVoteActionHandler` from the DI system and removes the service locator pattern around it so that code testing post votes (e.g. in #23587) doesn't need to set up a whole DI service provider and register a mock instance of this class on `BaseTest`.

This PR keeps `RedirectVoteActionHandler` unit-testable for verifying its functionality works with various handlers, while also letting production code just use an instance of that class that uses the default handlers that you need in production. 

If tests need to exercise some post voting functionality but want to inject their own specific `RedirectVoteActionHandler` to use, then that dependency can be added as parameters more locally to the code instead (in a followup PR). In practical terms that means if say you're testing `Posts2Vote.EnsureVotingRightsAsync` and want a custom `RedirectVoteActionHandler`, you can add a parameter to `Posts2Vote.EnsureVotingRightsAsync` to take that in, and by default callers can use `RedirectVoteActionHandler.Default`.

Making these changes I hope will make it so that "how do I handle a failed post vote" is less of a global app concern (registered globally at startup) and more of a specific concern to the post voting code itself.
title: Decouple RedirectVoteActionHandler from DI

author: gabrieltron
body:
## Summary

On #23494 we enabled caching the database used on Playwright tests. This significantly improved execution time (chopped off 1.5 minutes), and it's my belief that once we had enough data it would help reducing flakiness as well, as creating the databases is a big source of flakiness.

We had to revert this change because it ended up breaking several other runs (e.g. [here](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/actions/runs/16678722458/job/47221043958)) with the error `Microsoft.Playwright.PlaywrightException : net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED `.

This PR reenables taking the database backups, **but not using them on new runs**. This is so we can avoid breaking the pipeline, and I can create a separate PR with the backups enabled to try to replicate the error scenario and debug it.

Thus, this PR has 2 chagnes:
1. Revert the previous revert of using the DB backups
2. Disable using the backups - just take them

## How to Test

Functional Acceptance tests ran successfully in this branch both when the backup was not present ([first run](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/actions/runs/16911141239/attempts/1?pr=23609)) and when it is ([second run](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/actions/runs/16911141239/job/47914945402?pr=23609))
title: Reenable E2E db backups

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
This PR adds a toggle to use the new database tables in the API v3 BlockSensitiveSiteAttribute.cs attribute. This attribute is used to block access to sites that data licensing customers should not have access to.

Some highlights in this PR:

- About half of the code in this PR are tests
- While an API application will typically have one data licensing tier, we are building support for multiple tiers. The get allowed sites repository method joins on all tiers associated with a data licensing application.
- I have added a repo/service `DataLicensingTierSites*.cs` for adding/removing sites from a tier and extracted it from the developer route to configure allowed sites. This allows us to reuse the same queries in integration tests. 
- The implementation can be toggled with a site setting. The existing site setting implementation code should be the same. This uses the same site setting to toggle the `AppTypeRequired.cs` attribute. I have renamed the setting on the API v3 side in this PR. 
- The code can extended for the upcoming client packages work by modifying the query. Configuring the client packages will be a separate set of work. 

### Notes on opting out of caching
Allowed sites won't change often which makes them a good candidate for caching. However, to minimize Redis space we would have to cache by tier and then do a read for each tier assigned to an application. Since the query is fast enough, I have opted to skip on caching until this is identified as a performance concern.

An alternative is to cache the list per customer which results in a single read. However, this increases the amount of keys and values. These values will often be identical from app to app which sounds wasteful. The issue is that it becomes difficult to invalidate the cache on a per app ID basis since changes to sites happen per tier. We would have to scan Redis for all keys that match a pattern and then invalidate the keys.

In summary:
- No cache - Always calls the DB
- Cache per app ID - Single read for each API application but values are the mostly the same from application to application. Difficult to invalidate the keys when the allowed sites list changes.
- Cache per tier - Requires multiple reads (one for tier on an API application) and increases code complexity. It will require even more reads when we add the client packages. Easier to invalidate the cache.

## Tests
I have added unit tests and a couple of integration tests for the new implementation. I also added a fixture so that we can call methods from the DL module to setup data licensing API applications. The fixture allows us to register the module once for all tests in a classes instead of doing it for each test.

https://xunit.net/docs/shared-context#class-fixture

## How to Test
### **Site Settings Implementation**
While the body of this function shouldn't have changed we can still test it. I am linking testing steps from when Lisa added the sensitive site list for AWS. https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/21966

---------------------------------------------------
### **Database Implementation**
Turn on the site setting to use the database table implementation https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_UseNewApiApplicationTypeColumn.

**Regular Application** 
1. Clear all entries from `DataLicensingTierSites` in SQL
2. Use developer route to mark your app as regular https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/api/update-app-type?appIds={appId}&appType=1&dryRun=false (use the dev route as this will clear the cache)
3. Run the test script and validate both requests result in 200

**Data Licensing Application - With a single tier**
1. Run the query below to setup your app as a data licensing application with a tier and an allow list of `literature.stackexchange.local`. Validate the query output.
2. Call /questions - It should pass with `literature.stackexchange.local` but fail on `meta.stackexchange.local`
```
DECLARE @AppId INT = 20546; -- Your app ID
DECLARE @DataTierId INT = 2; -- Premium
DECLARE @SecondDateTierId INT = 3; -- AWS
DECLARE @LiteratureSiteId INT = 668; -- Literature SE
DECLARE @MetaSiteId INT = 4; -- Meta SE

/*--------------------------------
* Setup application
--------------------------------*/
UPDATE ApiApplications SET ApplicationTypeId = 4 WHERE Id = @AppId
DELETE FROM ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier WHERE ApiApplicationId = @AppId
INSERT INTO ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier(ApiApplicationId, DataLicensingTierId) VALUES (@AppId, @DataTierId)

/*--------------------------------
* Setup sites
--------------------------------*/
DELETE FROM DataLicensingTierSites WHERE DataLicensingTierId = @DataTierId AND SiteId IN (@LiteratureSiteId, @MetaSiteId)
INSERT INTO DataLicensingTierSites (DataLicensingTierId, SiteId) VALUES (@DataTierId, @LiteratureSiteId)

/*--------------------------------
* Validate output
--------------------------------*/
SELECT AA.Id, AA.Name, AAT.Description AS [ApplicationType], DLT.Description AS [Tier] FROM ApiApplications AA
JOIN ApiApplicationTypes AAT ON AA.ApplicationTypeId = AAT.Id
LEFT JOIN ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier AADT ON AA.Id = AADT.ApiApplicationId
LEFT JOIN DataLicensingTiers DLT ON AADT.DataLicensingTierId = DLT.Id
WHERE AA.Id = @AppId

SELECT DT.Name, S.Name, S.BaseHostAddress, S.Id FROM DataLicensingTierSites DTS 
JOIN Sites S ON DTS.SiteId = S.Id
JOIN DataLicensingTiers DT ON DT.Id = DTS.DataLicensingTierId 
WHERE SiteId IN (@LiteratureSiteId, @MetaSiteId)
```

**Data Licensing Application - With two different tiers**
1. Run the query below to setup your app as a data licensing application with two different tiers that each have their own allowed list. Validate the query output.
2. Call /questions - It should pass with on both sites `literature.stackexchange.local` and `meta.stackexchange.local`. This is because the application is registered for different tiers that each have their own allow site.
```
DECLARE @AppId INT = 20546; -- Your app ID
DECLARE @DataTierId INT = 2; -- Premium
DECLARE @SecondDateTierId INT = 3; -- AWS
DECLARE @LiteratureSiteId INT = 668; -- Literature SE
DECLARE @MetaSiteId INT = 4; -- Meta SE

/*--------------------------------
* Setup application
--------------------------------*/
-- Set as data licensing
UPDATE ApiApplications SET ApplicationTypeId = 4 WHERE Id = @AppId 

-- Delete any existing tiers
DELETE FROM ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier WHERE ApiApplicationId = @AppId 

-- Add new tiers
INSERT INTO ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier(ApiApplicationId, DataLicensingTierId) VALUES (@AppId, @DataTierId), (@AppId, @SecondDateTierId)

/*--------------------------------
* Setup sites
--------------------------------*/
-- Delete existing site entries
DELETE FROM DataLicensingTierSites WHERE DataLicensingTierId IN (@DataTierId, @SecondDateTierId) AND SiteId IN (@LiteratureSiteId, @MetaSiteId)

-- Allow meta.stackexchange.local on second data tier, allow literature.stackexchange.local on first data tier
INSERT INTO DataLicensingTierSites (DataLicensingTierId, SiteId) VALUES (@DataTierId, @LiteratureSiteId), (@SecondDateTierId, @MetaSiteId)

/*--------------------------------
* Validate output
--------------------------------*/
SELECT AA.Id, AA.Name, AAT.Description AS [ApplicationType], DLT.Description AS [Tier] FROM ApiApplications AA
JOIN ApiApplicationTypes AAT ON AA.ApplicationTypeId = AAT.Id
LEFT JOIN ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier AADT ON AA.Id = AADT.ApiApplicationId
LEFT JOIN DataLicensingTiers DLT ON AADT.DataLicensingTierId = DLT.Id
WHERE AA.Id = @AppId

SELECT DT.Name, S.Name, S.BaseHostAddress, S.Id FROM DataLicensingTierSites DTS 
JOIN Sites S ON DTS.SiteId = S.Id
JOIN DataLicensingTiers DT ON DT.Id = DTS.DataLicensingTierId 
WHERE SiteId IN (@LiteratureSiteId, @MetaSiteId)
```

### Developer Configure Allowed Sites interface
1. Visit https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/data-licensing/allowed-sites and validate that you can successfully add and remove sites
title: YETI2-706 - Update BlockSensitiveSite attribute to use new database tables

[KRAKEN-2422](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/KRAKEN-2422)
## Summary
This PR adds a new event to the askV3 page, `question_ask.captcha_load`. This event fires when a user goes to submit but gets back a recaptcha response. Additionally I have disabled the preview control buttons on submission to prevent any extra clicks, the buttons should always re-enable after submission unless the submission was successful and the user begins a redirect.

## How to Test

1. Enable [Captcha.Enabled](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Captcha.Enabled) site setting
2. Impersonate a low rep user and fill out a new question form
3. Open your browsers developer tools and swap to the elements tab
4. Refresh the page to reload your draft
5. In the elements tab search for i1l, this field should have no value, if it does try reloading your draft again and ensure you dont edit any fields. Without the i1l field we will be prompted to do a recaptcha.
6. Open the networks tab
7. Before submission take note that during submission all of the preview control buttons will disable, this is easier to see if you throttle your network - Try to post your question
8. You should get a recaptcha pop up
9. In the Networks tab you should see a stackevent fired for `question_ask.captcha_load`, Additionally you can look in Kafkaesque to make sure the events flow through.

author: sandermvanvliet-stack
body:
**Note:** No test because the behaviour is only surfaced when running for reals unfortunately and it's impossible to simulate the error in a unit test 🤷 

This PR solves the problem where calls through the Fragment Proxy that yield a response that should not have content throw an `InvalidOperationException` when attempting to copy empty content.

The full exception is like this:

```
System.InvalidOperationException: Writing to the response body is invalid for responses with status code 204.
   at Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Core.Internal.Http.HttpProtocol.FirstWriteAsyncInternal(ReadOnlyMemory`1 data, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   at Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Core.Internal.Http.HttpProtocol.WritePipeAsync(ReadOnlyMemory`1 data, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   at Microsoft.AspNetCore.ResponseCompression.ResponseCompressionBody.WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory`1 buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   at System.Net.Http.HttpContent.<CopyToAsync>g__WaitAsync|56_0(ValueTask copyTask)
   at StackOverflow.FragmentProxy.HtmlFragmentProxy.WriteToContextResponseAsync(HttpContext context, HttpResponseMessage response, CancellationToken cancellationToken) in /app/src/StackOverflow.Common.AspNet/FragmentProxy/HtmlFragmentProxy.cs:line 275
   at StackOverflow.FragmentProxy.HtmlFragmentProxy.ProxyRequestAsync(HttpContext httpContext, String xsrfFormValue, String requestIpAddress, Nullable`1 userId, String sitePrefix, String jwt, CancellationToken cancellationToken) in /app/src/StackOverflow.Common.AspNet/FragmentProxy/HtmlFragmentProxy.cs:line 140
```

To handle this scenario this PR will not attempt to copy a response in these situations:

- HTTP status code is 1xx
- HTTP status code is 204, 205 or 304
- response `Content-Length` is zero
title: [FRAGMENT PROXY] No content responses

author: stephen-vakil
body:
## Summary

Right now when you include an image when using AskV3 it is running a code detection plugin.  But [that plugin](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/69ca809ce088c39c994954afecd6ab6ec7178016/StackOverflow/_Scripts/islands/ask-question/src/components/Body.svelte#L4) is just some [sample code where the actual logic to detect code isn't implemented](https://github.com/StackExchange/Stacks-Editor/blob/eac67ed6333612367953f2e97447f62daedfffa9/plugins/sample/code-detection.ts#L42).

Even once that code detection is removed, the editor is trying to upload to the wrong URL so image uploads will still fail.  We need to override that behavior in the stacks editor to correctly upload images.

We have this enabled for some users on SuperUser and AskUbuntu and have [received reports of this bug from users](https://meta.superuser.com/questions/16547/weird-issue-when-trying-to-upload-image-to-super-user-question).

## How to Test

1. Enable AskV3
2. Start a question
3. Paste an image into the question and try to complete the image upload process
4. If it is no longer using the errant code detection, it **won't** say it found code and try to replace your image with some code even if you click Cancel
5. If the image upload process works, you should see the image URL successfully inserted into your question.

Alternately, test on [literature.ascn-dev](https://literature.ascn-dev.stackexchange.dev/) literature where the AskV3 is currently enabled for all.

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
In FBB, SOE and PubPlat, we have always used Cluster wide external secret stores because we always deployed only one tenant per K8s cluster.

However, with the new cell based architecture, we’ll have multiple tenants sharing the same K8s cluster, so we want to namespace the secret stores. For this to happen, we need to parametrize the `spec.secretStoreRef.kind` value, which currently is hardcoded to `ClusterSecretStore`, so that in the cell tenants we use `SecretStore`. 

We should default this param to `ClusterSecretStore` for backwards compatibility.

I tried deploying this PR to SOE AKS to confirm that with the default of `ClusterSecretStore` deployments keep working.
title: SCALE-584 Parametrize storeRefKind in external secrets from charts used by SOE

# Summary

This PR adds a dev route to capture Freemium teams that are inactive. The main purpose is because we have logic to cleanup unused freemium teams but it has [a hard requirement of the team needing to have exactly 1 user](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/fd67fc38d4ecd27f92bd360a630069ce474e43c6/StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/Channels/Channels.cs#L1337-L1341). This means inactive teams with 2 or more users, or even 0 users!, will never get cleaned up. 

This is problematic because we are technically paying for the subscriptions of these teams in Chargify. This dev route will help us make a decision on whether we should tweak the inactive team cleanup logic to include more inactive teams.

# How to Test

I tested this new route in https://stackoverflowteams.dev by [deploying this PR to it](https://stackeng.octopus.app/app#/Spaces-344/projects/stack-overflow-for-teams/deployments/releases/pr-23553/deployments/Deployments-250445). 

Here is the file it generated: [inactive-teams.csv](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21579020/inactive-teams.csv)

If needed, you may re-deploy that release to Dev eastus again to test it yourself via https://stackoverflowteams.dev/developer/channels/get-inactive-freemium-teams

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
For security purposes, we run our containers with a readonly filesystem. In fact, we do have in SOE and FBB clusters kyverno policies that check this when a pod is deployed. 

As part of SOE’s CNAB deployments, we use the Cluster Actions Helm chart, that contains a job that allows us to run scripts inside the cluster (pre-deploy, post-deploy, runbooks). This job is currently running with a writable filesystem. 

Although Kyverno checks for the readonly fs policy in SOE cluster’s, it doesn’t enforces it yet. However, in the new cell clusters, the policy is enforced making the deployment to fail. 

This PR mounts a tmp writable volume, including the writable paths that are required by dotnet and powershell.
title: SCALE-582 Read-only file system for SOE's CNAB cluster actions job

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
This PR adds a toggle to use the new database tables in the API v3 `AppTypeRequired.cs` attribute. This attribute is used to decorate routes that should only be available for certain API application types or Data Licensing client tiers. 

Some highlights in this PR:
- About half of the code in this PR are tests
- Data licensing tiers won't change often so they are great caching candidates. I have introduced a global cache to `Module.Base`. It is essentially a copy of `ModuleSiteCache` but pointing to the global cache.
- The cache will be cleared if the update update data licensing tier developer routes are called. The cache time is only 1 hour.
- While an API application will typically have one data licensing tier, we are building support for multiple tiers. You'll see that the `DataLicensingTierService.cs` returns a hash set for each API application.
- The implementation can be toggled with a site setting. The old/existing site setting implementation code should be the same.
- We have established AWS as a Data Licensing tier in the database but they are really a "Basic" customer. Instead of adding another app type, we have hardcoded a check for them. Regardless of the approach, they both require some level of hard coding.

## Testing
I have added several unit tests and a couple of integration tests for the new implementation. 

## How to Test
The testing here is wild. There are several different configurations and we want to make sure we don't accidentally cut off access to anything. DL customers should see a message about "upgrading" if they attempt to access a route that's enabled for Data Licensing but they don't have access to (due to tier), everyone else shouldn't see such a message.

### **Setup**
1. First run database migrations for the new/modified tables
2. Get a key ready for testing 

### **Site Settings Implementation**
Site Settings 
- [Api.APIv3_Mod_AppIds_DbValue](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_Mod_AppIds_DbValue)
- [Api.APIv3_OverflowAPI_AppIds_DbValue](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_OverflowAPI_AppIds_DbValue)
- [Api.APIv3_OverflowAPI_Premium_AppIds_DbValue](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_OverflowAPI_Premium_AppIds_DbValue)

**Regular Application** 
1. Clear your app ID from all site settings
2. Run the test script and validate the output  - Only /questions return 200

**Moderator**
1. Clear your app ID from all site settings
2. Add your app ID to the site setting `Api.APIv3_Mod_AppIds_DbValue`
3. Run the test script and validate the output  - Only /questions and /discussions return 200

**Data Licensing - Basic**
1. Clear your app ID from all site settings
2. Add your app ID to the site setting `Api.APIv3_OverflowAPI_AppIds_DbValue`
3. Run the test script and validate the output  - Only /questions should return 200

**Data Licensing - Premium**
1. Clear your app ID from all site settings
2. Add your app ID to the site setting `Api.APIv3_OverflowAPI_AppIds_DbValue` and `Api.APIv3_OverflowAPI_Premium_AppIds_DbValue`
3. Run the test script and validate the output  - All should return 200

### **Database Table Implementation**
Turn on the site setting to use the database table implementation https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_UseNewApiApplicationTypeColumn.

**Regular Application** 
1. Use developer route to mark your app as regular https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/api/update-app-type?appIds={appId}&appType=1&dryRun=false
2. Run the test script and validate the output  - Only /questions return 200

**Moderator**

2. Verify your configuration with the query below
3. Run the test script and validate the output  - Only /questions and /discussions return 200

**Data Licensing - Basic**
1. Use developer route to mark your app as data licensing https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/api/update-app-type?appIds={appId}&appType=4&dryRun=false
2. Clear any existing tiers from the DB `DELETE FROM ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier WHERE ApiApplicationId = @appId`
3. Use developer route to mark your app as basic https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/data-licensing/add-tier-to-app?appIds={appId}&tierId=1&dryRun=false
4. Verify your configuration with the query below

**Data Licensing - Premium**

**Data Licensing - AWS & Premium**
**Note: This is a hypothetical scenario where AWS becomes a Premium customer and should also have access to Premium routes but with their custom allowed sites list. In reality, AWS is a Basic customer.**
1. Use developer route to mark your app as data licensing https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/api/update-app-type?appIds={appId}&appType=4&dryRun=false
2. Clear any existing tiers from the DB `DELETE FROM ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier WHERE ApiApplicationId = @appId`
3. Use developer route to mark your app as Premium https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/data-licensing/add-tier-to-app?appIds={appId}&tierId=2&dryRun=false
4. Use developer route to mark your app as AWS https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/data-licensing/add-tier-to-app?appIds={appId}&tierId=3&dryRun=false
5. Verify your configuration with the query below
6. Run the test script and validate the output - All should return 200

**Data Licensing Tier Caching**
1. Add breakpoints to `GetDataLicensingTiersFromApiApplicationAsync` and `ClearApiApplicationDataLicensingTierCacheEntry` in `DataLicensingTierService.cs`
2. Run the test script and validate that the value is cached and then fetched from cache on subsequent calls
3. Update the data licensing tier on an app and validate that the cache entry is removed

**SQL Query to validate your configuration**
```
SELECT AA.Id, AA.Name, AAT.Description AS [ApplicationType], DLT.Description AS [Tier] FROM ApiApplications AA
JOIN ApiApplicationTypes AAT ON AA.ApplicationTypeId = AAT.Id
LEFT JOIN ApiApplicationDataLicensingTier AADT ON AA.Id = AADT.ApiApplicationId
LEFT JOIN DataLicensingTiers DLT ON AADT.DataLicensingTierId = DLT.Id
WHERE AA.Id = Id
```

**Test Powershell Script**
1. Copy the script below to a `.ps` file locally
2. Open the command prompt and run the command `powershell .\yeti2-706-test-script.ps1 -AuthorizationToken "YOUR_API_KEY"`

```
param (
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$AuthorizationToken
)

$Routes = @(
    "https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/questions",
    "https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/discussions",
    "https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/content-feeds/changes/questions?to=7/31/2025&from=7/25/2025"
)

$Notes = @(
    "A route available to everybody",
    "A route available to only premium DL customers and moderators",
    "A route available to only premium DL customers"
)

if ($Routes.Count -ne $Notes.Count) {
    Write-Error "The number of routes must match the number of notes."
    return
}

for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Routes.Count; $i++) {
    $url = $Routes[$i]
    $note = $Notes[$i]

    try {
        $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer " + $AuthorizationToken } -Method Get -ErrorAction Stop

        Write-Output "URL: $url"
        Write-Output "Note: $note"
        Write-Output "Status Code: $($response.StatusCode)"

    } catch [System.Net.WebException] {
        $errorResponse = $_.Exception.Response
        $statusCode = $errorResponse.StatusCode.Value__

        Write-Output "URL: $url"
        Write-Output "Note: $note"
        Write-Output "Status Code: $statusCode"

        if ($statusCode -eq 403) {
            $responseStream = $errorResponse.GetResponseStream()
            $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($responseStream)
            $reader.BaseStream.Position = 0
            $reader.DiscardBufferedData()
            $responseBody = $reader.ReadToEnd();

            Write-Output "Response Body: $responseBody"
        }
    }

    Write-Output "`n"
}
```

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
The `X-Account-Id` and `X-Application-Id` headers are appended to all authenticated API v2 calls. This allows to identify requests in our logs for troubleshooting and data analysis.

As of right now, we only append the log enrichment header when the auth values are passed in as query string parameters. This PR will append the headers when the auth request headers (`X-API-Key` and `X-API-Access-Token`) are used **but only for PubPlat**.

This change is in response to INCIDENT-1169 where we are aiming to add a rewrite URL that will move the authenticating query string parameters into the auth headers to prevent logging sensitive values.

## How to Test
Setup
1. Start up API v2 and visit https://api.stackexchange.local/docs/me#order=desc&sort=reputation&filter=default&site=meta.stackexchange.local&run=true
2. Click on "Get Token" 
3. Open the network activity inspector, make the request and copy the URL from the request to the API. It should include a `key` and `access_token` query string parameter.

Using a tool such as Bruno or Postman and the API request URL above:
1. Create a request with the URL and change it from `/me` to `/questions`, the response should include both a `X-Account-Id` and `X-Application-Id` header
2. Resend the request without the access token, the response should only have a `X-Application-Id` header
3. Remove the key and query parameters and instead send the auth credentials using the `X-API-Key` and `X-API-Access-Token` request headers. The response should include both a `X-Account-Id` and `X-Application-Id` header.
4. Remove the `X-API-Access-Token` request header and only send in the `X-API-Key` header. The response should only include the `X-Application-Id` header.
5. Remove both headers and perform an anonymous request. The response should NOT contain the `X-Account-Id` or `X-Application-Id` header.
title: INCIDENT-1169/YETI2-743 - Append log enrichment headers when using API v2 auth headers

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
This PR builds on the work established by Dusan in https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23475.

It provides an interface for developers to configure the allowed site list for each data licensing API tier. In addition, there is a developer route to do a sync of the existing site settings. 

The new table `DataLicensingTierSites` is an allow list rather than the block list we previously established with site settings.

## Important Note
There are different types of sites in the Sites table. Sites can also have different states.

I have filtered down to only show sites that are either a "meta" or "main" and are either "public", "public beta" or "private beta" (these are accessible in API v2). 

This does raise a concern over sites that die (SiteStateId = 5). Dead sites cannot be accessed in API v3. They result in a 500 internal server error. However, the record remains in the database. Right now, I am filtering out dead sites from the developer UI but can add them back.

## How to Test
Ignore the PR environment since the data changes of this work are easier validated locally. 

**One Time Sync Developer Route**
1. Add a sensitive site on your local to both sensitive site settings such as `literature.stackexchange.local` site (Id = 668), make sure to add multiple sites to at least one site setting such as Server Fault (Id = 2)
   - https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_Sensitive_Sites
   - https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_Sensitive_Sites_ForAWS
2. Run the developer route `?dryRun=true`, it should print a preview of the changes and should not insert any values into "DataLicensingTierSites".
   - https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/data-licensing/sync-allowed-sites?dryRun=true
3. Run the developer route with `?dryRun=false`, it should print a success message and insert the expected values into the "DataLicensingTierSites" table. For example, 668 should not be in the list if it was listed as sensitive.
   -  https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/data-licensing/sync-allowed-sites?dryRun=false

**Developer UI**
1. Click "Select all" and "Save", verify all of the values have been inserted into the "DataLicensingTierSites" table
2. Click "Select all" again and "Save", the confirmation modal should not show any changes since all values were already selected. Click "Save", there should not be any duplicate entries in the table.
3. Uncheck some of the sites and click "Save", verify the confirmation modal displays the changes and click "Save". Confirm that the values have been deleted from the database 
4. Uncheck some of the sites and click "Undo pending changes" it should undo any changes you have made, the save confirmation modal should display no changes
title: YETI2-691 - Add DataLicensingTierSites table and developer view to configure

body:
After releasing this, we saw a lot of [these exceptions](https://opserver.main-prod.int.gcp.stackoverflow.net/exceptions/detail?id=f01a94bd-aa5e-4467-b997-af616fc4419a&log=Q%26A&store=). `PeopleSelector with PercentageSampleSize was called for an anonymous user who is not the current user. This was caused by a combination of things so here's a couple of things to prevent a couple of them:

- Explicitly check `IsAnonymous`, then we'll never get to that PeopleSelector.
- Check if the user object being checked is `currentUser`. If so the check can use the current IP address and would work anyway.

This PR is for [ASCN-666](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/ASCN-666).

During Ascension, we duplicated the environment settings files for Dev and Prod and placed those in the CNAB folder. Now that the data center is gone, we no longer need the original files in `StackOverflow.Common`. This PR moves the CNAB env settings files back to `StackOverflow.Common`.

I've changed the Dev defaults to be `main-test` to avoid confusion for other developers. Octopus will make sure that environment variables override any environment specific values.

body:
KRAKEN-2398 KRAKEN-2399 KRAKEN-2400

## Summary

This PR adds functionality that allows users below the upvote/downvote privilege to cast 5 free votes per week. See https://meta.stackoverflow.com/questions/434568/stack-overflow-experiment-safely-expanding-voting-access for some details on how Free Votes works.

Free Votes are just regular upvotes/downvotes with a `TargetRepChange` set to `0`. Whenever a Free Vote is added, we add a record to the new `FreeVotes` table which joins to the vote in `Posts2Votes`. We ensure that the `TargetRepChange` stays at `0` during a Rep Recalculation as well.

There are tests covering all the cases I could think of! We should be pretty covered there, but I'm happy to add more if you can think of any.

## How to Test

Brace yourself, this is a huge testing plan! I haven't run through it myself (relying on the automated tests here) so we should run through it together in a pair programming fashion.

### Site Setting Off

With [FreeVotes.EnabledFor](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Votes.FreeVotes.EnabledFor) set to nobody, ensure:

- A user below 15 rep cannot cast a free upvote
- A user below 125 rep cannot cast a free downvote
- A user at or above 15 rep can cast a regular upvote
- A user at or above 125 rep can cast a regular upvote

### Site Setting On

With [FreeVotes.EnabledFor](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Votes.FreeVotes.EnabledFor) set to All:

- [Impersonate a user with 1 rep](https://meta.stackexchange.local/impersonate-by-rep/1)
  - You should be able to cast a Free Upvote
    - It should NOT increase the reputation for the upvoted user
    - You should be able to undo your Free Upvote within 5 minutes of voting
  - You should NOT be able to cast a Free Downvote on a question
  - You should NOT be able to cast a Free Downvote on an answer
  - You should only be able to cast 5 Free Upvotes per week
- [Impersonate a user with 2 rep](https://meta.stackexchange.local/impersonate-by-rep/2)
  - You should be able to cast a Free Upvote
    - It should NOT increase the reputation for the upvoted user
    - You should be able to undo your Free Upvote within 5 minutes of voting
  - You should be able to cast a Free Downvote on a question
    - It should NOT decrease the reputation for the downvoted user
    - It should NOT decrease the reputation for the downvoting user
    - You should be able to undo your Free Downvote within 5 minutes of voting
  - You should be able to cast a Free Downvote on an answer
    - It should NOT decrease the reputation for the downvoted user
    - It SHOULD decrease the reputation by 1 for the downvoting user
    - You will now be at 1 rep and will be unable to cast any more free downvotes
    - You should be able to undo your Free Downvote within 5 minutes of voting and go back to 2 rep
  - You should only be able to cast 5 Free Upvotes and/or Downvotes per week
- [Impersonate a user with 15 rep](https://meta.stackexchange.local/impersonate-by-rep/15)
  - You should be able to cast a regular Upvote
    - It SHOULD increase the reputation for the upvoted user
    - You should be able to undo your regular Upvote within 5 minutes of voting
  - You should be able to cast a Free Downvote on a question
    - It should NOT decrease the reputation for the downvoted user
    - It should NOT decrease the reputation for the downvoting user
    - You should be able to undo your Free Downvote within 5 minutes of voting
  - You should be able to cast a Free Downvote on an answer
    - It should NOT decrease the reputation for the downvoted user
    - It SHOULD decrease the reputation by 1 for the downvoting user
    - You will now be at 14 rep and will be unable to cast any more regular upvotes
    - You should be able to undo your Free Downvote within 5 minutes of voting and go back to 15 rep
  - You should only be able to cast 5 Free Upvotes and/or Downvotes per week
- [Impersonate a user with 125 rep](https://meta.stackexchange.local/impersonate-by-rep/125)
  - You should be able to cast a regular Upvote
    - It SHOULD increase the reputation for the upvoted user
    - You should be able to undo your regular Upvote within 5 minutes of voting
  - You should be able to cast a regular Downvote on a question
    - It SHOULD decrease the reputation for the downvoted user
    - It should NOT decrease the reputation for the downvoting user
    - You should be able to undo your regular Downvote within 5 minutes of voting
  - You should be able to cast a Free Downvote on an answer
    - It SHOULD decrease the reputation for the downvoted user
    - It SHOULD decrease the reputation by 1 for the downvoting user
    - You will now be at 124 rep and will be unable to cast any more regular downvotes
    - You should be able to undo your regular Downvote within 5 minutes of voting and go back to 125 rep
  - You should not be limited to casting 5 votes a week because you have access to regular voting

body:
## Summary

This PR backs up the base database used by playwright tests so we don't have to run migrations and import data on every single run. 

To do so, the following changes are included:
1. Add methods to the Setup project to trigger a backup or a restore of the database
2. Unify `stackoverflow-setup-network` and `stackoverflow-setup-importer` into a single container
  a. This change on itself already saved some time, as we don't need to spin up as many containers
3. Create `.docker/setup-and-export-data.sh` script that either restore backups if present, or run migrations and import data if not
4. Update `acceptance-tests.yml` to restore the cache if present. If not, upload the cache after the test runs
5. Add option to skip backup when using the `network add` command, as for some reason the initial backups were not being cleaned up correctly, causing us to upload that backup instead of the one taken after the data importer

## How to Test

Test that it's working
1. Check if the playwright db is cached in the [cache page](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/actions/caches). If so, delete it.
2. Rerun the Functional Acceptance Tests
3. Check that the playwright db cache was created in the [cache page](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/actions/caches)
4. Rerun the Functional Acceptance Tests

To test that it's saving time, that's difficult to have hard data. Since it's not run within the test command as integration tests, we can't see the setup on any traces on Datadog. If you look at the "Run tests" step, see that tests start executing near the 1 minute mark, were before it was executing near the 2.5 minutes mark

My goal is for his to also reduce flakiness, as the importer is currently a big source of flakiness (example [here](https://us3.datadoghq.com/ci/pipeline-executions?query=ci_level%3Apipeline%20%40ci.pipeline.name%3A%22Functional%20Acceptance%20tests%22%20%40ci.status%3Aerror%20-%40git.branch%3Agtrombeta%2Fscale-552&agg_m=count&agg_m_source=base&agg_t=count&buildId=AwAAAZhRFIjILtezFQAAABhBWmhSRklqSUFBRDk5NkVHOUtyZFh1M20AAAAkMTE5ODUxYzMtMjAxOC00OGQ3LWFkMjgtNzRiNTM5YjliNTVmAABYEA&colorByAttr=meta%5B%27ci.job.name%27%5D&currentTab=trace&fromUser=false&graphType=flamegraph&index=cipipeline&sort=time&spanID=18103762983945127697&spanViewTypePipeline=metadata&trace=AwAAAZhRFIjILtezFQAAABhBWmhSRklqSUFBRDk5NkVHOUtyZFh1M20AAAAkMTE5ODUxYzMtMjAxOC00OGQ3LWFkMjgtNzRiNTM5YjliNTVmAABYEA&start=1753291296548&end=1753896096548&paused=false))

It moves several root level folders (which should not be root level) in appropriate folders:

- Move the `ask/ask.dev.ts` file under `entry-points/developer/ask.dev.mod.ts`
- Move `Channels` to `legacy/scoped/Channels`
- Convert `Dashboard/Widgets/UserBreakdownWidget` and `Dashboard/Widgets/TrendingContentWidget` to ES modules (from namespaces)
- Move `Dashboard` to `legacy/scoped/Dashboard`
- Move `Discussions` to `legacy/scoped/Discussions`

- Move `highlightjs/highlight-js-merge-plugin.mod.ts` to `legacy/global/LegacyJS/highlightjs-merge-plugin.mod.ts`

This PR only takes care of folders from A to M. A follow up PR will be created to handle the rest. 
This is to reduce the changeset to review.

## How to Test

This PR just move folders around so the only thing to test is that things continue to work as expected.
You can test either locally or on the PR environment.

## Summary
This PR fixes an issue where the title component remained in an errored state when the CharCounter is in an errored state and a draft is discarded. Svelte has a very lazy state tracker where if it doesn't access a stateful variable in a derived rune run then it will unsubscribe from that variable and stop tracking its changes. This was causing our derived variable to not update.

## How to Test

2. Input a title that is longer than maxTitleSize

author: gabrieltron
body:
This is an attempt of fixing playwright tests sometimes hanging. This is what I think is going on:

1. We have 16 worker threads
2. During `OneTimeSetup` we acquire site setting locks in an async manner
3. NUnit does not have true async support. Even though the documentation says [OneTimeSetup may use async](https://docs.nunit.org/articles/nunit/writing-tests/attributes/onetimesetup.html), internally NUnit is [synchronously waiting](https://github.com/nunit/nunit/blob/5f561d887922485748855ca1f1dd17f3e6097a24/src/NUnitFramework/framework/Internal/MessagePumpStrategy.cs#L35)
  a. Hangdump confirmed that all 16 worker threads are stuck in the linked synchronous code
4. What's happening then is that 16 tests are trying to acquire the test locks, 1 succeeds, 15 fail. 15 threads are stuck on NUnit's synchronous implementation of async
5. NUnit does not immediately uses the same thread that acquired the lock to run the tests. The available thread will try to start the setup of another test first. It fails because site settings are locked, and now the only thread left is also stuck on NUnit's synchronous implementation of async
  a. You can see the logs where NUnit hanged that exact scenario happened, Example [here](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/actions/runs/16452768870/job/46502039146) and [here](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/actions/runs/16452981230/job/46502776463). 15 tests failed to acquire the lock, 1 succeeded, and then one failed

As a patch, this PR is increasing the number of threads available so we avoid all of them being stuck. A proper solution would be to review our Site Settings locking mechanism because it relies on async, which NUnit does not support, but the scope of that would be too big atm
title: SCALE-548: Increase number of NUnit threads

author: b-kelly
body:
## Summary

The "Review all posts" button was not updating its `disabled` styling properly, regardless of the set `disabled` prop. The reason for this is that the "button" in question is actually an `<a>` tag, which does not support the `disabled` prop ([spec](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/text-level-semantics.html#the-a-element)), unlike `button` and other form elements ([button spec](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-button-element) for comparison). As a result, modifying the `disabled` property does not update the DOM to match.

Since the page's behavior relies on the element being a hyperlink (i.e. can't change the element to a `<button>`), we have to switch to behavior that _will_ be reflected in the DOM - updating an attribute. [The Stacks docs](https://stackoverflow.design/product/components/buttons/#disabled) require us to set the `aria-disabled` attribute for proper styling. As a bonus, we get some a11y fixes for free as well.

Front-end only changes, so no tests added.

Follow the repro steps found on the ticket [TEAMS-14720](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-14720) to test.

body:
[STACKS-762](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/STACKS-762)

## Summary

This PR is the sixth step to implement our new frontend file structure as discussed [here](https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/C04EFFRL6G0/p1751299556217619) and shown in [this diagram
](https://lucid.app/lucidspark/c0e4fcf2-1a41-4c3d-b38a-ae9fab29ed00/edit?view_items=4xHtl3Ye9ogQ&invitationId=inv_22579d36-b479-43cd-84f4-dd6699623b76)

It moves several root level folders (which should not be root level) in appropriate folders:
- Move `Articles` to `legacy/scoped/Articles`
- Move `reviews` to `legacy/scoped/reviews`
- Delete unused `Charts/chartjs.helpers.ts`
- Move `Shared/comments.mod.ts` to `sprinkles/staging-ground/comments.mod.ts` since it is used only there
- Move `Shared/helpers.mod.ts` to `legacy/shared/helpers.mod.ts`
- Move `comments/*` to `legacy/global/LegacyJS/full-common/comments/*`
- Move `ContentHealth/*` under `legacy/scoped/ContentHealth/*`
- Move the content of `controllers/contact-form.mod.ts` directly in the `entry-points/contact.mod.ts` file (only place where it was used)
- Move the `ask/ask.dev.ts` file under `entry-points/developer/ask.dev.mod.ts`
- Move `Channels` to `legacy/scoped/Channels`
- Convert `Dashboard/Widgets/UserBreakdownWidget` and `Dashboard/Widgets/TrendingContentWidget` to ES modules (from namespaces)
- Move `Dashboard` to `legacy/scoped/Dashboard`
- Move `Discussions` to `legacy/scoped/Discussions`
- Inline content of `EndOfYear/EndOfYear.mod.ts` to `entry-points/end-of-year/end-of-year.mod.ts`
- Move `Enterprise` to `legacy/scoped/Enterprise`
- Move `highlightjs/highlight-js-merge-plugin.mod.ts` to `legacy/global/LegacyJS/highlightjs-merge-plugin.mod.ts`

This PR only takes care of folders from A to M. A follow up PR will be created to handle the rest. 
This is to reduce the changeset to review.

## How to Test

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
Our SOE instances all all equally built and deployed. Every instance has a K8s cluster, and inside that cluster we deploy the same apps, under the same namespaces. So for example each instance has a StackOverflow deployment under the `stackoverflow` namespace. 

In the new shared infra SOE architecture (aka cell architecture), we'll have a single K8s cluster (cell) that will host the applications of multiple customers. This means that a single K8s cluster will host mulitple StackOverflow deployments, therefore, we can't deploy them all under the `stackoverflow` namespace.

To address this issue, we decided to prefix all the namespaces with the instance's ticker, so for example `msft-stackoverflow`. 

In order to do so, this PR does:
- Define `Get-TransformedNamespace` function, as a single place where we defined the namespace to use based on the original hardcoded namespace. Right now, given `stackoverflow` it will return `{ticker}-stackoverflow` if `is_cell_based_architecture` is `true`, otherwise, it'll return `stackoverflow`
- Updated all the `install-xxxxx.ps1` scripts, to receive the namespace to use.
- Update all the runbooks and pre/deploy hooks to support custom namespaces.
- Updated config generation, moving lots of hardcoded urls from `environmentsettings.Prod.Enterprise.json` to be dynamically generated.


### How to test locally
We'll use the SOE AKS tenant

First we are going to test that this PR doesn't break anything for non cell deployments.
- Using the Octopus [runbook](https://stackeng.octopus.app/app#/Spaces-3/projects/stack-overflow-enterprise/operations/runbooks/Runbooks-3037/runNow), generate the variables. 
- Update the following things in the variables:
  - `runtime.name = local`
  - `deployment_targets[0|1].vars.deployment_group_metadata.is_cell_based_architecture = false`. Note, here are 2 deployment targets, update both. 
 - Run the `cnab-invoke install` command
 - Installation should succeed, and in OpenLens you should still see the usual namespaces (`stackoverflow`, `apiv2`, etc).

Now, we are going to try the cell deployments. 

- We need to delete the existing namespaces that don't have the ticker prefix to avoid conflicts with ingresses and also confusion. In order to do so, we need to do:

```
#Switch to the east cluster
kubectl config use-context aksue1dev-aks

#Delete all the namespaces from the east cluster
kubectl delete namespace astackoverflow; kubectl delete namespace apiv2; kubectl delete namespace apiv3; kubectl delete namespace scheduler; kubectl delete namespace tagserver; kubectl delete namespace channelsdbapi

#Switch to the west cluster
kubectl config use-context aksuw1dev-aks

#Delete all the namespaces from the west cluster
kubectl delete namespace astackoverflow; kubectl delete namespace apiv2; kubectl delete namespace apiv3; kubectl delete namespace scheduler; kubectl delete namespace tagserver; kubectl delete namespace channelsdbapi
```
- Update the following things in the variables:
  - `deployment_targets[0|1].vars.deployment_group_metadata.is_cell_based_architecture = true`. Note, here are 2 deployment targets, update both. 
- Run the `cnab-invoke install` command
- Installation should succeed, and in OpenLens you should see the new usual namespaces (`aks-stackoverflow`, `aks-apiv2`, etc). 
- App should work:
  - https://aks.dev.stackenterprise.co/ should load. 
  - You should see questions in the `/questions` page, meaning that tagserver is working. You can also confirm that with miniprofiler trace
  - Go to `/scheduler` to see the scheduler. Note, scheduler source might be off, that's because we need to run the runbook to update force update the sources. 
  - Go to /api and /api/v3, both should work.


Finally, in order to leave the AKS instance in a normal state:
- Go back and update `deployment_targets[0|1].vars.deployment_group_metadata.is_cell_based_architecture = false`. 
- Delete all the namespaces:
```
#Switch to the east cluster
kubectl config use-context aksue1dev-aks

#Delete all the namespaces from the east cluster
kubectl delete namespace aks-stackoverflow; kubectl delete namespace aks-apiv2; kubectl delete namespace aks-apiv3; kubectl delete namespace aks-scheduler; kubectl delete namespace aks-tagserver; kubectl delete namespace aks-channelsdbapi

#Switch to the west cluster
kubectl config use-context aksuw1dev-aks

#Delete all the namespaces from the west cluster
kubectl delete namespace aks-stackoverflow; kubectl delete namespace aks-apiv2; kubectl delete namespace aks-apiv3; kubectl delete namespace aks-scheduler; kubectl delete namespace aks-tagserver; kubectl delete namespace aks-channelsdbapi
```
- Run a new local deployment.
title: SCALE-507 Support custom namespaces
