author: gabrieltron
body:
## Summary

Jira: SCALE-260

This PR makes so our SCIM GET and POST endpoints conform with [Okta's specification](https://developer.okta.com/docs/guides/scim-provisioning-integration-prepare/main/#basic-user-schema). Here are the changes:

- Have a new auxiliary table to store the information passed by SCIM, as  we do not use it in product
  - This is in a new table because changing tables such `Accounts` is very risky, as any migrations that we run there will run on public as well, and those are huge and highly accessed tables

This fixes the following bugs:

- For given name and family name, we were previously splitting the display name in the first space character, the first resulting string was the given name, and the second string was the family name. This can return incorrect information. Even in SO Internal it's easy to find users where the display name is a nickname that cannot be parsed into given name and family name (e.g. balpha).
- The UserName that we were previously returning was the user's email. Although in practice I believe this is how most IdPs will define that field, the specification [SCIM specification](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7643#section-4.1.1) does not define a direct relationship between those attributes
- I also added to support modifying this data with the PUT verb. This was not required by Okta, and our PUT request does not support quite a few attributes. That said, the [SCIM specification says resources must be modifiable via PUT](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7644#section-3.5), so I wanted to include the PUT changes here to make sure we conform to specification

In addition, I also fixed a couple of status codes. [Okta provides a test suite ](https://developer.okta.com/docs/guides/scim-provisioning-integration-prepare/main/#test-your-scim-api)to test the SCIM implementation. Our current implementation was failing the tests, to make them pass the following was fixed:

- Status in the response body when an account is not found was changed to 404
- Response status and response body changed to 401 error when an invalid token is passed to the request

## How to Test

- Automated tests should cover all changes. Defer to them.
- Check the report of the test suite provided by Okta: https://www.runscope.com/radar/zrt6do76aq2m/acd9424b-144d-42e7-a482-fc54ff735c11/results/85f135e9-6c5f-4dfe-9512-ccc1339878ce
  - If you want to run the tests yourself, follow [Okta's instructions to setup the tests](https://developer.okta.com/docs/guides/scim-provisioning-integration-prepare/main/#test-your-scim-api). I deployed this branch to the [Sander Test instance](https://sktt.dev.stackenterprise.co/), so you may use it to setup the tests
title: SCALE-260: Make SCIM conform to Okta requirements

## Summary
This PR adds `HashHelper` so rate limiters can use SHA256 hashing for keys to prevent sensitive information like API keys from being exposed in our API v3 exception logs. Three rate limiters (backoff, burst throttle, and token bucket) now use SHA256 to create cache keys. 

## How to Test
Please let me know if there is a better way to test but this is how I tested locally:
1. Enable the following rate limiters in site settings
    * APIv3_BackoffRateLimit_Enabled
    * APIv3_BurstThrottle_Enabled
    * APIv3_TokenBucket_Enabled
2. Set break points in the following methods
    * `GetLockKey` in StackOverflow.Api.V3/Middleware/RateLimiter/BackoffRateLimiter.cs
    * `GetViolationLockKey` in StackOverflow.Api.V3/Middleware/RateLimiter/BackoffRateLimiter.cs
    * `GetClientKey` in StackOverflow.Api.V3/Middleware/RateLimiter/BurstThrottleRateLimiter.cs
    * `GetClientKey` in StackOverflow.Api.V3/Middleware/RateLimiter/TokenBucketRateLimiter.cs
3. Make calls with a valid bearer token
4. At each breakpoint, verify that keys are SHA256-hashed

## Summary

This PR adds two dev routes: one takes the app id and marks the app as disabled and expires all of its keys. The other one takes account id and does the same for all apps owned by that account.

- Create several applications and make sure they all have few keys (one app should have no keys, one just one, others can have several keys).

- Verify that all of its keys are expired.
- Verify that other apps and their keys are not expired.

## Summary

*Showing entry count with a message on the entry page telling the user when the entries will become visible.*

## How to Test

1. Create a new challenge
2. Go to challenge's page as both an anonymous user and a logged in user
3. Ensure that "no entries" is shown to both sets of users.
4. With a third logged in user, create an entry
5. Ensure that all the counts show "1 entry" for this user.
6. Go back to the other two users in step 2 and make sure both see the new message with 1 entry showing.

**Note**
There were also bugs in the entry counts because we were including replies in the entry counts. This was a problem on the main challenges page and the individual challenge page. 
To reproduce this issue in dev:
1. Create a challenge
2. Add an entry. Notice that all the entry counts on the main challenges page and the challenge's page show 1 entry
3. Add a reply to your own entry
4. Notice that the entry counts on the main challenge page and the challenge's page show 2 entries.
(You can also see this bug in production where there is a reply to the second entry of our challenge, but the reply is included in the counts)

This PR fixes these issues too by ensuring that we are looking at "top-level" replies/entries when showing the counts. This only happens with challenges, and not with discussions. So, nothing should have been broken in discussions by this change.
title: Show Entry count and message to users without an entry.

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
[**Jira**](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/jira/software/c/projects/YETI2/boards/411?selectedIssue=YETI2-514)
[**Figma**](https://www.figma.com/design/atoWgAoP2WFZhW2SAKFjeu/OverflowAPI?node-id=14-731&t=v2VsqfgGOaG7443z-1)

This PR adds the "Stack Apps post" input field to the "Edit details" modal in the new Stack Apps manage application dashboard. This field is required for users to request the `write_access` scope from Stack Overflow's OAuth endpoints. The post is also checked on all API calls to make sure the post has not been deleted.

#### Validation Rules 
Validation has been adapted from the following Stack Apps code:
https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/5aa630d57eeb3bed3c1ec0b73b8ceaa8f07ad03f/StackOverflow/Controllers/StackAppsController.cs#L203-L273

Input must meet all of these criteria to be considered valid:
1. Must be an HTTP/S link
2. Must be posted on Stack Apps
3. Post must be a question
4. Post must be authored by the current user
5. Post must contain either/both the [app] and/or [script] tag

This input field will accept both tiny URLs and full URLs. 

#### Architecture
There's a few utility functions in `StackOverflow.Common` that I needed to use. I do not want to copy the code into the module since I don't want to have multiple implementations of the same thing. For now, I settled on injecting these functions at the expense of testability. 

Since the functions appear to be primarily stateless, they are good candidates to move into a central place that can be accessed by all modules. However, I believe this is a problem for another time given the number of references on those methods.

#### Testing
- I have included some unit tests to validate the URL. 
- I have added a front-end unit test to verify that the user can submit the form _without_ a Stack Apps post URL.

## How to Test
I have set up the user Udo (4) with some API applications and a Stack Apps post. 
- Stack Apps Post Link https://22926-stackapps.stackexchange.cloud/questions/302
- Stack Apps Post Link to answer from user https://22926-stackapps.stackexchange.cloud/questions/303

User Staff-Moderator can be used to toggle site settings.
- Impersonate https://22926-stackapps.stackexchange.cloud/impersonate/1
- New flow site setting https://22926-stackapps.stackexchange.cloud/developer/site-settings/edit?name=StackApps.ApiApplicationSpaEnabledFor

**Users migrating from existing experience**
1. Using the old flow create an API application without a Stack Apps post and another one with a Stack Apps post
2. Enable the new flow and verify that the Stack Apps post is displayed correctly for each API application
3. You should be able to edit the "Application name" on both apps without seeing a validation error on the Stack Apps post URL input field

**New Users**
1. Using the new flow create a new API application
2. Verify you can edit the name of the application without an error on the Stack Apps post URL input field
3. Create a question as the logged in user with the [app] or [script] tag, add an answer to your question after it has been created
4. Link the tiny URL in your API application, it should link successfully (refresh the page to validate it is saved)
5. Link the full URL in your API application, it should link successfully (refresh the page to validate it is saved)
6. Attempt to link a URL with a very high ID that does not exist, it should fail with the message "Could not find post with ID: {id}."
7. Attempt to link a URL that is in a different domain, it should fail with the message "Post must be on Stack Apps."
8. Attempted to link a URL with the FTP protocol, it should fail with the message "Provided value is not a valid URL."
9. Attempt to link a URL from a question from a different author, it should fail with the message "Post must be authored by you."
10. Attempt to link a URL with an answer ID that the current user created, it should fail with the message "Post must be a question."
11. Remove the [app] or [script] tag from your post, and attempt to link a URL, it should fail with the message with the message "Post must be tagged with the [app] or [script] tags."
title: YETI2-514 - Add Stack Apps post input field to Stack Apps  manage application dashboard

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
We currently have an `SiteIntegrationTestCollection` which disables parallelization that needs to be added to any test that touches `SiteIntegrations` (quite a few). 

SiteIntegrations are stored in the AggregationDB (SitesDB or ChannelsDB). As we have not yet isolated the ChannelsDB, this PR only focuses in the **non-channels tests**. However, even though we isolated the SitesDB, there is another challenge, the `SiteIntegrations._cache` cache.

The `SiteIntegrations` class stores a cache in a static reference, so although we could have mutliple tests running concurrently with isolated SitesDBs, the cache would be shared, generating unexpected outcomes. In order to circumvent this issue, this PR allows to isolate that `_cache` for the ambient (async context) for testing. 

In order to do so, this PR introduces a new class `AmbientIsolatableObject<T>`. This class allows to store main reference to a object of type `T` (to be used in prod), but also allows us to override it for an ambient (to be used in tests). The goal is to reduce the boilerplate code of using ambient overrides, where we need to check if the object was overriden or not when accessing it.

The usage is pretty straight forward:

For example, in this PR's site integration cache, we just need to do:
```
private static readonly AmbientIsolatableObject<ImmutableDictionary<int, SiteIntegrations>> _cache = new();
```

If we want to isolate this cache for the Ambient, we need to do:
```
_cache.IsolateForAmbient();
```

And finally, in order to get the correct value, we just access:
```
_cache.Value
```


### `AmbientIsolatableObject` implementation details

The implementation is pretty straight forward, however it's important to note the use of `StrongBox<T>`. This is needed, because `AsyncLocals` only flow "down" the async call path, but not "up". This is due to AsyncLocal's [copy-on-write](https://blog.stephencleary.com/2013/04/implicit-async-context-asynclocal.html) behavior on the execution context. 

As a consequence if we just store `T` in the asynclocal, if in the async flow a method updates `_cache`, any async methods called after that will see the updated values, but if an async method is called and replaces the `_cache` with a new version of it (i.e. a purge or refresh), the parent context won't see the update. This is problematic, because we want to isolate the whole test context, and we want to allow this behavior.

The solution is to use `StrongBox<T>`. This class is just a "box" (reference) type that stores a value `T`. What this means is that when we call `IsolateForAmbient` we set the AsyncLocal to a `StrongBox`, that will be copied to all the child async methods, but now if the child wants to change the value it will change what's inside the `StrongBox`, so the reference to the StrongBox, which is what's not copied up, stays the same. This works, because the `copy-on-write` generates a shallow copy of the asynclocal. 

### Channels SiteIntegration tests
This PR still keeps the `SiteIntegrationTestCollection` in the Channels tests. `SiteIntegrations` are stored in the `ChannelsDB` for channels tests, which isn't isolated yet. We are still defining how we are going to work with isolated channels instances.
title: SCALE-513: SiteIntegrations tests parallelization

author: KyleMit
body: MOD-128 | PUBPLAT-4449 | PUBPLAT-4321 | PUBPLAT-4479 ## Summary ### Multiple markdown parsers This is an unfortunate side effect of having two entirely distinct markdown rendering engines, one on the client and one on the server. On the client we use [**markdown-it**](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it) And on the server we use [**markdig**](https://github.com/xoofx/markdig) As you can see from [this example in **Babelmark**][1] (which allows you compare markdown implementations), different engines are widely divided on whether a blank line is required before or after parsing a table ### The "Spec" So if they're divergent, which one is right? Which standard should we attempt to follow. According to [this discussion on GFM](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/156131) > The GFM spec isn’t clear on whether tables can interrupt a paragraph, which has led to some confusion. Some platforms require an empty line before a table, while others allow it to follow a paragraph with just a line break The GFM spec doesn't seem to cover it in [tables](https://github.github.com/gfm/#tables-extension-), but my reading is that a table is a [leaf block](https://github.github.com/gfm/#leaf-blocks) (similar to a heading or code fence) which can only start if the parser is not already in the middle of a paragraph ### Markdown-It (JS) Here's a [MRE of the issue with **markdown-it**](https://jsfiddle.net/KyleMit/f309gL7b/2/) Or a demo from [their own fiddle site][2] ### Markdig (C#) Here's a [MRE of the issue with **markdig**](https://dotnetfiddle.net/AT4hW8) There's also this issue raised on the markdig repo that [tables are not rendered properly unless there is a new line before them #818](https://github.com/xoofx/markdig/issues/818). This issue has been status declined, citing that the implementation was based on pandoc and this is by design. ### Possible Solution(s) Although Markdig does support modifying their pipelines, I couldn't come up with a way to avoid requiring blank lines surrounding tables I did noodle on an implementation for markdown-it that would modify their existing table rule to require an empty line before and after each table [Here's a demo of a markdown-it plugin **`requireBlankLineBeforeTable`**](https://codepen.io/KyleMit/pen/YPXKdXa?editors=0011) Just handling if the *preceding* line was blank, is a little bit easier and basically boils down to the following ```js const tableWrapperFunction = (state, startLine, endLine, silent) => { // must be at start of doc or have blank line before if (startLine > 0 && !state.isEmpty(startLine - 1)) { return false; } // Otherwise delegate to the original table parser return originalTableFunction(state, startLine, endLine, silent); } ``` However, as reported in [Markdown preview doesn't match post](https://meta.stackexchange.com/q/358999/209031), we also probably want to cover cases where a trailing blank line is also required. This requires checking the first line of a possible table, and then each subsequent line to see if it looks like a table (starts with a `|`), and then making sure the line *after* that is blank (or the end of the document) [Here's a demo of a markdown-it plugin **`requireBlankLinesAroundTable`**](https://codepen.io/KyleMit/pen/myJbaRQ?editors=0010) Which basically boils down to the following logic ```js const tableWrapperFunction = (state, startLine, endLine, silent) => { // if we don't start with |, definitely not a table if (firstCharInLine(state, startLine) !== '|') { // definitely not a table return false; } // must be at start of doc or have blank line before if (startLine > 0 && !state.isEmpty(startLine - 1)) { return false; } // Now scan forward until we hit a line that doesn't start with '|' or the end let nextLine = startLine + 1; while ( nextLine < state.lineMax && firstCharInLine(state, nextLine) === '|' ) { nextLine++; } // must be at end of doc or have blank line after all | lines if (nextLine < state.lineMax && !state.isEmpty(nextLine)) { return false; } // we've met all our checks - delegate back to the core table parser return originalTableFunction(state, startLine, endLine, silent); } ``` This does start to make some assumptions but it's relatively clean to implement. For example, I'm not verifying the number of pipes match previous rows and the content is legitimately a table - just that it "looks" like a table row by starting with a pipe (`|`). ## Meta Posts * [Markdown table preview does not detect missing blank line before table header](https://meta.stackexchange.com/q/359192/209031) * [Rendered view requires blank line before (and after) tables, but preview works regardless](https://meta.stackoverflow.com/q/404376/1366033) * [Markdown preview doesn't match post](https://meta.stackexchange.com/q/358999/209031) * [New Feature: Table Support](https://meta.stackexchange.com/questions/356997/new-feature-table-support/357596#357596) [1]: https://babelmark.github.io/?text=Filled+Row+Before+Table%0A%7C+simple+table+%7C%0A%7C+------------+%7C%0A%7C+goes+here++++%7C [2]: https://markdown-it.github.io/#md3=%7B%22source%22%3A%22Filled%20Row%20Before%20Table%5Cn%7C%20simple%20table%20%7C%5Cn%7C%20------------%20%7C%5Cn%7C%20goes%20here%20%20%20%20%7C%22%7D ## How to Test 1. Try it in the both the old editor and new editor. Can toggle answers editor via [`Answers.StacksEditorEnabledFor`](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Answers.StacksEditorEnabledFor) 2. Try using the following input with preceding line ``` Filled Row Before Table | simple table | | ------------ | | goes here | ``` 3. You should **not** see a table on both the client and server rendered html 4. Try using the following input with trailing line ``` | simple table | | ------------ | | goes here | Filled row after table ``` 5. You should **not** see a table on both the client and server rendered html 6. Try using the following input with empty lines surrounding the table ``` Empty lines around table | simple table | | ------------ | | goes here | Empty lines around table ``` 7. You **should** see a table on both the client and server rendered html ## Unit Tests If you want to run unit tests for just the `md-table.test.ts` file, in the `StackOverflow` directory, you can run either of the following ```bash $ npm run test:legacy -- ./_Scripts/plugins/md-table.test.ts ``` ```bash $ npx vitest ./_Scripts/plugins/md-table.test.ts ```
title: MOD-128 Markdown on client should require empty line before and after

author: animuson
body:
## Summary

When anonymous users attempt to visit any page on Enterprise, we normally redirect them to the login page because login is required for access to all pages. However, the OnlyAllow and other related attributed overrides this behavior and causes to drop a PageNotFound for things like the /developer, /admin, and /enterprise routes instead of redirecting like all other pages. This behavior is inconsistent, as any other page that might 404 when accessing would still redirect. It also violates the intended security through obscurity of not revealing the page exists, because it ends up inherently revealing that a page _does_ exist there to any anonymous user due to the fact it behaves differently from all other pages.

This difference in handling has annoyed both customers and staff for a long time as the site does not make it obvious you are not logged in when you hit an anonymous 404 page. The top bar does not display a Log In button in the top bar for anonymous users since we normally redirect everyone to the login page already. Clients sometimes assume the link just doesn't work.

This fix alters the AuthorizeOrNotFound behavior to add a check for IsEnterprise and IsAnonymous to perform a redirect, matching behavior for redirects across the rest of the site, and falls back to the usual PageNotFound behavior when any of those conditions is no longer true.

## How to Test

1. Open Enterprise in incognito tab to ensure you're logged out.
2. Try to visit /developer/site-settings (or any other access-restricted path)
3. Observe that you are redirected to the login page with a correct return URL
title: TEAMS-14640: Consistently redirect to login for anonymous Enterprise users

author: giamir
body:
[STACKS-746](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/STACKS-746)

# Summary

> ⚠️ Do not merge before https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/22908 is merged

This PR introduces few lines of bash in the "frontend lint and test workflow" to report code coverage diff between the PR branch and the main branch as a sticky comment for PRs that are touching files in the StackOverflow project.
 
I decided to write few lines of bash to keep the job simple and avoid installing node,js or another runtime in the GH agent. This also allowed me to inline the code directly in the workflow for now and not having to identify a dedicated location in the repo. Removing this feature will be as straightforward as removing this job.

author: gabrieltron
body:
## Summary

This PR is a followup from #22793 . What it does is:

- Isolate elastic search on API v3
  - For the main tests and Channels the isolation is being done with the isolated databases. This is to make it easier to do the right thing - use the elastic isolation alongside database isolation to reduce the number of posts to index. API v3 does not have an isolated database, so I just added it to the base class
- Remove `SiteIntegrationTestCollection` from a few tests - Those now use an isolated database and might parallelized 
  - `SiteIntegrationTestCollection` was not removed from Channels tests, as those do not have the Site (or Channels) DB isolated yet, so using the isolated db will still mess up installation data
- Add elastic index isolation to the channels isolated database
  - Although the elastic index isolation was added, channels isolated databases do not work with elastic, even without the isolation. This is because the Search library creates a new DB context in the shared DB, causing the indexing to fail. It's not straightforward to fix this issue, we cannot simply override the connection string mappings [as we do with the regular Isolated Database ](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/c863f288aa64fcac79539602b15f2af8c9f0a55f/tests/StackOverflow.Tests.Integration/TestHelpers/IsolatedDatabaseTest.cs#L36)because the username is a substring of the DB name, so the mapping replaces both db name and username, causing the connection to fail. This is a solvable issue, but given the way we isolate Channels may change on SCALE-463 (currently in progress) to use different channels instead of a different database, I'm not digging further here as this issue will not appear in the new approach.

## How to Test

Tests should still pass. I ran the [CI for the latest commit ](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/actions/runs/15258514469/)5 times, and they all passed
title: SCALE-486: Isolate elastic on APIv3 and Channels tests + more parallelization

author: qheaden-stack
body:
# Summary

This PR adds a new experiment called "Stack Heartbeat" which adds a sidebar widget on the question ask page that shows some statistics about activity on Stack Overflow. The hope is that this encourages users to post as they can see how many users are active on the sites.

## AJAX Data Loading

In this PR, the widget is rendered server-side, but is filled with 0 numbers and is hidden on the page using the Stacks `v-hidden` class. This leaves space for it on the page as opposed to `d-none` which will hide it completely from DOM positioning. The Javascript then hits the endpoint to get the numbers, and if successful, fills out the text in the widget and then reveals it by removing the `v-hidden` class. This then shows the widget to the user.

By loading this way, we prevent any slowdowns or issues with the query from slowing down or preventing the load of the question ask page. This can result in a slight pop-in of the widget for users.

## How to Test

- [Impersonate the dev user](https://22840.stackoverflow.cloud/users/impersonate/1)
- [Visit the question ask page](https://22840.stackoverflow.cloud/questions/ask)
- Ensure you see the community stats widget on the right sidebar
- Submit a question
- [Clear the Redis cache key](https://22840.stackoverflow.cloud/developer/redis/killkey/stack-heartbeat-community-stats)
- [Revisit the question ask page]([Visit the question ask page](https://22840.stackoverflow.cloud/questions/ask)
- Ensure the number of question askers increased
- [Impersonate a different user](https://22840.stackoverflow.cloud/users/impersonate/5)
- Answer the question you just posted, or any other question
- [Impersonate the dev user again](https://22840.stackoverflow.cloud/users/impersonate/1)
- [Clear the Redis cache key again](https://22840.stackoverflow.cloud/developer/redis/killkey/stack-heartbeat-community-stats)
- [Revisit the question ask page once more]([Visit the question ask page](https://22840.stackoverflow.cloud/questions/ask)
- Ensure the answers shared count increases
title: [LAUNCH-104] - Stack Heartbeat Experiment

author: shiyaoli-1
body:
If an account owner is a user **on Stack Overflow** and has **<20 reputation**, we send them the Stack Overflow chat beginner room notif. (About 25 million in prod)

_After all SO notifs are sent,_ we check for account owners who are not a Stack Overflow user, and have <20 combined rep from all network sites. We send them the Stack Exchange chat beginner room notif. (About 9 million in prod)

## Local Testing ##
No good way to test the whole thing. Happy to walk through in a call instead.

1. Run `https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/send-beginner-chat-room-notification?isLocalTesting=true`
 - `isLocalTesting` just switches the SO notifs to being sent to Meta Stack Exchange users. I do have users who are SO users in my local `NetworkUsers` table, so if you do too, it doesn't matter if you include it. If successful, there should be logs on the screen indicating how many users it notified.

2. Run 
```sql
Select AccountId from NetworkUsers where SiteId = 4 and Reputation < 20 group by AccountId;
```
It should have the same number of lines as

```sql
select * from Inboxes where InboxTypeId = 121
```

if `isLocalTesting` was false, you need to update `SiteId` to 1.

3. Run
```sql
SELECT AccountId, Count(AccountId) as SiteCount, Sum(Reputation) as ReputationSum, Count(*)
FROM NetworkUsers
WHERE AccountId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY AccountId
HAVING MAX( CASE SiteId  WHEN 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 0
   AND SUM(Reputation) < 20
ORDER BY SiteCount desc;
```
It should have the same number of lines as 
```sql
select * from Inboxes where InboxTypeId = 121
```

if `isLocalTesting` was false, you need to update `SiteId`  in the `HAVING` clause to 1 as well.

4. After all inboxes notifications are sent, if you run the route again, no more notif should be added.
title: AW-1335 Add route to batch send beginner chat room notifications

## Summary

This PR is adding caching for ApiApplication record which is currently being loaded rom the database multiple times for each and every API request. Caching is being done for 10min with a local cache. In order to do the caching I implemented ApiApplicationService in addition to already existing ApiApplicationRepository. Service calls repository and does the cashing. I then replaced all usages of `Repository.Get()` with a call to `Service.Get()`. Additionally I refactored BaseTest class and replaced `servicesConfiguration` constructor parameter with `ConfigureServices()` so that service configuration can be performed without static method requirements.

Since most of the code here is mechanical refactorings required to do the caching, I split the change into 3 commits for easier PR review:
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/commit/88f5165a66824d59293727abb51dc5a902377240 adds an empty service and replaces the calls to repository's Get() method with calls to newly added service's Get() method.
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/commit/a02a73fbd9f884778a9d43743d6a20714cefb68f replaces above mentioned `servicesConfiguration` parameter with overloadable method.
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/commit/a47ff90aad5f8dd49162c26d7f29acaa540882b0 does the actual caching and adds tests for it

## How to Test

- On your local add a breakpoint in ApiApplicationRepository.Get() method.
- Issue an api request and verify that the breakpoint is being hit.
- Issue the same api request again (within the 10mins) and verify that breakpoint is not being hit.
title: YETI2-559: Added caching for ApiApplication object

author: ProductiveRage
body:
## What

It seems like quite a lot of flakiness originates from how Redis is involved in our integration tests (citation needed, maybe! 😆). We have some hacks and workarounds to try to isolate tests (key prefixes for Redis stores, to try to segregate data persisted between test classes) but I'm not sure that they are as effective as we would like.

So I wondered about whether we should change the default for integration tests to be to use in-memory stores, in place of Redis stores. Most of the integration tests that hit code paths that involve access to Redis-backed caches aren't explicitly testing the Redis integration, and the tests that _do_ intentionally try to exercise a Redis cache / integration can override the caches used within their own scope such that Redis is called.

Hopefully the changes here achieve greater test isolation, reduce flakiness, and _may_ even make the test suite run faster since cross-process calls to Redis no longer occur!

## How

In crafting this PR, I discovered that the `LocalCache` in the `StackRedis` repo is.. somewhat incomplete. To explore what was missing / not working, I created a wrapper class `LocalCacheWithFixes`. If this PR is merged, we should make these changes to the `StackRedis` repo, and delete the `LocalCacheWithFixes` from the integration tests.

I've made an effort to change only the test code, where possible, and avoid touching the production code - however, a few changes were necessary, such as in the `ChannelSubscription` class, where there was no way to override what caches it would use (and where it _has_ to use a real Redis-back cache because the `ChannelSubscriptionTests` call `SiteActivity.GetForSite(..)` and that relies upon `ExecuteScript` calls to Redis).

## Who

This work is probably best aligned with Scale Pod, and so I'll be asking them whether they think it makes sense to push this PR over the line.

---------------------------------------------------

- [x] I've given a good description above that describes the changes and why they're needed.
- [x] I've added instructions on how to test this PR.
- [x] I've added unit and integration tests as appropriate, or justified their absence.
- [x] This PR can be reviewed in a few hours at most. (Please consider splitting it up otherwise.)
title: EXPERIMENT: Try mocking out Redis for integration tests

## Summary

Jira: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-6148

When an Enterprise admin is using the Private Teams settings to view the members list for an individual team, we still display a Download CSV button to them. The button currently goes to a 404 not found because it links to an incorrect page.

We could manually alter this URL to include the `/c/{slug}` part of the URL needed to land on the correct page, but that still requires the admin to also be a team owner for the specified team. Otherwise, they'll either receive a "request access" message if they are not a member at all, or a 404 still if they are not a team owner.

Given that, it makes more sense to just not show the button on the global Enterprise admin page and only display it when viewing users from within Private Teams itself, to the team owners.

## How to Test

1. Go to Admin settings then click on the Teams section in the left menu (/enterprise/teams).
2. Select any private team in the list.
3. Ensure the Download CSV button _does not_ appear on the page.
4. Visit any team from the left sidebar and visit the Admin settings then Users and permissions.
5. Ensure the Download CSV button _does_ appear on the page.

1. Impersonate the type of user under `Triggerer` column
2. Find or create a question with an asker of the type of user in the `Asker` column with an answer by the type of user in the `Target` column
3. Accept the target's answer
4. Observer that the asker and target get the amount of rep as shown in the the `* should receive` columns
5. Run a recalc of both users and ensure that the rep amount _has not changed_

### mod force accept vote

Triggerer (mod) should _never_ get the +2

| Triggerer | Asker  | Target        | Asker should receive              | Answerer should receive |     |
| --------- | ------ | ------------- | --------------------------------- | ----------------------- | --- |
| mod       | mod    | mod (self)    | 0                                 | 0                       | ✅   |
| mod       | user1 | mod           | 0 (did not cast the accept vote!) | 15                      | ✅   |
| mod       | user1 | user1 (self) | 0                                 | 0                       | ✅   |
| mod       | user1 | user2         | 0 (did not cast the accept vote!) | 15                      | ✅   |

### self accept vote

Triggerer (question owner) should always get +2 on not-self

| Triggerer | Target | Triggerer should receive | Target should receive |     |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------ | --------------------- | --- |
| mod       | mod    | 0                        | 0                     | ✅   |
| user1    | user1 | 0                        | 0                     | ✅   |
| user1    | user2 | 2                        | 15                    | ✅   |

---

<details><summary>original description</summary>

> Jira: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-10456
> 
> A while ago, we implemented logic in the voting system that allows moderators/admins on Teams to accept answers on behalf of the question asker. The following rules are currently implemented there:
> 
> - The moderator accepting the answer never receives the +2 reputation for casting the accept vote.
> - The author of the answer always receives the +15 reputation for an accepted answer, even if the moderator is accepting their own answer, unless the author of the answer also authored the question.
>
> However, this logic was never implemented into the RepRecalc system, which means these reputation changes eventually get lost once a moderator's reputation is recalculated automatically (for example, after a post delete/undelete), resulting in a potentially large drop in reputation with no trace of what happened in the user's history.
> 
> This PR adds an extra IsForceAccepted check which does a quick DB query for the AnswerForceAccepted variable we store in PostMetadata. If the answer was force accepted, we return the correct values of +0 for accepting and +15 for being accepted for the moderator involved in the vote.
> 
> Ideally, we would be storing the variable for ForceAccepted directly onto the vote instead of in PostMetada so that it could easily be pulled into the RepRecalc system instead of doing a DB query. However, that would be a significantly higher amount of code and structural changes. Instead, I made sure the query only runs if it is an AcceptedAnswer vote and the AllowModsToAcceptAnswersForAllUsers site setting is on (which should only be true for Teams). This ensures the changes don't impact performance at all on public. The query result is cached per-row so that it isn't run multiple times for a single vote.
> 
> ## How to Test
> There are two separate avenues to test depending on whether the moderator accepts their own answer or someone else's answer. I recommend going to your own profile and triggering a recalc manually before doing testing, to ensure there are no other pending reputation changes on your account that might interfere with the values we're looking at.
> 
> To perform a reputation recalc: visit your profile, click on the Mod button at the top right to open the modal, select Developer info in the dropdown, then click on Debug to the right of Rep history. This will display a page with a bunch of values for what running a recalc would change vs the current values. You can trigger the actual recalc by clicking the button at the very bottom of this page.
> 
> ### Accepting your own answer as moderator
> 1. Post an answer to another user’s question.
> 2. As a moderator, accept your own answer.
> 3. Upon accepting, you are awarded the 15 reputation for the answer.
> 4. Trigger a reputation recalc for your account.
> 5. Ensure you retained the 15 reputation for the accepted answer and that it did not zero out (reputation did not change).
> ### Accepting someone else's answer as moderator
> 1. Visit any question that has an answer that is not accepted and not posted by you.
> 2. As a moderator, accept that answer.
> 3. Upon accepting, the other user is awarded 15 reputation and you are awarded 0 for accepting.
> 4. Trigger a reputation recalc for your account.
> 5. Ensure you did not receive 2 reputation for accepting the answer (reputation did not change).

</details>

TEAMS-14564

# Summary

This PR fixes TEAMS-14564 by escaping the text for the titles and the department names as described in the [Slack documentation](https://api.slack.com/reference/surfaces/formatting#escaping). 

Example of the issue in my local data:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5bd59985-5598-44f7-bff9-f7cf3f861ae2)

The same text after applying the fix:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/17275d4e-2f06-4a1c-93c3-13bd5201d6fc)

# Implementation Notes
- It seems this issue only happens with our title links in digests. Search and notifications handle this separately, and inline links in the answer text are not rendered
- Instead of escaping the title portion of the link in multiple places, I introduced a `FormattingHelper.TitleWithLink` that creates the title link for us. I was hoping this would make it easier to remember to escape the title portion of the text
- I left `FormattingHelper.EscapeText` public to make it obvious that it can be used as other situations come up.
- Search and Notifications use [a converter](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/b23220a2745aa8f1003e04612e051c5544f03554/src/StackOverflow.Module.Slack/SlackApi/Markdown/SlackMarkdownReplacers.cs#L53) that already does some of this, but since we haven't used any of that functionality in the digest code, I think it's best to just leave them separate.

# How to Test

1. Create or edit a question with the character '<' in it, as well as '>' and '&'. The example where we found the bug was the string "(<= 3 years)". Before this fix, the '<' character in particular would cause the rendered markup to look bad since there wasn't a closing '>'. I suggest trying this on `main` to see the issue before checking the fix. Note: if you follow the '<' with a closing '>' it may not replicate the issue properly.
2. Generate a digest
3. Confirm that the text shows up properly.

Notifications and search results are a separate code path and do not exhibit this bug.

author: animuson
body:
# Summary

Our current `GetPostCount` method does not account for the situation where `IncludeDeletedDrafts` is set to false but `IncludeDeleted` is set to true. This results in a situation where the list of posts to be displayed does _not_ include deleted drafts, but the count of posts does. The ultimate side-effect here is that the pagination tools at the bottom of such a posts list can include extra pages that will not display any results. As far as I can tell, this combination of events is currently only possible for articles, but we should future-proof this method in case that changes.

The solution here is two-part:

1. Added a new `WherePostStatesNotDeleted` method to the query builder, which can take in two lists of post states. One list will be post states which should always be shown (regardless of if they are deleted) and the other is a list of post states which will only be shown if not deleted. This allows for us to account for the situation where we are displaying a mix of deletion states - only showing deleted posts of specific post states. This is already implemented correctly on `GetArticles` but there was no corresponding logic in `GetPostCount` because the existing query builder methods did not allow for it.
2. Tweak the logic of `GetPostCount` to use the new method by keeping track of which post states can only be shown if not deleted when the `IncludeDeletedDrafts` variable is set to false.

Also note that I removed the explicit PostStates override from TabArticles because it essentially replicates logic that already exists in `GetArticles` but prevents the logic for determining which post states to show deleted from working without a bunch of extra tweaks to the method.

# How to Test

1. Create an article and save it as a draft.
2. Delete the draft article without publishing it.
4. Go to your profile page's Activity tab then the Articles sub-tab.
5. Ensure the count on the page does not include the deleted article draft.

## Unit Tests

As far as I could tell, there are not currently any unit tests that exist for User.Posts to cover any of the combinations of variables that can occur for `GetPostCount`. I don't think this would break counts anywhere else because it specifically only changes behavior in cases where `IncludeDeletedDrafts` is explicitly always false, which only appears to occur in two places in the code (one of them being the articles tab we are fixing here). However, it is hard to verify given that there don't appear to be any other unit tests to make sure this doesn't break anything. Adding tests for this method to cover all cases would be an entire project.
title: TEAMS-13529: Retrieve correct post count for articles tab

# Summary

This is for [SCALE-161](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/SCALE-161).

This PR adds the ability to import exported ForYou messages to the exporter tool. 

Following ForYou types currently aren't being imported:
* Tags related ForYou's like SME assignments. 
  * This is because we don't have the old id's for Tags as they are exported as string only.
* Communities related ForYou's
  * This is because we don't have DI for modules implemented in the SO.Setup project. Not sure if it's worth implementing this as part of this PR or not
* Content Health ForYou's for unhealthy posts.
  * This is waiting for https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/21540 to be merged.

# How to Test

1. Download Pickles data with `forExport=true` to get a broad import sample.
   * Go to the [Account information page on Pickles](https://stackoverflowteams.com/c/pickles/admin/billing/account).
   * Modify the page html's DOM and add `?forExport=true` to the form's action url so it looks like: `/c/pickles/admin/download-data?forExport=true`. Then click on the download data button.
2. I tested by nuking my `EnterpriseDev` network locally and loading the team data there, not sure if there's an easier way. But to do that you can run:
   a. `cd C:\Code\StackOverflow\utils\StackOverflow.Setup\bin`
   b. `.\StackOverflow.Setup.exe network remove EnterpriseDev` (Warning: this will nuke your local SOE environment!)
   c. `.\StackOverflow.Setup.exe network new EnterpriseDev` Creates fresh empty db's
   d. You'll need to login to your fresh local SOE environment before you can import: https://stackenterprise.local/
3. Run the importer, pointing to your local SOE db's: 
    ```
     .\StackOverflow.Setup.exe data import C:/pickles.zip -sitesConnection "Data Source=localhost;Initial Catalog=Local.Enterprise.Sites.Teams;Integrated Security=True" -dataHost stackoverflowteams.com/c/pickles -threads 1 -deploymentEnvironment Local.Enterprise
    ```
4. Import should be successful. You can impersonate an imported user such as `/users/impersonate/1` and look at that user's ForYou's which should exist now.

[SCALE-161]: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/SCALE-161?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

author: marradoss
body:
# Summary

Soo, this is a replacement for [this PR](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/21480) (though it may take longer to review, so both stay open). It's a proper fix to a bug that occurs cause some users are created as mods without a corresponding user history entry.

For past mods: we look through user history and select those mods, whose history starts with an end of their tenure. Those are people who were created as mods without the historical entry. We add an entry for them.

For current mods: we look through current mods that were not found through user history and add an entry for them. 
We could expand our basic query to include them there, but that would make the query even less readable and introduce a lot of duplicate entries. Our cleanup method would fix it, buuut maintaining that code is hard enough as is. I think that adding one more db query to our cheduled route is not a big problem.
title: Mod history old users proper fix

author: aalear
body:
CE-642. This is a follow-up to https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/17235 in which I missed the fact that the Suggested Edits queue has its own Razor view and therefore it wasn't covered by the original fix.

This turned into a bit of an adventure as I noticed some inconsistencies in how we handle DMCA locks. 

# Summary of changes 
- The Suggested Edits queue no longer happily shows content diffs for DMCA-locked posts.
- When a DMCA lock is applied to a question, it's also implicitly applied to all of the question's answers. This means that we have to check whether the parent is locked when we're evaluating the state of a specific answer. This is easy to miss, so these checks are now replaced by a more declarative `MustOverrideBodyDueToDmcaLock()`.
- `ShowArticle` views now also support hiding content if the article has been taken down due to DMCA. Additionally, when viewing article revisions, we are no longer saying "this question was taken down...".

> [!NOTE]
> There are a few places where we do multiple queries to look up latest post histories of various types related to DMCA locks. These could be replaced by Dapper queries ([example](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/20168/commits/eae079f58fccf215c90e34dd712db81ab2a4ea96)), but there's a scary comment about query plans within `GetLatestHistory()` and I'm already going way far afield with this PR, so I'm leaving those in place.

# Testing

I set up two posts with a DMCA lock in the PR environment: 
- https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/questions/44/how-do-i-rename-a-local-git-branch
- https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/questions/46/why-does-html-think-chucknorris-is-a-color/212#212

## Developer-only and post owner

1. [Impersonate the developer user](https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/impersonate/1) and visit those links to verify that you, as an employee, are able to see the full content of the posts.
2. Visit the review queue tasks and verify the same:
   - https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/review/suggested-edits/2
   - https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/review/suggested-edits/4
   - https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/review/first-questions/3?isRefreshing=true
   - https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/review/first-answers/5?isRefreshing=true
3. [Impersonate the post owner](https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/impersonate/7) and repeat the two steps above.

## Everyone else
1. [Impersonate Moderator Marion](https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/users/3/moderator-marion)
2. Repeat the steps above but this time verify that the body of the post is redacted and replaces with a "This answer was removed due to a DMCA takedown and is therefore not shown." message.
3. On https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/review/suggested-edits/2, verify that the answers on the Answers tab all say "This answer was removed due to a DMCA takedown on the parent question and is therefore not shown."
4. On https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/review/suggested-edits/4, verify that the answers on the Answers tab are visible as normal.
5. Repeat the realtime reload test from #17235 to ensure no regression: from [a DMCA-locked question](https://20168.stackoverflow.cloud/questions/44/how-do-i-rename-a-local-git-branch), execute `StackExchange.realtime.reloadPosts($('.question, .answer').toArray().map((el) => $(el).data('questionid') || $(el).data('answerid')))` from the browser console and verify that the post body is still replaced with the DMCA takedown notice.
title: CE-642 Suppress DMCA content in the suggested edits queue

author: aalear
body:
We had a situation in `load-test` where the AEH connection string wasn't configured properly and attempts to establish connection were failing. This didn't present in an obvious way, however. The QA team noticed that posting answers was taking a long time, followed by a generic error, but the answer itself was posted correctly.

The culprit was the thread-blocking attempt to send `question.answered` to AEH. This PR removes the "sync over async" implementation and replaces it with actual async.

### Testing

Tested in `ascn-dev` by using a wrong AEH credential. Posting an answer worked just fine and Datadog logged the failed call with the same message as we were seeing in `load-test`:

> An exception occurred while enqueuing events to be published buffered producer instance with identifier 'db6706ea-3c3f-4fbe-b396-e0d23fc22c56' to Event Hub: evh-dev-pubplat (Requested Partition Id/Key: '155160'), Operation Id: '6801f07c-299f-47da-994c-d9088ca99a21'. Error Message: 'The buffered producer took too long to start. (evh-dev-pubplat).  For troubleshooting information, see https://aka.ms/azsdk/net/eventhubs/exceptions/troubleshoot'
title: PRODPLAT-246 Don't thread-block for question.answered to be sent to AEH

author: kylejrp
body:
KRAKEN-2273

## Summary

I made an assumption in #24376 that was critically wrong: I thought that the behavior of encoding tags in a URL was to use `+` for spaces, and `%2b` for any `+` in the original tag. For example, `c++ or java` would get encoded as `c%2b%2b+or%2bjava`. It looked like the current iteration of the code was doing it _wrong_: namely, it was encoding as `c%2b%2b%20or%20java`, with `%20` instead of `+` for the spaces. This seemed wrong, so I fixed it!

Turns out, this _definitely doesn't work_. If you do a search like `[c++23] or [c++17]`, it gets converted to `c%2b%2b23+or+c%2b%2b17`, which went sent to our server, gets sent as `c++23+or+c++17` and then decoded as `c  23 or c  17`. This resulted in the tag search `[c++23] or [c++17]` going to `/questions/tagged/c%2b%2b23+or+c%2b%2b17` which would get read as `c++23+or+c++17` and then converted to the tag search [c][23] or [c][17]. Whoops!

This PR reverts anything that touched space encoding as `+` instead of the proper `%20`. 

## How to Test

1. Search for `[c++]`. You should be brought to `/questions/tagged/c%2b%2b`.
2. Search for `[c++23] or [c++17]`. You should be brought to `/questions/tagged/c%2b%2b17%20or%20c%2b%2b23`.
3. Try changing the search filters or sort tab on either query. You should be brought to a valid search still.
title: KRAKEN-2273 Fix tags encoding with `+` instead of `%20`

author: kylejrp
body:
## Summary

#24229 introduced a fix to a bug introduced by #24152:
- The latter introduced schema.org microdata to Question lists
- The former fixed an issue with double borders showing up

However, this doesn't work on Enterprise, because there the /questions page uses `UpvoteBookmarkPostSummary.cshtml` instead of the bare `PostSummary.cshtml`. I'd argue that `UpvoteBookmarkPostSummary.cshtml` is probably semantically incorrect from a Stacks styling perspective - it puts a `.s-post-summary` _inside_ another `.s-post-summary`, mixing up the expected markup. That functionality introduced by `UpvoteBookmarkPostSummary.cshtml` should probably instead just be features added to `PostSummary.cshtml` so they share a parent `.s-post-summary` - but oh well, this will have to do for now!

My solution:
- Change the selector in 99_TagPreferences.ts to explicitly look for `[itemprop='itemListElement']` instead of the more generic `[itemscope],[itemtype],[itemprop]` which was capturing the parent questions div before.
- Add a `HideExtraBordersAddedBySchemaMetadata` property to be used by `UpvoteBookmarkPostSummary.cshtml` to avoid a display issue where some (but not all) of the post summary would have a doubled border

## How to Test

1. Go to `/questions` on PubPlat. On the right sidebar, add a tag to the ignored tag list and make sure that both "Hide questions in your ignored tags" and "Gray out questions in your ignored tags" work as expected. (Only hides relevant tags, no doubled borders)
2. Do the same for `/questions` on Enterprise (no clue how to do this, need help from an Enterprise dev here)
title: TEAMS-15036 Fix ignored tags hiding too much on Enterprise

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
Yesterday @aalear found out a bunch of [NREs](https://opserver.main-prod.int.gcp.stackoverflow.net/exceptions/detail?id=4b060b51-9ac0-4e53-b3da-6bf157fcab7d&log=Q%26A&store=) in Pubplat's opserver.

The reason is that when trying to send an RepChangedEvent in the `ProductEventsDispatch.UserReputationChangedAsync` handler `Current.Context.TryGetService` method relies on an [HttpContext to exist](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/857500d16180695655ce6f83f594a6036806d564/StackOverflow.Common/ModuleIntegration/CurrentContextServiceExtensions.cs#L20), which in the case of AppServices it doesn't, so it return null, generating the NRE. 

This PR implements a static `ServiceLocator` class, which gets initialized during app startup (after DI is set wired up), and it holds an instance of `IServiceProvider`. Then in any place, with an HttpContext or not, we can just access the `IServiceProvider` instace by calling `ServiceLocator.Instance`. 

This is not a new concept, this is something that AppServices already had to deal with. However, in that case, the appservices are receiving an instance of `IServiceProvider` on the `RegisterAndStart` [method](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/857500d16180695655ce6f83f594a6036806d564/StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/Services/AppServices.cs#L60), which they hold during the lifetime of the application, so they can resolve services. The solution introduced here is the same concept but generally accessible so it can be used for example in event handlers.
title: PRODPLAT-103 Make IServiceProvider generally available

author: kylejrp
body:
KRAKEN-2273

## Summary

https://meta.stackexchange.com/questions/414857/doing-a-tag-search-and-changing-the-sorting-via-the-navigation-buttons-breaks-qu
https://meta.stackoverflow.com/questions/436570/tags-mangled-in-page-links

This pull request fixes a few bugs:
- Spaces were being encoded as "%20" instead of "+"
- Canonical tag ordering incorrectly was being applied to "and", "or", and "not" operators.
- The canonical URL for /questions/tagged/{tagQuery} was being set in two different places with two different methods
- We were doing canonical ordering even in cases where we explicitly didn't want to order them (saved tag queries, watched tag lists)

**Canonical URL Generation Logic:**

* Updated `UserQuestionList.GetCanonicalUrl` and its underlying helpers to accept a `canRenderInvalidAndNoncanonicalQueries` parameter, allowing the caller to specify when non-canonical tag queries are acceptable. This prevents canonical URLs from being generated for user saved lists or watched tag lists. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-2afd713cb728e6646571140eeb138f073feb361a14a6f659d9259049583aca4dL383-R392) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-2afd713cb728e6646571140eeb138f073feb361a14a6f659d9259049583aca4dL269-R270) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-2afd713cb728e6646571140eeb138f073feb361a14a6f659d9259049583aca4dL281-R285) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-2afd713cb728e6646571140eeb138f073feb361a14a6f659d9259049583aca4dL395-R404)

* Modified the logic in `QuestionsController.List.cs` and related view code to use the new canonical URL generation rules, ensuring that only simple tag queries result in a canonical URL being set. Complex queries and wildcards are handled appropriately. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-fd94ed01c25621c39410de2fb1e3f8b65c867ce0159564fff5d4a2f5ef5e50a4L25-R52) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-fd94ed01c25621c39410de2fb1e3f8b65c867ce0159564fff5d4a2f5ef5e50a4L136-R162) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-fd94ed01c25621c39410de2fb1e3f8b65c867ce0159564fff5d4a2f5ef5e50a4L334-R353) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-fd94ed01c25621c39410de2fb1e3f8b65c867ce0159564fff5d4a2f5ef5e50a4L486-R505) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-f67d88dc7e37838970dfcd737514f43e6cd4c3130caefbf073409a577ce38f84L44-L59)

**Tag Encoding and URL Formatting:**

* Adjusted `Tag.TagUrlEncode` to no longer replace `+` with `%20`, aligning tag encoding with the new canonical URL logic and expectations for tag query formatting.

**Integration Tests:**

* Updated and expanded integration tests in `UserQuestionListTests` to reflect the new canonical URL logic, including new test cases for tag queries with operators and ensuring correct URL formatting in all scenarios. author: dionrhys
body:
`BaseScheduledController` currently has a few `high` severity CodeQL "Uncontrolled format string" alerts:

- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/security/code-scanning/816
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/security/code-scanning/815
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/security/code-scanning/814
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/security/code-scanning/813
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/security/code-scanning/812
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/security/code-scanning/811
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/security/code-scanning/810
- https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/security/code-scanning/809

These are alerting because the `IScheduledLog` method implementations on the `BaseScheduledController` are using uncontrolled format strings and are also being treated as valid ASP.NET Core controller actions.

These alerts are valid because ASP.NET Core [does](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/mvc/controllers/actions?view=aspnetcore-9.0#defining-actions) consider these methods to be valid controller actions:

> Public methods on a controller, except those with the `[NonAction]` attribute, are actions.

Here's the CodeQL [source code](https://github.com/github/codeql/blob/958d209a8152eaca3bebe0f23a93befa45791a5d/csharp/ql/lib/semmle/code/csharp/frameworks/microsoft/AspNetCore.qll#L225-L231) that flags these methods up as being controller actions:

> ```qll
> /** Gets an action method for this controller. */
> Method getAnActionMethod() {
>   result = this.getAMethod() and
>   result.isPublic() and
>   not result.isStatic() and
>   not result.getAnAttribute() instanceof MicrosoftAspNetCoreMvcNonActionAttribute
> }
> ```

No route attributes are on these methods and no conventional routes are set up on startup to route to these, however it's still best practice to mark any public instance method in a controller as `[NonAction]` when they should never be treated as controller actions.
title: Fix BaseScheduledController CodeQL alerts

author: juanrodriguezcen
body: We already had a "monolith internal event" for reputation changed which is triggered from every spot where user reputation changes. However, this event is in process only, so in order to make it available for the Customer Engagement Service, we need to send it to AEH as a product event. This PR creates a new event handler for `EventTypes.UserReputationChanged` with the sole purpose of sending this internal event to AEH for external services to consume. I believe this is a pattern that we can use to lower the bar for moving towards a more event based architecture. Using the internal events infrastructure that we already have in place, product teams can build or refactor features in the monolith (i.e. in a module) that communicate with the rest of the monolith via internal events as a cheaper way of shipping feature. This creates a seam in the monolith that allows for an easy split in the future. If that logic wants to be moved into a separate service, we create the service and in the monolith we just need to add a new internal event handler that emitts the corresponding product event to AEH, in the same way that this PR does. ## How to test Pick a question an upvote it, then using the `/developer/product-events` you should see that there is a product event of type `user.reputation_changed`
title: PRODPLAT-103 Emit rep changed product event

author: kylejrp
body:
## Summary

This PR reverts #24343 (reverts just the sitemap bits, not the trailing slash redirect bits) so that the improved sitemap generation from #24292 is back. This time, we've added optimizations to how question sitemap pages are generated so that we no longer experience [timeouts in production for Stack Overflow](https://opserver.main-prod.int.gcp.stackoverflow.net/exceptions?similar=1bd93c9d-f678-4332-ba5b-a423ef644d9f&log=Q%26A). This fixes KRAKEN-2567.

This also completely solves pagination instability for the question sitemaps. We've switched pagination from an `OFFSET/FETCH` strategy to a fixed `startId, endId` strategy. This means that some `sitemap-questions-{index}.xml` files will have less than 50,000 entries because some questions will get filtered out. However, questions won't move between pages anymore as they're closed/migrated/deleted/etc. This fixes KRAKEN-2569.

One inaccuracy with the new siteMapCount query for questions is that it finds the `MAX(Id)` using only the indexed filters. This means that we _could_ be finding the `MAX(Id)` of a post where it would be filtered away in the actual `sitemap-questions-{index}.xml` file. In practice, Questions are dense enough data that this shouldn't matter, and worst case we get a final `sitemap-questions-{index}.xml` page that is empty and thus 404s. I don't expect this to come up often, if ever.

@AaronBertrand helped me evaluate the updated queries in production. (Thanks for the assist! 🎉)

### Performance of `sitemap.xml` siteMapCount query

The previous query used `COUNT(*)` on the filtered posts, which resulted in a 1s query that 1mil+ reads. The new query uses a `MAX(Id)`, ignoring some of the non-indexed filters, which resulted in a 0ms query with 4 reads. 🤣 

| Strategy | Duration | CPU | Reads |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `COUNT(*)` | 1,184 | 6,755 | 1,392,551 |
| `MAX(Id)` | 0 | 0 | 4 |

### Performance of `sitemap-questions-{index}.xml` query

The original query before #24292 had an inaccurate strategy, but had okay performance (~300ms to ~2000ms). The updated query in #24292 was more accurate, but had really bad performance because if failed to utilize the index, especially on high pages (~400ms to ~7800ms). The final query introduced in this PR is accurate _and_ has fantastic performance, even on high pages (~50ms to ~55ms).

#### First page query

| Strategy | Duration | CPU | Reads |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Original | 283 | 279 | 213,270 |
| Accurate, but without index utilization | 389 | 384 | 294,672 |
| Accurate, but with index utilization and fixed pagination | 49 | 49 | 11,211 |

#### Large page query

| Strategy | Duration | CPU | Reads |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Original | 2,023 | 1,272 | 356,508 |
| Accurate, but without index utilization | 7,826 | 6,933 | 2,250,879 |
| Accurate, but with index utilization and fixed pagination | 56 | 226 | 13,057 |


## How to Test

- Visit https://meta.stackexchange.local/sitemap.xml?manualBypassCache=true and make sure it loads
- Visit https://meta.stackexchange.local/sitemap-questions-0.xml?size=50000 and https://meta.stackexchange.local/sitemap-questions-1.xml?size=50000 and make sure they both load. (We don't have enough data locally to test this reasonably - but the above tests against production Stack Overflow show that the queries perform as expected)
title: KRAKEN-2567 KRAKEN-2569 Revert #24343, optimize question sitemap generation

author: kylejrp
body:
KRAKEN-2567
KRAKEN-2271

## Summary

This PR reverts #24292 as it's [causing timeouts in production](https://opserver.main-prod.int.gcp.stackoverflow.net/exceptions?similar=1bd93c9d-f678-4332-ba5b-a423ef644d9f&log=Q%26A). The changes introduced made it stop using the `ix_PostTypeId_DeletionDate_LastActivityDate_Include` index underneath. A future PR will update the index to include the extra fields or take some other optimization step.

This PR also changes the site setting for trailing slash redirects introduced in #24191 to be a `[GlobalOnly]` site setting. This too was [causing exceptions](https://us3.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Astackoverflow%20env%3Aprod%20product%3Apubplat%20%22no%20site%20found%22&agg_m=count&agg_m_source=base&agg_t=count&cols=host%2Cservice&event=AwAAAZqD65rWjX-WtwAAABhBWnFENjZNc0FBRE9HZzBKU3J0RVpnQ24AAAAkZjE5YTgzZWItYmYwYi00ZTczLWIxZTItMzRmOWQwN2E4YzA3AAAYSg&fromUser=true&messageDisplay=inline&refresh_mode=sliding&storage=hot&stream_sort=desc&viz=stream&from_ts=1763148707397&to_ts=1763149607397&live=true) - it's possible to make a HTTP query to a Stack Exchange site that doesn't exist, and thus `Current.Site` won't exist. For example, `https://asdf.stackexchange.com/`.

## How to Test

1. Visit https://meta.stackexchange.local/sitemap.xml?manualBypassCache=true and make sure it loads
2. Visit https://meta.stackexchange.local/sitemap-questions-0.xml?size=50000 and make sure it loads. (It wasn't timing out locally, so we can't reproduce that behavior though.)
3. Visit https://meta.stackexchange.local/questions/ and make sure you're redirected to https://meta.stackexchange.local/questions without any exceptions showing in https://meta.stackexchange.local/admin/errors (other than the developer-only `Remove the trailing slash from this URL so that we don't have an unnecessary redirect`)

author: shiyaoli-1
body:
This PR adds developer route to send the AI Assist notifications.

**User selection criteria:**
Stack Overflow registered users who have accessed the site within the last year. [Slack convo](https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/C05U5BB3YQN/p1763061992321489)
[Prod query](https://dataexplorer-local.main-prod.int.gcp.stackoverflow.net/stackoverflow/query/40046?opt.bypassCache=true): around 6 million users.

**Testing:**
I used the `NetworkUsers` table in the `Sites` db instead of the `Users` table. I have about 500 users in my local `NetworkUsers`. Depending on how many you have, you may need to change the query params' values.

`userBatchSize` is how many users we're processing during this run.
`notifBatchSize` is how many notifications we're sending at a time for the processed users using `BatchNotificationAsync`.
`isLocalTesting` sets `SiteId` to 4 (Meta StackExchange) and `AccountTypeId` to 6 (developer). it's only because I have more users locally this way. You may not need to set it.
`testAccId` is a single account Id you can pass to send one notification to a specific person. This is for testing purpose only. If you set this param, the route returns immediately after the single one is sent.

Run the following route to send all notifications.
https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/notify-ai-assist?userBatchSize=1000&notifBatchSize=10&isLocalTesting=true

Run the following route to send one notification.
https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/notify-ai-assist?testAccId={testAccId}

author: dusanrad
body:
## Summary

This PR adds InternalApi project and corresponding integration tests. Internal api project is meant to be used as a data access layer for project SHINE. This is the first draft of the project and things might change during review. At the very least `fake-auth-service` should not be merged.

Project supports jwt token authentication only. Jwt token is required (even for anonymous users) in order to access any endpoint. Data from jwt token are being parsed and hooked into ICurrentContext so that user and site information from the token can be accessed through `ctx.User` and `ctx.Site`. Take a look at the ExampleController.cs for basic examples. Roles from the jwtToken can be used in `[Authorize(Roles = "")]` attributes to limit access to certain roles only.

## Example token:

Project expects a jwt token with a specific payload. Here is one example for the authenticated user

``` json
    {
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/user_type": "moderator",
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/site_id": "4",
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/site_base_host": "meta.stackexchange.local",
        "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/role": [
            "Employee",
            "Developer",
            "Moderator"
        ],
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/user_id": "883380",
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/display_name": "Dusan Radovanovic",
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/account_id": "19934330",
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/account_type": "Developer",
        "exp": 1763941057,
        "iss": "https://stackenterprise.local",
        "aud": "https://stackenterprise.local"
    }
```

This is an example for an anonymous user:
``` json
    {
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/user_type": "anonymous",
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/site_id": "4",
        "https://stackoverflow.com/claims/site_base_host": "meta.stackexchange.local",
        "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/role": "Anonymous",
        "exp": 1763959659,
        "iss": "meta.stackexchange.local",
        "aud": "meta.stackexchange.local"
    }
```

## Performance considerations

Since this is planned to be used on a main site (and other network sites) performance is critical. For that reason I tried to avoid any unnecessary DB queries. Unlike our other APIs, InternalApi will blindly trust payload from the jwt token (as long as we can verify the validity of the token) and will not load up user from the database. User will only be loaded once the `ctx.User` is being accessed. `ctx.Site` is being picked from the pre-loaded list (cached in memory). So accessing simple routes like '/stacky' that do not have any DB calls will result in zero DB queries total. Similarly we blindly trust roles from the jwt token when matching against `[Authorize(Roles = "")]` attribute and make no db calls for that. The goal here is that the only SQL/Redis/Elastic calls that will be made are the ones being made from within the endpoint - no hidden cost.

## How to Test
- Use https://github.com/StackEng/DevLocalSetup/pull/406 in DevLocalSetup project to setup the website.
- Use `fake-auth-service` to get a jwt token: Issue a GET request to `meta.stackexchange.local/fake-auth-service?userId=USER_ID&siteName=SITE_BASE_URL`. For instance https://meta.stackexchange.local/fake-auth-service?userId=883380&siteName=meta.stackexchange.local. There is no challenge here, you can impersonate anyone with this route. You will need to be logged as a developer in order to use this route.
- Route will return both jwtToken as well as unencoded payload (used for testing). You can use jwtToken in subsequent calls.
- Make a GET call to `api-internal.local/stacky` with the token and ensure you get back stacky ASCII art with the Internal API banner.
- Make a GET call to `api-internal.local/example/whoami` and verify that the response contains info for the user that was being impersonated.

## Missing in the PR
- PR environment setup
- Deployment pipeline
- Token validation though use of `AddJwtBearer()` method
title: [KRAKEN-2520] Added InternalApi project and integration tests

author: qheaden-stack
body:
## Summary

This PR updates the monolith code to work with the updated response schema of the Databricks ML model for spam evaluation. The model now returns the model version string in the format `<year>.<month>.<day>.<hour>.<minute>` as part of the response object.

The changes update the C# model objects and their mapping to the response JSON, and updates to the saving of the model version in the JSON of the spam evaluation post history record.

## How to Test

Note: This must be tested locally since you need to update the environment settings file to point to the new Databricks model URL since the updated model hasn't been made default yet.

1) Open `StackOverflow.Common/environmentsettings.Local.Public.json` and change the `ModelEndpoint` property under the `MLSpamDetection` object to the following URL: `https://adb-3938166729385722.2.azuredatabricks.net/serving-endpoints/mod-tooling-spam-detection/served-models/mod-tooling-spam-detection-vnext/invocations`
2) Rebuild the code and post any question or answer
3) Visit the post history of the post you just made and ensure the spam evaluation record is there
4) Ensure the model version is included on the spam evaluation information shown
title: [MOD-292] - Log ML model version in spam evaluation post history

body:
JIRA: [YETI2-861](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/YETI2-861?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiMTY0YWJjMzQ2NmE5NDBjYTk1N2JhNDE0YjdhNWEzOWYiLCJwIjoiaiJ9)

## Summary

This PR adds a new query parameter `TagName` and removes the `TagId` parameter from DL API. The new query parameter is added to the `/questions` endpoint only and can take up to 5 tag names. Note that it does not verify if it's a valid/existing tag name so if you add 6 tag names but one of them is invalid(i.e. now you have 5 valid tag names), you will still get a 400 with a message similar to below:

```
{
    "errors": {
        "TagName": [
            "The field TagName must be a string or array type with a maximum length of '5'."
        ]
    },
    "type": "https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9110#section-15.5.1",
    "title": "One or more validation errors occurred.",
    "status": 400,
    "traceId": "00-e6d5492a0493203736ba5cdf9ca88102-c62ac51cf131f473-00"
}
```

## How to Test
Helpful Tags
`support` - ID 575
`bug` - ID 1

**Get questions from database**
1. Make sure site setting [Api.APIv3_UseElastic_ForQuestions](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_UseElastic_ForQuestions) is set to False
2. Use Postman to get questions
3. Make a request using the `TagId` parameter > request should go through but doesn't filter by `TagId`. You will get the same result with/without it.
4. Make a request with one `TagName` value > should get a 200 > save the response (count especially) to compare with elastic result
5. Add 4 more tag names and make it 5 total > make a request > should get a 200 > save the response (count especially) to compare with elastic result
6. Add a 6th tag name > should get a 400 with error message "The field TagName must be a string or array type with a maximum length of '5'."

**Get questions using elastic**
1. Make sure site setting [Api.APIv3_UseElastic_ForQuestions](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_UseElastic_ForQuestions) is set to True
2. Use Postman to get questions
3. Make a request using the `TagId` parameter > request should go through but doesn't filter by `TagId`. You will get the same result with/without it.
4. Make a request with one `TagName` value > should get a 200 > save the response (count especially) to compare with elastic result
5. Compare it to the db response > should match
6. Add 4 more tag names and make it 5 total > make a request > should get a 200
7. Compare it to the db response > should match
8. Add a 6th tag name > should get a 400 with error message "The field TagName must be a string or array type with a maximum length of '5'."

**API v3 (both PubPlat and Teams&Enterprise**
Go to Swagger and make sure `TagId` parameter is still visible in Swagger and it can be used counts should match DL API if you are using the same tags.

## Summary

On OBC thumbs voting a user could vote, click a link on the page then using the browser back button, return to the page and keep casting votes like this. This PR adds in backend and front end defences. In the backend each time the vote endpoint is hit a check for an existing vote runs and rejects the vote if one is found. In the front-end, the thumbs voting component is refreshed each time the page is loaded and by disabling caching, even if they return to the page through the back button, the component is always refreshed.

1. Enable OBC
2. Create OBC with some answers
3. As different user follow steps on [this meta post](https://meta.stackoverflow.com/questions/435293/opinion-based-questions-alpha-experiment-on-stack-overflow/436494#436494) to attempt to cast more than one vote on a question or answer
