author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
StackOverflow's helm chart creates the sql externalsecret with the following annotation so it's available to the sql migrations job which runs as a helm hook:

```
"helm.sh/hook": pre-install,pre-upgrade
"helm.sh/hook-weight": "-5"
```

We don't run SQL migrations as part of the StackOverflow helm upgrade, we do that separately as part of the cluster actions pre-deploy run. Also, resources created by helm hooks are recreated on each run, so each time that we deploy the StackOverflow application, the externalsecret is created and we wait for almost 2 minutes for the secret to sync from KV. 

The StackOverflow application helm chart already supports creating the external secret without those annotations, not tied to a helm hook. All we need to do is to set `sqlExternalSecret.enableHooks = true`

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Resources that have the `helm.sh/hook` are created for hooks and are not managed by Helm deployments. If we just remove the annotation, the StackOverflow's helm deployment will try to create an External secret with the same name associated with the deployment, but it'll get an error because another external secret already exists with that name (the one created by the last time the hook ran). This is why I had to rename the external secret so a new one can be created. After this one is created on every tenant, we can delete the old one from every tenant and rename it back (or just leave it as is).
title: PRODPLAT-163 Remove hook annotations from StackOverflow sql secret in SOE

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
Small change to use interpolation instead of variables for `PostState` and `PostTypeId` in `PostQueryBuilder.cs`. This change allows SQL to more likely make use of filtered indexes potentially improving performance.

Queries without interpolation, note that `PostState` and `PostTypeId` are passed as variables
```
exec sp_executesql N'SELECT P.* , U.* , LastEditorUser.* , PostMetadata.ViewCount
 FROM Posts P /* Helpers\PostQueryBuilder.cs@500 */ 
LEFT JOIN Users U ON U.Id = P.OwnerUserId
LEFT JOIN Users LastEditorUser ON LastEditorUser.Id = P.LastEditorUserId
LEFT JOIN PostMetadata ON PostMetadata.PostId = P.Id
WHERE P.PostTypeId = @PostType AND P.DeletionDate IS NULL AND P.PostState = @State
ORDER BY ISNULL(P.LastActivityDate, P.CreationDate) Desc
OFFSET @start ROWS
FETCH NEXT @size ROWS ONLY
',N'@PostType tinyint,@State tinyint,@start int,@size int',@PostType=1,@State=1,@start=0,@size=30

exec sp_executesql N'SELECT COUNT(*)
 FROM Posts P /* Helpers\PostQueryBuilder.cs@495 */ 
WHERE P.PostTypeId = @PostType AND P.DeletionDate IS NULL AND P.PostState = @State
',N'@PostType tinyint,@State tinyint',@PostType=1,@State=1
```

Queries with interpolation
```
exec sp_executesql N'SELECT P.* , U.* , LastEditorUser.* , PostMetadata.ViewCount
 FROM Posts P /* Helpers\PostQueryBuilder.cs@500 */ 
LEFT JOIN Users U ON U.Id = P.OwnerUserId
LEFT JOIN Users LastEditorUser ON LastEditorUser.Id = P.LastEditorUserId
LEFT JOIN PostMetadata ON PostMetadata.PostId = P.Id
WHERE P.PostTypeId = 1 AND P.DeletionDate IS NULL AND P.PostState = 1
ORDER BY ISNULL(P.LastActivityDate, P.CreationDate) Desc
OFFSET @start ROWS
FETCH NEXT @size ROWS ONLY
',N'@start int,@size int',@start=0,@size=30


SELECT COUNT(*)
 FROM Posts P /* Helpers\PostQueryBuilder.cs@495 */ 
WHERE P.PostTypeId = 1 AND P.DeletionDate IS NULL AND P.PostState = 1
```

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
We are lowering the CPU limit for Tagserver in SOE, and the app sees the CPU as 1. This breaks the CPU reservation feature that Tagserver implements. 

This CPU affinity feature for Tagserver is presumably to take advantage of CPU caches, although this is a low level optimization that is most definitely not needed in SOE (very low load), and that probably no longer makes sense in K8s. 

This PR sets TAGSERVER__PROCESSORSTORESERVE to 0, telling Tagserver to don't reserve any CPU.

## Summary

Right then, get ready for some highly contentious hacky nonsense 😅 

This approach is based on the concept of adding a dropdown to Ask V2, which is able to switch the form to an opinion-based version of V3, which, in the interests of sheer confusion, I'm calling V2.5.

Changing the 'type' dropdown added to V2 reloads the page with an `obc` search param, where '0' indicates troubleshooting, whilst '1', '2' and '3' are the opinion-based options.

When an opinion-based option is selected, this is detected by the view and we:
- inject the V3 island set to 'opinion-based mode'
  - all this means is that the island loads a lighter version of the form, with a load of stuff ripped out
- we switch out the sidebar stuff for Whit's copy (this moves above on mobile)
- hide the normal submit button at the bottom of V2

**Considerations**

- We don't want the user to lose everything they've added to the form when changing type! It's entirely possible somebody will get halfway though and go 'you know what, this is actually a best practices question'
  - Currently this solution leans on the 'draft' functionality which we appear to be getting for free from both V2 and V3, so many thanks (and well done) to everybody who worked on those 😆

## Summary

This PR introduces a create and edit page for the new Challenges module. It adds the relevant methods to the module's Challenges Service as well as adding a new `ModuleChallengeService` that interacts with the monolith. 

### Service refactors

While writing the `ModuleChallengeService`, it was noticed that the tag sanitizing logic was duplicated across several services. Thus, we've made a new `ITagSanitizerEncoder` that's used in `ModuleChallengeService` as well as `CollectiveCollectionService` and `ColleciveDiscussionService`. This refactor was a bit painful because these services weren't being grabbed from the DI container but rather being `new`'d up everywhere. So, this refactoring correctly wires up all of the dependencies to be injected where possible.

### StackOverflow.Common changes

We added a `Challenge.cs` file and wired it up to the `DBContext`. We added `PostHistoryTypeIds` for each of the Challenge-specific fields. We refactored a lot of `Post` checks into `CanHaveComments`, `CanHaveTitle`, `CanHaveInitialTitle`, `CanHaveTags`, `CanHaveInitialTags`, `CanHavePostMetadata`. We added link rendering for Challenge posts. We added support to the revision history rendering for all the new challenge `PostHistoryTypeId` we added. We added checks to `HasEditRights` and `CanViewPostRevisions` to support Challenges. We added a redirect for edits to Challenges to go to the module route. 

### Create and edit form limitations

Since this form is limited to employees only, it's not got the best UI. There's no tag editor wired up yet and the rest of the fields are pretty barebones and not user-friendly. It's okay for now but would need to be improved if we want to scale up challenges.

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
[Jira: YETI2-764](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/YETI2-764)

This PR adds a cursor pagination endpoint for questions `/questions/beta/cursor`. A user can traverse forwards and backwards by using the `after` and `before` query parameters. At this time, users can only sort by ID. Most filters aside from `creationFrom,` `creationTo`, `isAnswered` and `hasAcceptedAnswer` have also been removed. 

This endpoint differs from `/questions` in that users use a cursor (pointer) to traverse a set of results rather than pages. Clients cannot jump to "pages" and can only move forward and backward. Cursor pagination only works when the item we are sorting/filtering on is unique such as ID or a pairing of LastActivityDate and ID. If an optimal index exists, then SQL queries using cursors are significantly faster than offset based pagination, especially in later pages. In events when an optimal index does not exist, it can be even slower than offset based pagination. For this reason, new sorts must not be added until testing has been done in SQL with the proposed sort. This testing should factor in the middle and end of a dataset with the proposed sort. 

**Overall Design**
I designed with the intent to make it easy for us to additional sorts in the future. While we are starting with an integer sort, it should be relatively easy to add sorts based on other types like date time. The `PostQueryBuilder` portion should make it easier to add a new endpoint that paginates through answers or other post types. 

Originally, I intended this endpoint to take a single `cursor` parameter. But I found it difficult to implement the previous functionality with it. Doing so would have required encoding more information into the cursor which was one of the most difficult parts of this work. I looked at paginating endpoints from big data APIs and noticed they all used two query parameters to support moving forward and backward. This allows us to issue a single SQL query (excluding any other queries to populate the response model) to get the page of results and create both pointers/cursors with the results of that single query. Alternatives, include issuing a second query to derive the previous cursor which I wanted to avoid.

The query parameter names for traversing forward and backward are `after` and `before` as those appear to be more frequently used than `next` and `previous`.

**Cursor Design**
I found this one of the more difficult things to implement. Cursors should be opaque and store minimal information, primarily only the location of where to start sorting on. They should not dictate the sort, order or limit of a request, that information should be transparent in the URL of the request. For example, a link can be shared to a friend and the sort/order/limit are visible in the link.

It is up to the client to maintain the sort and order between requests. We could add validation to prevent client's from changing these parameters midway but 1) it makes the endpoint feel clunky since sort and order become non-functional when a cursor is passed (the parameters are only functional on the first call) and 2) it will increase the cursor's size and complexity (the less information the better). 

Originally, I went with a custom encoding using "|" as a delimiter and then encoding it into web-safe Base64. After some research with Gemini, it was recommended to use JSON + web-safe Base64 encoding to avoid issues with special characters. For example, the original pattern I went with could not make use of future delimiting characters like ":", "+" or "-" without breaking on datetimes. 

Note these values are encoded and can be decoded so they are not meant to be secret. While they can be decoded, users manually creating cursors should not expect that functionality to be supported.

Changing the cursor's form should be done carefully as it could be a breaking change. The current form allows sorting on multiple types and also supports a tiebreaker ID if needed. For example, a tiebreaker would be used on a Score sort but not required for an ID sort. 

**Inspiration**
- https://docs.stripe.com/api/pagination
- https://docs.x.com/x-api/fundamentals/pagination
- https://developers.facebook.com/docs/threads/retrieve-and-discover-posts 
- https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/queries#search - A GraphQL API with both before and after
- https://docs.slack.dev/apis/web-api/pagination/ - Only appears to allow forward navigation
- https://www.shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/queries/customers

## Tests
About half of this PR is made up of tests. I have added only 2 integration tests since testing pagination requires several items to be created. One test covers the site setting and the other the happy path of paginating forward and backwards.

Unit tests have been added to test the cursors and validation rules in the service layer.

## How to Test
### Pagination
I recommend using Postman to test. I have added the "Get Questions with Cursor" request under the PubPlat API v3 collection that will automatically populate the "after" and "before" query parameters. You will need to manually toggle the "after" and "before" query parameters to move forward or backward.

Note that the `/questions` endpoint does not have an ID sort. However, ID very strongly correlates with CreationDate and you should find the results of both queries to be nearly identical.

**Page Size**
If your results are different, then you may want to turn off the use Elastic site setting so we compare SQL to SQL. https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_UseElastic_ForQuestions
1. Make a request to `/questions/beta/cursor` and make a request to `/questions`. The cursor endpoint will sort by ID. The questions endpoint should sort by Creation. The order should be the same on both. The default limit for both endpoints is 30.
2. Verify the first and last post from each response are equal
3. Repeat this a few times.
   - On my local, page 3 has an instance where there is a question ID with a creationDate that does not align with the surrounding IDs 383242. These leads to slightly different results and is expected.
4. Attempt to use an invalid limit such as 40 and you should receive a 400 status code error.
5. Repeat steps 1-3 with a different limit size such as 15, 50 or 100. (The parameter name in `/questions` is pageSize)

**Filtering**
1. Make a request to `/questions/beta/cursor` with different filtering options (`isAnswered` boolean, `hasAcceptedAnswer` boolean).
2. Scan through the results and confirm that the filter is applied as expected. The result can also be compared against `/questions`.

**First and Last Pages/Traversing Forward and Backward**
1. Make a request to `/questions/beta/cursor`  with the following query parameters to produce 3 "pages" `limit=15&creationTo=2022-11-07&creationFrom=2022-11-01`. Do not include an "after" or "before" query parameter on the first request.
2. On the first request, verify that the previous cursor and URL response properties are null. Next should not be null.
3. Move forward using the "after" query parameter. On the second request, both the previous and next cursor response models should be populated. Take note of the title of the first element.
4. Move forward using the "after" query parameter. On the third request, the next cursor response model will be null. 
5. Move backward using the "before" query parameter. On this request, the title of the element should match the title in step 3.
7. Move backward again to return to the first "page". The result should be the same as step 2. 

**Validation**
1. Attempt to send both a "after" and "before" cursor should result in a 400
2. Attempt to pass in a cursor with an invalid format such as "invalid" should result in a 400

### **Site Setting to Disable Endpoint**
1. Disable the site setting https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_QuestionsCursorPaginationEndpoint_Enabled
2. Make a request to `/questions/beta/cursor` and verify that the status code is a 503 with the message "This endpoint is currently unavailable"

### Data Licensing Apps Cannot Use Endpoint
1. Call /questions/beta/cursor with a DL app, it should return a 503 (https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/api/update-app-type?appIds={appId}&appType=4&dryRun=false
2. Update the app type to regular app (https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/api/update-app-type?appIds={appId}&appType=1&dryRun=false)
3. Call /questions/beta/cursor again, this time it should return a 200 response

### **Teams**
1. Verify the new endpoint or it's schemas does not appear in https://24011-blueshift-api-v3.stackexchange.cloud/swagger/index.html or https://24011-blueshift-api-v3.stackexchange.cloud/swagger.json (I used CTRL+F "cursor")
title: YETI2-764 - Add questions endpoint with cursor based pagination to API v3

author: mukunku
body:
# Summary

It turns out Exceptional uses an outdated jQuery version which InfoSec has flagged for us to update in [SPARK-42](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/SPARK-42). And Exceptional is accessible via `/admin/errors` to SOE admins.

This is not straightforward as [Exceptional](https://github.com/NickCraver/StackExchange.Exceptional) is not owned by us. So instead of trying to update what essentially is a third-party library, the general consensus among the former Scale Pod developers (myself included) and the Support folks is that `/admin/errors` is no longer useful and that DataDog has been the source of truth for exception data since we retired On-Prem SOE. ([Slack thread here](https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/C049EQU3HK3/p1755113629552539?thread_ts=1755007426.994639&cid=C049EQU3HK3))

So this PR disables this route for SOE Prod environments. (Note: SOE Dev environments run in Prod mode as well. So the route will only be accessible locally going forward.)

[SPARK-42]: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/SPARK-42?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ
title: SPARK-42: disable /admin/errors in SOE prod

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
We previously parametrized the request/limits for the different tshirt size definitions. However, we noticed that on big customers (i.e. Microsoft) that weren't migrated to a cell yet, deployments were failing because the requests that we used were too high for the non-cell clusters which use smaller nodes and a limit of 3 nodes per pool.

This PR uses the split that introduced in this deployment-pipelines-variables [PR](https://github.com/StackEng/deployment-pipeline-variables/pull/290) that spilts the tshirt size definitions between the instances that have been migrated to a cell and those who haven't. 

This allows us to tweak requests/limits for cell customers without affecting the instances that haven't ben migrated to a cell yet.
title: PRODPLAT-143 Split tshirt definition

author: aalear
body:
## Summary

We're seeing an issue in prod where static assets are getting old versions of files cached with new cachebreakers. This happens when a user visits the site during a deployment and hits one of the new pods but their `sstatic` requests are routed to one of the old pods that are still active.

This PR adds monitoring and a light mitigation to the issue:

- we want to track mismatches as a DD metric so we can get an idea of the scope of the problem
- if a mismatch is found, we will serve the old version of the file still but with a `no-store` directive to prevent caching.

This does mean that users can still see a broken page, but the issue should resolve itself on a reload once the deployment completes. As new pods spin up, the odds of someone being routed to an old one go down as well.

There is a potential risk here that someone could simply force a redownload of something over and over by making a single minor alteration to the cachebreaker, however that's not meaningfully different from someone making a bunch of requests with _different_ random cachebreakers to achieve the same goal in production today.

## How to Test

Automated tests are included, but this change can also be tested manually in the PR environment: simply pick a static asset on the page and observe response and cache headers and file size depending on whether you are loading with the valid current cachebreaker value or if you manually change it to something else.
title: PRODPLAT-124 Handle cachebreaker mismatches a bit more gracefully

author: aalear
body:
All privileges in SEM1 require at least 10 reputation, so "Test NoRepUser" never earned any despite the single positive rep change of +2 since their last "reputation visited date". No privileges means that the `FirstOrDefault()` call to determine `requiredRepForCurrentPriv` returns 0 and that single rep change passes the check and the date of the rep change is treated as the date of the most recently earned privilege.

This PR fixes this issue by returning early from this method if the user doesn't have any privileges in the first place.
title: TEAMS-14891 Fix edge case in privilege congratulations

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
We recently found out that when we deploy multiple instances in a cell simultaneously, the deployments fail. The reason being that the liveliness check fails because the app doesn’t respond and the pod gets constantly restarted, without ever becoming available and the deployment times out. 

We noticed a node got to 100% CPU usage and that node was hosting all the pods that failed. 

Why is the same node getting all the pods that are being deployed? Because K8s thinks it can handle it due to the low CPU request that we ask for the pods. For each app we request only 20-50m CPU, which is less than 5% of one CPU. During normal operation, that’s what the app usually take, but when the apps start up they have a spike in CPU usage, and with multiple simulatenous deployments, multiple apps are starting at the same time, using all the CPU and making the node unresponsive. 

We should bump the CPU requests to higher numbers that are closer to what the apps need during startup. 

Currently requests/limits are hardcoded in the cnab deployment scripts. In order to allow faster iteration this PR parametrizes them.

This PR relies on https://github.com/StackEng/deployment-pipeline-variables/pull/279 being merged
title: PUBPLAT-143 Parametrize and bump cpu and memory requests for all t-shift sizes in SOE deployments

body:
Originally from https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23931 and reverted due to exceptions it caused in https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23957

Handles the following exceptions that were introduced due to refactoring how we get the service.  The fix is available in [5479e68](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23959/commits/5479e68af76f9be1e094e5aa1743653f06389c47).

I opted to use the old approach of [TryGetService](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/1acb5a6a02c970e119c4f0c68b3576575319f149/StackOverflow.Common/ModuleIntegration/CurrentContextServiceExtensions.cs#L15). Benefits:

1. easier to reason about
2. not tied to the lifecycle of the underlying service
3. still fairly easy to mock

### Root cause

Its related to [AsyncLocal](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/70fbc0a28bf034eaf47c1bc902b0b837439c2e31/StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/Analytics/EventRecording.QandA.cs#L30-L45) - it keeps the value stored per Execution context (or perhaps actually the non-thread async alternative? Its [complicated](https://blog.stephencleary.com/2016/12/eliding-async-await.html)).

One way to fix this is to move the initialization down to `ProductEventService` - see [12fc13b](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23959/commits/12fc13b75a3d9289208a5bfcdd5a8a07b589524c) but I'd rather remove any AsyncLocal/lifecycle related code.

## Reproducing the error

Not trivial to do using a unit test. I had success simply spinning up the app locally and sending at least two events. First one will be cached but the other one will have the null value (curtesy of internals of AsyncLocal).

When I say two events - I did question created and answer created. It should not matter as long as a different Execution context is picked up.

```
System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
   at StackOverflow.Helpers.EventRecording.AnswerCreatedAsync(Post p, CreatedArgs args) in /app/StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/Analytics/EventRecording.QandA.cs:line 229

Full Trace:

   at StackOverflow.Helpers.EventRecording.AnswerCreatedAsync(Post p, CreatedArgs args) in /app/StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/Analytics/EventRecording.QandA.cs:line 229
   at async StackOverflow.Models.EventHandlerCollectionExtensions.<FireAsync>g__Impl|1_0<TSender,TArgs>(EventHandlerCollection<T1,T2> events, TSender sender, TArgs args) in /app/StackOverflow.Common/Models/Events.cs:line 400
   at async System.Threading.Tasks.AwaitTaskContinuation.RunCallback(ContextCallback callback, Object state, Task& currentTask)
   at System.Runtime.CompilerServices.AsyncTaskMethodBuilder<T>.SetExistingTaskResult(Task<T> task, TResult result)
   at async StackOverflow.Helpers.SpamSimilarityChecker.ContentSubmittedHandlers.AnswerCreatedAsync(Post p, CreatedArgs args) in /app/StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/SpamSimilarityChecker/ContentSubmittedHandlers.cs:line 21
   at async System.Threading.Tasks.AwaitTaskContinuation.RunCallback(ContextCallback callback, Object state, Task& currentTask)
   at System.Runtime.CompilerServices.AsyncTaskMethodBuilder<T>.SetExistingTaskResult(Task<T> task, TResult result)
   at async StackOverflow.Helpers.SpamSimilarityChecker.ContentSubmittedHandlers.RecordSimilarityAsync(Post p, Boolean isEdit, Nullable<T> cutoffDate) in /app/StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/SpamSimilarityChecker/ContentSubmittedHandlers.cs:line 39
   at async System.Threading.Tasks.AwaitTaskContinuation.RunCallback(ContextCallback callback, Object state, Task& currentTask)
   ```
   
   Also happens on `questions.create` ([example](https://opserver.main-prod.int.gcp.stackoverflow.net/exceptions/detail?id=0fcb377f-d037-4450-9bef-fd2dbdb88c67&log=Q%26A&store=))

## Summary
This PR moves 6 dev routes from `DeveloperController.Api.cs` to `CommunityController.Api.cs` so these routes are available for CMs and Devs. 

These are the routes that are being moved:
1. CheckApplicationAccountRequestUsage: `cm/api/check-application-account-usage/{accountId}/{applicationId}`

SELECT * FROM [Local.StackExchange.Meta].dbo.Users U
JOIN [Local.Sites].dbo.Accounts A
ON A.Id = U.AccountId
WHERE A.AccountTypeId = @accountTypeId

author: marradoss
body:
MOD-267 | [Slack Thread](https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/C03LPFFR728/p1758718417294629)

## Summary

Apparently it sometimes happens, probably during account merge, that multiple user profiles are linked with the same account id ([here](https://dataexplorer-local.main-prod.int.gcp.stackoverflow.net/android/query/edit/39733)). When we look for user profiles by account id, we don't consider that possibility. When that happens, the ongoing process simply fails.

There was a brute fix for that on Enterprise and I see no reason why we shouldn't extend it to public platform. The fix straight up skips the secondary user profile and returns the main profile. Can it lead to some incorrect data? It may, but assessing that would require analyzing every place where this method is called. On the other hand, this problem happens so rarely that it's worth having a quick fix that prevents a hard crash and come back to that, if needed, in case other problems occur (though I don't think anything important will).
title: MOD-267 A quick fix for failing scheduled job (recalculate tenures)

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
In SOE, all metrics have a “client” tag which is important for filtering. In the pre-cell times, each customer had it’s own cluster with it’s own DD agents, so we just included the “client” in the Agent’s default tags to be added to every metric sent to DD. 

However, in the new cell architecture, mutiple customers will share the same cluster and same agents, so this is no longer an option. 

Sander updated the DD agent, so that it pulls the client from a pod’s namespace label called “client”. However, for this to work, the DD agent needs to determine from which pod did the metric came through. 

As we are using DogStatsD which sends a UDP request to the agent from the pod, that request needs to include the pods unique identifier for the DD agent to identify the pod and get the label its namespace. 

We can provide the pod’s unique identifier to the DogStatsD client library by adding the following env var to the deployment:

```
- name: DD_ENTITY_ID
    valueFrom:
      fieldRef:
        fieldPath: metadata.uid
```

This PR adds this env variable for the deployments used in SOE.
title: PRODPLAT-128 Add DD_ENTITY_ID env var to deployments using DogStatsD

author: svalbuena
body:
This is a tidy up PR I'm doing before the real changes. We are using InternalsVisibleTo too much, usually this is just done to expose internal methods/classes to the test projects but not to other non-test project.

If project A needs to access an internal property of project B then we need to re-think the design of the internal property of project B like making it public. Using the InternalsVisibleTo makes the code harder to follow, as something you believe is internal in the project can break other projects.

I want to clean this up, and only leave InternalsVisibleTo for unit/integration tests projects, and make the impacted properties public. This should also avoid issues like https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/CBVG8MJQN/p1758562497811019.

I looked at the git history, seems like making internal available for any kind of project was an historical decision to make a .net migration easier, and addressing this "patch" was never done later: https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/2869

In this PR i'm consolidating the location of InternalsVisibleTo, at the moment we are mixing using it in .csproj files or in AssemblyInfo.cs files. We should stick with one of the two.
I've usually used .csproj for this, in most cases we can avoid creating the AssemblyInfo.cs file so it's one less file to maintain. It's also more cohesive, since the InternalsVisibleTo is needed when another project references our project, and they do it with ProjectReference directives on their .csproj files.

In a follow up pr i'll remove some of the InternalVisiblesTo directives to try limit this to only testing projects.
title: Consolidate InternalsVisibleTo on .csproj files

author: daleksiuk
body: TEAMS-14776 ## Summary Note: Kyle Mitofsky and I went over this PR together line by line. He feels comfortable that this PR won't cause issues for pub plat and I'll ask him for an approval after our team has a chance to dig in. I'd appreciate it if reviewers could try to follow the logic to confirm that existing functionality isn't affected. The reason for many of the updates in this PR is that we want a review task result for editing questions and answers. It's a little different from other queues because we don't want these edits to complete the task. This allows the user to edit a question and then an answer without completing the task. ### Implementation areas of interest - [`HasReviewFromUser` in `ReviewTask.cs`](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/f3c0d6a170860b5368e03e4e2e9f8e83eac763e5/StackOverflow.Common/Models/ReviewTask.cs#L316) - A check is done when saving a new review result to make sure that there isn't one already there for the user. I had to add a way to override it for ingestion. This is the only new override I had to add. It should be documented fairly well. _Important_: the default behaviour isn't changed. The override only kicks in if the developer chooses to use it. - A new template and model for ingestion - The system is set up to have multiple templates, and the one we would have defaulted to has conflicting logic that would be complicated to modify. Introducing a new template made life MUCH easier and gives us a lot of flexibility moving forward. - [An override](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/f3c0d6a170860b5368e03e4e2e9f8e83eac763e5/StackOverflow/_Scripts/legacy/scoped/reviews/review.ts#L1608) to the `onSuccess` handler for question editing (answer already had an override). This allows us to call the `taskReviewed` endpoint so we can add a review result for the edit question functionality. Edit answer already had a way to override it. ## Automated Testing I struggled a lot to write meaningful tests for this PR, but there is an integration test for the `AddNewReviewResultAsync` function that calls the newly overridable `HasReviewFromUser` function. This is probably the most important place to have a test. ## How to Test 1. Use the instructions on [this PR](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23440) to create a new ingested QA pair. Make sure you get a 201 back. 2. Hit [this developer endpoint](https://stackenterprise.local/developer/review/sync/15) in your browser to create a review task for the Ingested_Draft post that you imported with the Swagger page. 3. Navigate to the ingestion review queue at https://stackenterprise.local/review/ingestion to find an ingested post to review. 4. Edit a question by clicking the edit button. - a. Make sure the cancel button returns you to your review task. - b. Make an edit and save it. It should save and return you to your review task 5. Edit an answer by clicking on the edit button - a. Make sure the cancel button returns you to your review task. - b. Make an edit and save it. It should save and return you to your review task 6. Make sure you can edit the question and answer multiple times 7. Note your Review Task id in the browser URL bar to confirm that review tasks were created using the SQL below 8. You can now verify and publish or skip the question. 9. As a bonus, it may be worth testing edits in another review queue. I used Content Health to make sure edit was still working. After editing, you should see review task results from editing your review task in the following query. There should only be one each for editing the question and answer. ```sql select rtr.ReviewTaskId, rtrt.Name as ReviewTaskResultType, rtr.* from [Local.Enterprise.StackOverflow.Teams].dbo.ReviewTaskResults rtr inner join [Local.Enterprise.StackOverflow.Teams].dbo.ReviewTaskResultTypes rtrt on rtrt.Id = rtr.ReviewTaskResultTypeId order by rtr.CreationDate desc; ``` ## Screenshot of the task screen --------------------------------------------------- ## Things to verify [[Context and rationale](https://stackoverflow.com/c/stack-overflow/articles/16418)] - [X] The PR Title includes its JIRA issue number and there are links to the relevant material at the top of the PR description. - [x] I've given a good description above that describes the changes and why they're needed. - [x] I've added instructions on how to test this PR. - [x] I've added unit and integration tests as appropriate, or justified their absence. - [x] This PR can be reviewed in a few hours at most. author: KyleMit
body:
MOD-268 | Meta: [Bounty dialog does not update bounty value](https://meta.stackexchange.com/questions/412737/bounty-dialog-does-not-update-bounty-value)

## Summary

On close and cancel, the bounty was hidden, but not removed. Since bounty options could hypothetically change by the next time the bounty is invoked, a fresh modal is generated server side and loaded onto the page. When CSS selectors go to retrieve your selection, it only grabs the element from the first dialog and subsequent ones are ignored.

## How to Test

Stealing steps to repro from meta...



Note: the procedure does not require starting a bounty, it aborts early enough, you can test it without spending your reputation.

1. Find a question where you can start a bounty of at least 100 reputation.
2. Click "Start a bounty". A dialog will pop up.
3. Offer **100** and click "Next".
4. Choose any reason and click "Next".
5. Now you are asked

   > Are you sure you want to start a bounty of **100** reputation on this question?

   So far so good.

6. Close the dialog by clicking "X" in the top right corner.
7. Without reloading the page, click "Start a bounty" again. A new dialog will pop up.
8. Offer **50** and click "Next".
9. Choose any reason and click "Next".
10. Now you are asked

    > Are you sure you want to start a bounty of **100** reputation on this question?

    **This is the bug.** The most recent choice was **50**. For some reason the value shown in the "are you sure?" question has not been updated.

11. Should be broken on main/prod and fixed in this branch

[COMMSWITCH-3923]: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/COMMSWITCH-3923?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

author: lisaleegithub
body:
## Summary

This PR introduces a logic to set default range ranges for the questions and comments endpoints if both date parameters are missing.

The default date range is applied only when the `IsTimeBasedPaginationEnabled` site setting is true and both ‘from/creationFrom’ and ‘to/creationTo’ parameters are not provided. Default range is calculated based on the max day range for the endpoint (questions and comments have different values). 

Once the date range has been set, users will be redirected so they are not impacted greatly when we enable the `IsTimeBasedPaginationEnabled` site setting.


## How to Test

### Setting up
1. [Enable time based pagination](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_TimeBasedPagination_Enabled)
2. [Set max day range for the questions endpoint](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_TimeBasedPagination_MaxDayRangeWindowForQuestions)
3. [Set max day range for the comments endpoint](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Api.APIv3_TimeBasedPagination_MaxDayRangeWindowForComments)
4. Add a breakpoint on the line where default dates are assigned for both questions and comments endpoints to check default dates
   - **QuestionService.cs** lines 143-144
   - **CommentService.cs** lines 50-51

### No ‘from/creationFrom’ and ‘to/creationTo’ provided
1. Using Postman, call the questions endpoint without date parameters
2. Verify that the breakpoint is hit and default from/to dates are correctly set
3. Confirm the API response is correct with a redirect (status code 302) and the correct url is shown in the console. 
4. Call the questions endpoint with parameters like `sort=score&order=asc` but still no date params. The new redirect url should still have that sort param with the default date range.
5. Repeat steps 1-3 with the comments endpoint. Note that for comments, it's `creationFrom` and `creationTo`.

### Only ‘from/creationFrom’ provided
1. Call the questions endpoint with only ‘from’ parameter
2. Verify that the breakpoint is not hit
3. Confirm there is no redirect and you get the error message: _"'From' and 'To' are required parameters. The date range between 'From' and 'To' must not exceed {APIv3MaxDayRangeForQuestionsRequest} days."_
4. Repeat steps 1-3 with the comments endpoint by providing only ‘creationFrom’ parameters.

### Only ‘to/creationTo’ provided
1. Call the questions endpoint with only ‘to’ parameter
2. Verify that the breakpoint is not hit
3. Confirm there is no redirect and you get the error message: _"'From' and 'To' are required parameters. The date range between 'From' and 'To' must not exceed {APIv3MaxDayRangeForQuestionsRequest} days."_
4. Repeat steps 1-3 with the comments endpoint by providing only ‘creationTo’ parameters.

body: `PostState.IngestedDraft` was added in #23176. It looks like posts with that state are causing the query in `GetQuestionsAndAnswersCounts()` in `User.Posts.cs` to return multiple rows with `PostTypeId` 1 (questions) and 2 (answers) and the code is only expecting there to be one, so we end up with a `Sequence contains more than one element` exception. This is a proposed fix - only counting published answers and adding the new `IngestedDraft` post state to the list of states ignored when counting questions. I'm not set up to test this, so I defer to the folks working on content ingestion. If you're happy with this, please feel free to merge. If not, no hard feelings and this PR can be closed in favor of another solution y'all might have. # How to test - Check out the main branch - In local, follow instructions in this [PR](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23776) to create a question with `IngestionDraft` status - Log in as the same user and go to the profile page (ex: https://stackenterprise.local/users/1/?tab=profile) - You should see an error - Check out this branch and go the profile page again -> You shouldn't see the above error.

author: stephen-vakil
body:
## Summary

We currently are incorrectly filtering suspicious votes when you add some filters.  The problem is that we apply the `OFFSET` and number of rows fetched within one of the CTEs, before we filter by user reputation (when that is supplied).  As a result, the CTE might get 50 rows, which then get filtered down to < 50 after the user rep filters are applied.  On the screen, it looks confusing because the page count and paging buttons are working from a different count as a result.

This moves the `OFFSET` and row fetch limit out into the main / final `SELECT` that runs.

## How to Test

1. Make some fake data locally if you haven't already.  See [this script](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/23836#pullrequestreview-3218886483)
2. Put in various criteria and verify that the number of pages matches the number of records it should get, and that the table of data doesn't mis-match.  
3. Try both with and without this fix
title: KRAKEN-2475: Fix SQL for suspicious votes

author: balpha
body:
We already have a site setting to disable submit-on-enter for comments. In that case, that's not browser-default behavior (because it's a `<textarea>`), but custom behavior created by us. This site setting was created specifically for the Japanese Stack Overflow, where many people will use an IME and thus there is a chance for accidental Enter-presses (even in moments where the IME is not on).

For some reason, it seems like this site setting was never enabled though.

We've now been asked to also prevent submission of posts (and edits to them) when the user is typing in an `<input type="text">` and presses enter. In contrast to the comment thing, this is modifying default browser behavior (it's technically not part of the spec, but it's mentioned and clarified in the spec: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#implicit-submission).

I see no reason to have a separate site setting for this, so I moved `Settings.Comments.DoNotSubmitOnEnter` to
`Settings.Site.DoNotSubmitOnEnter`. Given that it's not enabled anywhere on the network, I didn't bother writing a migration to rename it.

I considered three different approaches for the implementation:

1. A piece of centralized JS that finds relevant text inputs in the page and modifies their behavior
2. As Stimulus controller that is conditionally attached to the relevant inputs if the site setting is on
3. A Stimulus controller that is *un*conditionally attached to the relevant inputs, and that looks at the site setting to decide whether it should do anything.

Alternative 1 is out, as it has the potential to be super confusing because it's not obvious where the behavior change is coming from.

Alternative 2 makes things more explicit, because at render time you can see the behavior specified in the code. However, as you can see in the diff, there are twenty different places where you would have to check the site setting and add the controller attribute (or not), and that is really noisy.

So I decided on alternative 3: A controller that is attached to all text inputs that live in post editor forms, and that controller decides based on the site setting whether it's a no-op (that's the default), or whether it should `preventDefault()` the Enter press.

I did not touch the Svelte-based AskV3 controls because on that page, the elements aren't wrapped in a `<form>`, so implicit submission doesn't happen in the first place. (I'm not sure this is a good choice from an accessibility standpoint, but that's the way it is.)

I also skipped stuff that is obviously Teams-only (user mentions).
title: AW-1594: Make it possible to disable the browser-builtin submit-on-enter

author: aalear
body:
Before Ascension, on-prem Redis was set up to have each Q&A site use a dedicated Redis DB (matching the site's id) for caching. FBB and Enterprise had already shifted to disambiguating keys by a prefix instead, so when pubplat moved to GCP, it followed suit. Now that Ascension is over, it's time to clean things up.

This PR standardizes Redis cache usage across product lines by removing support for multiple Redis databases per site and switching to a single Redis database (ID 0) for all caches. Site-specific cache keys are now disambiguated using key prefixes by default.
title: PRODPLAT-116 Remove support for running Redis in database mode

author: ycantu
body: ## Summary This PR: 1. Removes a check that prevented applications that have only enabled the Auth Code Grant w/ PKCE variant from using a client secret 2. Changes the HTTP status code when an error occurs exchanging an access token from a `200` to `400`. This allows Swagger UI to surface the error in the UI instead of obfuscating auth errors. My original intent when adding that check was to protect users who selected the option in Stack Apps (listed under Public Clients) from passing in a client secret. However, Auth Code Grant w/ PKCE does not fall neatly into the Public/Confidential client paradigm since it can be utilized by both types of clients. This brings up questions on whether there is a better way to display this in the UI and simplify the options but that's a problem for another time (for example, can we consolidate "Auth Code Grant" and "Auth Code w/ PKCE" into a single option in the UI and database). I believe we kept it separate because we were migrating existing API applications, where "Auth Code Grant" meant requiring a client secret to exchange a token and we didn't want to change that requirement where they would have then been able to "Auth Code Grant" w/ PKCE without a client secret. The only real validation that happens when selecting only one of these options is: - If you only enabled Auth Code Grant, then we have a check that requires a `client_secret` to exchange a code - If you only enabled Auth Code Grant w/ PKCE, then we have a check that requires a `code_challenge` be provided to get a code Otherwise, you can use the Auth Code Grant option with PKCE and a client secret, and you can use Auth Code Grant w/ PKCE option with or without a client secret. What we do want to make sure is that the type of method used to get a code, is the exact same method used to exchange the code. This means if you used a PKCE code challenge then you must use a code verifier to exchange. Likewise, if you didn't use a code challenge then you must a client secret to exchange the code. ## How to Test ### On `main` - Reproducing the issue 1. Using `main`, start up the API v3 Swagger page 2. In Stack Apps setup your API application to only allow "Authorization Code w/ PKCE" under "Manage OAuth" 3. Create a client secret 4. In the API v3 Swagger authentication modal, enter your client ID and client secret 5. Make a request to `/questions` and you should receive a 401 response. The "Authorization" header is sending a value of "undefined". ### In this branch - Fixing the issue 1. Start up the API v3 Swagger page 2. In Stack Apps setup your API application to only allow "Authorization Code w/ PKCE" under "Manage OAuth" 3. Create a client secret 4. In the API v3 Swagger authentication modal, enter your client ID and client secret 5. Make a request to `/questions` and you should receive a 200 response. 6. Logout using the Authorization modal and enter a random character for the client secret and submit, you should now see an error banner appear in the modal and Swagger page ### Reviewing Authorization Code Grant This section of testing is reviewing that the authorization code grant flows works as expected with different combination of parameters and token exchanges. I have created a spreadsheet with possible combinations but it is not exhaustive. It is mainly to verify that the authorization flow still works and that we validate the client secret and/or code_verifier. Use variants of the URLs below in a browser to get an authorization code. Then, use the "OAuth/Auth Code - Exchange Code" request in Postman to exchange the code. ``` Auth Code Grant w/o PKCE - https://meta.stackexchange.local/oauth?client_id={clientId}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri} Auth Code Grant w PKCE - https://meta.stackexchange.local/oauth?client_id={clientId}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri}&code_challenge_method=s256&code_challenge=Io16W183H2YVhVs3a203-Zm9gaKIDvZQSNCXcKxPCi0 The code verifier is `WOMxmT6iyluc0eMFkY-Rue8yZXwxp0ensqo9_jGVuBEefj5C2fNQuiJnovXYQBMUWrep94_6u_WRbWbvY-6XLwfP_dHIzXVgxmh1BDYl7Nu0mla_ulEVpW0Xonpl0RMD`. ``` You can toggle the OAuth options in Stack Apps or through SSMS. ``` UPDATE ApiApplications SET AllowAuthCodeGrantPkce = 1, AllowAuthCodeGrantWithSecret = 1 WHERE Id = @id ``` **Both options are disabled** You should not be able to get a code from https://meta.stackexchange.local/oauth. 1. Visit `https://meta.stackexchange.local/oauth?client_id={clientId}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri}`. An error message should be returned stating "Application is not allowed to request authorization code grants". **Enable `Auth Code Grant` and disable `Auth Code Grant w/ PKCE`** You can get a code from `https://meta.stackexchange.local/oauth?client_id={clientId}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri}` but can only redeem using a `client_secret`. You can optionally still use the PKCE extension but must always provide a `client_secret`. Trying to reedem without a `client_secret` will result in the error "Confidential clients must provide a `client_secret` as part of this flow". 1. Go through the combinations for `Auth Code Grant` [in this spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zg77UkAZ6uNP8vOnqNJM-QwsvilLUwiYx_DlXoU0UpI/edit?gid=0#gid=0). To save time, generate a code and go through the cases that result in failure first (this will allow you to reuse the code). **Disable `Auth Code Grant` and enable `Auth Code Grant w/ PKCE`** You can get a code from https://meta.stackexchange.local/oauth but can only request using a PKCE challenge. Using a `client_secret` is optional. 1. Requesting a code with ` https://meta.stackexchange.local/oauth?client_id={clientId}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri}` will result in the error "Application expects a `code_challenge`" 2. Go through the combinations for `Auth Code Grant w/ PKCE` [in this spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zg77UkAZ6uNP8vOnqNJM-QwsvilLUwiYx_DlXoU0UpI/edit?gid=0#gid=0). To save time, generate a code and go through the cases that result in failure first (this will allow you to reuse the code). **Both options are enabled** You can use both PKCE and the client secret auth code grant flows. 1. Go through all the combinations [in this spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zg77UkAZ6uNP8vOnqNJM-QwsvilLUwiYx_DlXoU0UpI/edit?gid=0#gid=0). To save time, generate a code and go through the cases that result in failure first (this will allow you to reuse the code).
title: YETI2-788 - Allow secret to be used when only PKCE flow is enabled

## Summary

This PR is to display a warning toast message when a user with 5 or more API applications clicks the "Register an application" button. The message should say "You cannot have more than 5 active applications."

When a user with 5 or more apps tries to access the `/applications/register` page, they are still able to access the register form but when they click the button to submit the form, they will see the existing toast message "Failed to register application. You cannot have more than 5 applications." This is not super ideal but after a [discussion](https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/C063MRR938S/p1758824519046859), we've decided it's ok.

## How to Test

**User with 5 apps (current max app limit is 5)**
1. [Impersonate user](https://23869-stackapps.stackexchange.cloud/impersonate/5) with 5 apps
2. Click the "Register an application" button in the Get started sidebar widget > confirm you see the warning toast message and you are not being redirected to `/applications/register` page
3. Confirm you can dismiss the toast
4. Navigate to the `/applications/register` page in the address bar > confirm you can access the register page > click 'Register Application' at the bottom of the form > confirm you see the warning toast message and cannot submit the form

**User with less than 5 apps**
1. Impersonate a different user with less than 5 apps
2. Click the "Register an application" button in the Get started sidebar widget > confirm you are on the register page
3. Navigate to the `/applications/register` page in the address bar > confirm you can access the register page

**Anonymous user**
1. As an anon user, go to the stack apps home page
2. Click the "Register an application" button in the Get started sidebar widget > confirm you are redirected to the login page
3. Navigate to the `/applications/register` page in the address bar > confirm you are redirected to the login page

### Downsides:

body: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-14846 ## Summary This PR handles an issue where tag counts are being incremented from posts currently in the ingestion queue. The behaviour will now be that tag counts increment when a post is verified and published. ## How to Test 1. author: balpha
body: [AW-1598](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/AW-1598) The "alt" -> "title" thing is just something I happened to notice that was wrong, so I fixed it while I was here. The main issue is the other two changes, one of them reported here: https://ja.meta.stackoverflow.com/questions/3992 These strings use `@_m()` for moonspeak (because the whitespace is meant to be highlighted), and that was (in some cases) actually interpreting the markdown syntax instead of outputting it verbatim. Say you have this: @_m(@"Click [here]($link$$space$""hover text"")") Moonspeak [replaces](https://github.com/StackEng/MoonSpeak/blob/72d70ca0e91f75098a612bd9f7ecd7a5031f3606/MoonSpeak.Shared/LocalizedString.cs#L43) the parameters with GUIDs, performs a MarkdownMini transform, and then replaces the GUIDs with the parameter arguments. For the sake of example, let's say the GUIDs are 11-11 and 22-22. Click [here]($link$$space$"hover text") => Click [here](11-1122-22"hover text") This is what MarkdownMini receives, and because of the space between "hover" and "text", it's not a valid markdown link and therefore the text remains unchanged by this transform. That's why this seemed to work correctly in the English version. Now let's say the title text was just the word "hover": Click [here]($link$$space$"hover") => Click [here](11-1122-22"hover") There's no space anymore, so this is a valid link definition as far as MarkdownMini is concerned, so it created Click here which after the argument replacement looks something like this (simplified): Click here Yes, this looks pretty dangerous, although I don't see an immediate way to exploit it (and the attack surface is limited since it would be via translation). But regardless of danger, it's definitely going to look broken. And that's what the bug report was about -- on ja.stackoverflow.com, the translation of the title text contains no spaces, because that's not a thing in Japanese. The fix is to escape the opening bracket to ensure that MarkdownMini doesn't treat this as an actual markdown link. For completeness (and so we can easily fix the translations), these are the string keys before and after the changes: - "alt" -> title: `d20a5aadb3ac742e277907cc09bb4fda` => `2b42b563e6636794105eff6dbfb2a339` - bracket escape in v1: `527df1ace1e6eef07c58cce0e44469a9` => `8d03b816b9a490d58d9dc5d06166c526` - bracket escape in v2: `55cdda2b117fcaa69e9ba046799f19f0` => `8f839dd47bcfa2ab224cebe096ad5b3a` ## How to Test I've tested locally that this fixes it in the Japanese locale, even in the v1 of the Markdown help (where the translation does not have the "Foo bar baz" workaround mentioned in the meta post). If you insit on the pain of testing it yourself with an actual translation, I'm happy to show you how, but I would suggest you simply test the English version (maybe even by removing spaces from the title text, which allows you to reproduce the issue with the code before this change, and confirm the fix with the code after this change). [AW-1598]: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/AW-1598?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ
title: fix some broken translatable strings in the in-editor markdown help files

## Summary

This PR adds a new dev page for testing the newly created ML model to detect spam posts. This ML model is still under development, and this new dev page allows seeing how the model scores recently flagged spam posts.

It implements authentication via the Azure Databricks OpenID Connect endpoint using Microsoft's IConfidentialClientApplication interface. The ConfidentialClientApplication class handles all of the token management, including knowing when the token needs to be refreshed.

To enable unit testing, the PR adds an adapter class `IDatabricksAuthTokenRetriever`. ## Summary

This PR makes it so that when a Coding Challenge is incomplete, you can't see the vote score on the entries. This PR merely hides it on the front-end - it's still visible in the network calls and I think it would be too much work to try and hide this everywhere while we're still in Discussions.

This PR implements [CE-1864 Open sign up modal from Add Comment CTA's](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/CE-1864)

Goal: When an anonymous user tries to comment, reply to a comment or vote on a comment, show the sign-up modal.

## What's new:
For anonymous users, clicking any of:
- Top “Add a comment” button
- Bottom “Add a comment” link
- Reply button on a comment
- Upvote button on a comment

## What's changed:
- Added `currentUserIsAnonymous` on `appState`
- Extended E2E to verify the modal appears from each entry point
- Added lightweight Svelte tests where feasible.

## Trade-offs / not ideal
Please let me know if you have an idea on how to improve any of those, either in this PR or in a follow-up.

1) **Event dispatch scattered across multiple components**  
   - Harder to maintain; easy to miss a callsite.  

2) **Some unit tests missing / awkward to write**  
   - Components call `window.dispatchEvent` and read Svelte context directly.  

3) **Two vote button variants feel redundant**  
   - We had a “info/dummy” button (popover) and a “real” button; both now also gate anonymous users, blurring the separation.

body:
JIRA: [YETI2-177](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/YETI2-177?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNjIxN2E0YzI2OGIwNDM3Y2IwZTQzN2IzOTFhOTBiYTUiLCJwIjoiaiJ9)
### This PR is for option 1. For option 2, see #23812 .
Would like feedback on which option to go with.

## Summary
The search endpoint in API v3 was not working with queries that map to a tag. For example, searching `azure` or `[azure]` in production was returning a 500 error. The reason for the 500 was that it was trying to redirect to `questions/tagged/{tagName}` if the query string matched a tag.  Since we do not perform redirects in the API, there are 2 approaches to fix the issue:

**Option 1: Add an optional parameter `allowTagRedirect` to the `SearchAsync` method, which defaults to true. For API v3, the parameter is set to false to bypass the tag redirect.** 

Option 2: Add a check inside the CheckForEarlyExitFromTagRedirect method. API v2, v3, and Data Licensing API all are set to RoleAPI so we can do a Current.Role and environment check to forbid redirect to tag.


With this change, the search endpoint will perform a search within a specific tag if the query string is wrapped in square brackets. When comparing results between v2 and v3, the outputs matched when a single tag was used. To view some results, see the tabs with different tags [in this file](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kgq7nvfmAxFKtGr82jE3Dyjms98z7ywE1n3uS5Bvyt4/edit?usp=sharing). Note that this was done locally so if you run the same search on your machine, the results may differ.

However, there is a difference between v2 and v3 if more than one tag is provided. 
* API v2: The `tagged` field accepts multiple tags separated by a semicolon. The search will return any question that has at least one of the tags listed. For instance, searching for `tagged=discussion;bug` returns questions tagged with either "discussion" or "bug", not necessarily both.

* API v3: The `query` field accepts multiple tags separated by commas and treats them as an "AND" operation. For example, searching for `query=[discussion], [bug], is:question` returns questions with both tags. This behavior matches the site search bar.

## How to Test
Note: API v3 search endpoint returns questions, answers, and articles so if you want questions only, you need to add `is:question`
1. Checkout the main branch to test locally (or test on prod) >hit the search endpoint (API v3) with a tag name > you get a 500
    - Example: `https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/search?query=flags, is:question&sort=newest`
2. Pull this PR branch > hit the search endpoint (same as above) > should get a 200 but you'll notice not all have the `flags` tag. This is because it's not doing a tag search
3. Make a request (same string as above) but add square brackets to do a tag search > should get a 200 and you'll see that the items all are tagged with the tag you were searching with.
    - Example: `https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/search?query=[flags], is:question&sort=newest`
4. Make a request using API v2 using the same tag & sort option > confirm the results match API v3 results
    - Example: `https://api.stackexchange.local/2.3/search?order=desc&sort=creation&tagged=flags&site=meta.stackexchange.local`
6. Perform a muti-tag search. In API v2, the results show questions with at least one of the tags. In API v3, the results show questions with all tags.
    - API v2 example: `https://api.stackexchange.local/2.3/search?order=desc&sort=creation&tagged=discussion;bug&site=meta.stackexchange.local`
    - API v3 example: `https://api.stackexchange.local/v3/sites/meta.stackexchange.local/search?query=[discussion], [bug], is:question&sort=newest`

## Summary
This pr fixes an issue where we were displaying incorrect rep changes for the time sorted rep history table.
This page uses the yielded return methods `GroupedEvents` & `GetEventsBatch`. `GetEventsBatch` manually calculates the rep change for a group of recent events when sorting the rep history table by time, these methods were getting called multiple times while still initially executing which caused us to rollup the same events a number of times leading to inflated rep change numbers.

## How to Test

1. Find a user with multiple rep changing events on a given day.
2. Go to their user profile and append this string to the end of the url `?tab=reputation&StartDate=2025-09-01%2000:00:00Z&sort=time`, adjust `StartDate` to be before the multiple rep changing events
3. all of the rep changes should roll up correctly

author: daleksiuk
body: TEAMS-14812 ## Summary Some enterprise digests are failing because of a SQL timeout error when calculating the total contributions per department. This PR updates the SQL with a more efficient query. I worked with Aaron Bertrand and his plan calculations showed that changing the subselect to a CROSS APPLY is significantly more efficient. The original query cost was 124.48. This new query is 4.9. Within the CROSS APPLY sub query, we also changed the sort to be by `Id` instead of the `CreationDate` which is also much faster. Note: Drew would prefer that this value be queried by the same date range as everywhere else, but that opens up the question of hiding this if the value is zero (since it often will be for a specific department for the week), which means more testing. This approach keeps the functionality exactly the same but with a more efficient query. ## How to Test - the integration tests for this function are quite good. They make sure that the right department comes back. I did all the steps below for Slack and MS Teams both on `main` and on this PR branch to compare the old query and new query but I'm not sure it's necessary. 1. You need MS Teams and Slack integrations set up. It's the same query used for both, so I think running one on either FBB or SOE is enough. 1. Manually create a department and OrgMemberDetails in `Local.Enterprise.Stackoverflow.Teams`. Subtitute your user ids from the `Users` table for the UserIds below. Mine were 1, 2, and 3. ```sql insert into Departments (Name, CreationDate) values ('Accounting', GETUTCDATE()); insert into OrgMemberDetails (UserId, CreationDate, DepartmentId) values (USER_ID_ONE, GETUTCDATE(), 1); insert into OrgMemberDetails (UserId, CreationDate, DepartmentId) values (USER_ID_TWO, GETUTCDATE(), 1); insert into OrgMemberDetails (UserId, CreationDate, DepartmentId) values (USER_ID_THREE, GETUTCDATE(), 1); ``` 2. You need a way to include departments in your local running code. Option 1: In your code, go to`StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/Digest/Personal/GetChatOpsPersonalDigestUseCase.cs` and hard-code the variable `teamSupportsDepartments` on line 125 to `true`; Option 2: On SOE, change the site setting `Auth.DepartmentAttributeNameFromAssertion` to have a value. This worked for me but I don't know what other side-effects it might have, since it's meant to work with a SAML SSO configuration. 4. Run the developer routes to send a Slack and MS Teams digest. ```sql delete from WebhookHistory where WebhookHistoryTypeId in (8, 9); ``` https://stackenterprise.local/scheduled/send-msteams-personal-digest?force=true https://stackenterprise.local/scheduled/send-slack-personal-digest?force=true You should see a number similar to what's circled below: --------------------------------------------------- ## Things to verify [[Context and rationale](https://stackoverflow.com/c/stack-overflow/articles/16418)] - [x] The PR Title includes its JIRA issue number and there are links to the relevant material at the top of the PR description. - [x] I've given a good description above that describes the changes and why they're needed. - [x] I've added instructions on how to test this PR. - [x] I've added unit and integration tests as appropriate, or justified their absence. - [x] This PR can be reviewed in a few hours at most. (Please consider splitting it up otherwise.) - [x] If this is a work in progress, I've marked this as a draft PR. - [x] If I've added the `pr-environment` label, I want a new environment to help me and others test this branch. - [x] I've added the appropriate labels like [security], [hot-path] or [dependencies] (See [list](https://stackoverflow.com/c/stack-overflow/articles/16512))

body:
Slack Thread: https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/CBVG8MJQN/p1757010113169629

## Summary

* We have never set a value for `Current.Site.Settings.Spam.OpenAIApiKey` for FBB/SOE so it failed on invocation.  Now this shouldn't have been called anywhere because we have `SpamSimilarityCheckerProcessDeletedPostsEnabled` immediately bail out of a route when it's off.  But through DI, was attempted to be initialized from the `[FromServices]` call when the route was initially hit.

* Moved to the service locator pattern _after_ we do the site settings check so it's not called unless it's setup.
* We checked if there was something like a `CoreOnlyScheduledRoute` but we don't have such a class and ideally we want to move away from explicit references to Core/FBB/SOE in code and use feature flagging instead anyway.

## How to test (Locally)

1. Make sure it builds fine
2. Hit the scheduled route endpoint and make sure it runs fine

    [`/scheduled/similarity/refresh-recent-spam-post-embeddings`](https://meta.stackexchange.local/scheduled/similarity/refresh-recent-spam-post-embeddings)

3. Try hitting dev routes and make sure they run fine

    [`/developer/similarity/recent-bad-posts`](https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/similarity/recent-bad-posts)


4. Try deleting content as spam or editing content and make sure it runs fine


## How to Test (on main after merge)

1. We'll want to log in to SOE dev environment at https://sem1.dev.stackenterprise.co/
5. You'll need to use the `testengadmin@soedev.onmicrosoft.com` credentials under **sem1**

7. Specifically this job at https://sem1.dev.stackenterprise.co/scheduler/jobs/aHR0cDovL3N0YWNrb3ZlcmZsb3cuc2VtMS1zdGFja292ZXJmbG93L3NjaGVkdWxlZC9zaW1pbGFyaXR5L3JlZnJlc2gtcmVjZW50LXNwYW0tcG9zdC1lbWJlZGRpbmdz

author: dionrhys
body:
Slack context: https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/CBVG8MJQN/p1756997426996799 and https://stackexchange.slack.com/archives/C099V42GFNZ/p1756998320864379

`ClientSideEventAnalyzer` was erroring frequently on incremental builds with this error:

```
CSC : error AD0001: Analyzer 'StackOverflow.Generators.CSharpToTypeScript.ClientSideEventAnalyzer' threw an exception of type 'System.IO.IOException' with message 'The process cannot access the file 'D:\code\StackOverflow\StackOverflow\_Scripts\cs-to-ts\product-events\ModalDismissedEvent.generated.ts' because it is being used by another process.'. [D:\code\StackOverflow\StackOverflow.Common\StackOverflow.Common.csproj]
```

Those problems can then lead to problems in building the front end, e.g.:

```
The command "node telemetry.mjs "npm run msbuild-debug -- && npm run msbuild-ssr"" exited with code 1.
```

This PR fixes the problem by wrapping the IO code in a lock. There are not too many `.generated.ts` files generated by this analyzer, so I don't foresee lock convoy performance problems from this change. I don't measure any build duration increases from this change either.

# Testing

You can run the build in a loop to verify flakiness before and after this PR:

```powershell
$count = 10; for ($i = 1; $i -le $count; $i++) { echo "Run $i / $count"; dotnet build -c Debug -v quiet /t:Rebuild }
```
title: Fix ClientSideEventAnalyzer breaking incremental builds intermittently

author: animuson
body:
## Summary

Jira: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-11045

The way we are using Moment.js in this case is not compatible. Moment requires us to know the format of the date string being passed in, but these are free-text boxes where users can enter dates of any format. Therefore, trying to parse dates that are not of the expected `MMM DD, YYYY` format that we are telling it to expect results in it parsing them incorrectly, often giving very old dates in the button.

We already use the plain Date object to do parsing, validation, and updates to the dashboard in other parts of the dashboard code. Given that, it's safe to assume that throwing the string into Date again would result in it being valid, because otherwise an error would be displayed below the field. So rather than reinventing wheels here, I opted to just pass the date string into Date for parsing, then pass that into Moment so we can use the format function as desired.

## How to Test

1. Visit the dashboard page.
2. Open the date picker and enter a date like "09/01/2025" into the start date box then click Apply.
3. Ensure the date is displayed correctly in the button containing the date range.
title: TEAMS-11045: Use Date object for parsing instead of moment
