author: mukunku
body:
# Summary

Unlike File Uploads for Knowledge Ingestion, Confluence content ingestion will be initiated by the connector, outside the monolith, and not by a user. For this reason we need to query the Postgres database regularly to see if any new Confluence Pages have been ingested. 

Additionally, we need to regularly sync the statuses for Confluence Page ingestions like we do for File Uploads.

This PR implements both checks in a new scheduled route: `scheduled/sync-confluence-cloud-pages` plus some refactoring.

This PR depends on https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow.KnowledgeIngestion/pull/435 so that PR needs to be merged before this one.

# How to Test

You'll need the KI WebApi and this branch running locally.

* Go to https://stackenterprise.local/scheduled/sync-confluence-cloud-pages and execute the schedule job.
* If you have no Confluence data (which I assume is the case for most folks) you should see 0 new Pages inserted and 0 new statuses being synced.
* Next, simulate an ingested Confluence page by running this INSERT statement in your **postgres** `data` database for Knowledge Ingestion:
    ```sql
    INSERT INTO documents (source_system, source_url, source_version, source_last_run_id, source_path, raw_container, raw_file_name, raw_file_size, raw_etag, raw_file_type, raw_storage_path, raw_inserted_at, processing_state_id, text_extracted_container, text_extracted_path, text_extracted_at, text_chunked_at, text_chunk_count, qna_extracted_at, qna_posted_at, updated_at, word_count, user_list, external_id, file_upload_id, processing_state_message, external_group_id) VALUES (
          'confluenceCloud',
          'https://signaleleven.atlassian.net/spaces/SD/overview',
          1,
          '08467a08-01ce-4a45-8653-501f61e6d0b7',
          'confluenceCloud/Software development/Software development/page-content.html',
          'ki-silver',
          'page_content.html',
          4482,
          '"0x1D9CB4B00E8A890"',
          'html',
          'confluenceCloud/Software_development/Software_development/page_content.html',
          '2026-03-25 11:04:42.677408',
          6,
          'ki-gold',
          'confluenceCloud/Software_development/Software_development/page_content.html.md',
          '2026-03-25 17:04:48.212539',
          '2026-03-25 17:04:51.8981',
          1,
          '2026-03-25 17:05:35.7039',
          '2026-03-25 20:12:29.106218',
          '2026-03-25 20:12:29.106218',
          227,
          '[{"author_email": "daleksiuk@signaleleven.com", "source_system": "confluenceCloud", "author_full_name": "Dustin Aleksiuk"}]'::jsonb,
          'DUMMY_PAGE_ID',
          NULL,
          '3/3 Q&As posted to SOE',
          'DUMMY_SPACE_ID'
      );
    ```
* Make sure to also create the Confluence Space for it on the **monolith side** as well by running this sql query:
    ```sql
    --Local.Enterprise.StackOverflow.Teams
    INSERT INTO IngestionConfluenceCloudSpaces(ConfluenceSpaceId, CreationDate, IngestionStatusId)
    VALUES ('DUMMY_SPACE_ID', GETUTCDATE(), 2)
    ```
* Now re-run the schedule job. You should see 1 new Page be inserted and its status get updated to `6`
  * You can confirm this by querying `SELECT * FROM IngestionConfluenceCloudPages`
* Update the status to 7 in postgres next:
    ```sql
    UPDATE documents, SET processing_state_id = 7 WHERE id = <your-new-record>
    ```
* Re-run the scheduled job and confirm the status was updated on the monolith side as expected.
title: TEAMS-15862: Sync Confluence Cloud Pages and Statuses from KI

author: troygould-stack
body: ## Summary - **Pulls `BillingStartDay` from Statsig** instead of hardcoding the billing period to the 1st of the month. The start day is read from the `knowledge-ingestion` parameter store and clamped to a valid value (1–31) with monitoring if misconfigured. - **Introduces `BillingPeriod` struct** to encapsulate billing period calculation. Correctly handles months shorter than the configured start day (e.g. start day 31 in April becomes April 30; start day 30 in February becomes Feb 28/29 depending on leap year). - **Migrates existing Statsig calls to Parameter Stores** — `IsEnabled` (previously a gate) and `IngestionLimit` (previously a dynamic config) are both now read from the `knowledge-ingestion` parameter store, keeping all ingestion configuration in one place and removing the need for code changes when switching implementations in Statsig. - **Renames `GetCurrentIngestionBillingDateAsync` → `GetEndDateOfCurrentIngestionBillingCycle`** and makes it synchronous, since the value is now derived from `BillingPeriod.Create` rather than an async lookup. The banner now correctly shows the first day of the next billing cycle as the reset date. - **Removes `IIngestionReviewQueueRepository` from `IngestionBillingLimitsService`** — it was injected but never used. - **Adds developer endpoints** for inspecting Statsig parameter store values (`bool`, `string`, `number`) to aid local debugging. ## Testing 1. Ensure that statsig is enabled in site settings 2. Use the development statsig server api key in environmentSettings 3. add certpath to same file 4. Updated the `knowledge-ingestion_ingestion_limits` to return `2` for development environment 5. updated `sandbox_knowledge_ingestion_zuora_entitlements` to return billing day of `13` for development environment 6. Uploaded three Q/A pairs via t he ingestion v3 endpoints 7. went into the site and published two of the Q/A pairs 8. upon having two ingested items published, I started getting the following message on the page:

author: calliopemode
body: ## Summary While confluence cloud space keys are still saved in the azure key vault, they are now also stored in our database There are few cases for saving handled by this update 1. If a space key is added, and it does not currently exist in the table, we insert a row for this space key 2. If a space key is removed, we set a disabled date for that row and filter it from the returned list in the future 3. If a space key is added which already exists in the table we null the disabled date ## Important Edge Case Dustin ( @daleksiuk ) has provided information that these space keys are not immutable, the customer may update them in their confluence configuration. At present, if a customer were to rename a space key, we would lose that connection, and if they were to add the new key to our list we would save that as a new row. I don't think at present there is a way to account for this change based on the structure of the table, which I will include an image for reference ## To Test Navigate to the settings page for confluence cloud connector under Ingestion Test the adding and removal of space keys upon refresh. Intentionally enter invalid space keys to see the error state ## Functionality Notes If the space key entered does not exist in confluence it errors out and alerts the user their config needs to be verified against confluence cloud

author: jbubriski
body:
From [AW-1912]:

## Summary

Ignored-tag question filtering was client-side only, causing native ad units to bunch up or stack when enough questions were hidden. Moves filtering to the server in both `QuestionsController` (question list pages) and `HomePageQuestionRetriever` (homepage). Also adds wildcard ignored-tag support (`c#*`, `*sql*`) that was missing from both filtering sites — exact tags go into a `HashSet` for O(1) lookup; wildcard patterns become `Wildcard` objects checked only when no exact match is found.

**Changed files:**
- `QuestionsController.List.cs` — `FilterOutIgnoredTagQuestions` now splits ignored tags into exact (`HashSet`) + wildcard (`Wildcard`) sets
- `HomePageQuestionRetriever.cs` — same split applied; posts filtered before view rendering
- Native ad Razor views — ad insertion index now counts only rendered posts
- `WhenRetrievingQuestionsForHomepage.cs` — unit tests for homepage filtering behavior; preference key uses `(int)Preference.HideIgnoredTags` instead of a magic number

## How to Test

1. Enable Native Ads for meta.stackexchange.local (2 Native Ads settings in Campaigns → Ad Settings).
2. Confirm native ad units appear after question 2, then every 5 questions.
3. Add ignored tags matching visible questions.
4. Before this fix: hidden questions cause ads to cluster or stack.
5. After this fix: filtered questions don't appear in HTML at all; ad spacing is maintained.
6. Also set a wildcard ignored tag (e.g. `java*`) and confirm matching questions are filtered server-side.

---------------------------------------------------

body: # Summary This PR is for [TEAMS-15532](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-15532) and complements: https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow.KnowledgeIngestion/pull/431. Currently we only have one "Failed" state that has a generic failure message. We want to start showing custom messages based on the specific error that happened. This PR adds two: one for the case where all the generate q/a's are low quality, and one for the case where all the generated q/a's are duplicates. ## Remarks This PR also creates a copy of the `IngestionProcessingState` enum defined in https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow.KnowledgeIngestion/blob/2acfb71a14571a863b13382ae574c196eef0a4a0/src/py_daemon/src/app/app_constants.py#L10-L50. This I believe is a necessary choice as we can't keep having magic numbers everywhere. Before they were isolated to tests only but now it is affecting production code flow. # How to Test * You'll need a record in your `IngestionFileUploads` table with the correct processing state id. You can insert one with the following query: ```sql INSERT INTO IngestionFileUploads (UploaderUserId, [FileName], UploadedDate, IngestionStatusId, ProcessingStateId, StatusUpdatedDate, ExternalDocumentId, FileHash) VALUES(1, 'dummy.txt', GETUTCDATE(), 4, 29, GETUTCDATE(), -1, '54f564d173335eacc8b21842091063c4e4835210df1b16ff0570c507cb505302') ``` * Next, simply open https://stackenterprise.local/ingestion and confirm you see the new status message on hover ## End-to-End Testing To test the whole flow without manually inserting records you may use the following document to re-create the `All low quality posts` scenario: [UselessDocument4.docx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26517672/UselessDocument4.docx) This will involve running the Knowledge Ingestion `py_daemon` app and the C# WebApi app in conjunction with your local enterprise. Additional instructions not provided here 😬 [TEAMS-15532]: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-15532?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

author: jacob-adams
body:
## Summary

This PR publishes user signup product events using the [transactional outbox pattern](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html), ensuring that event writes are atomic with the user creation DB transaction and eliminating the risk of a user being created without a corresponding event being dispatched (or vice versa).

### Changes

**Outbox-aware event publishing (`IProductEventHelper`)**
- Added a new `IProductEventHelper` interface (in `StackOverflow.Module.Events`) with a `PublishOutboxEventsAsync` method that writes events within an existing DB transaction using the transactional outbox pattern.
- The concrete `ProductEventHelper` falls back to best-effort delivery when the outbox is disabled via `SiteSettings.Global.ProductEvents.AllowPublishingViaOutbox`, allowing a safe rollout.

**User signup flow (`UsersController.HandleSuccessAsync`)**
- Wrapped the entire user signup flow in a `BeginTransactionIfNotInOne` block so that user creation, and outbox event writes all commit atomically.
- Replaced direct `_productEventService.SendAsync(...)` calls for `UserSignedUp` and `SignupComplete` events with `PublishOutboxEventsAsync`, passing the transaction.

**`IModuleDbContext` / `IMaybeATransactionWrapper`**
- Moved `BeginTransactionIfNotInOne()` and a `Transaction` property to `IModuleDbContext`, making scoped transaction management available across all modules and legacy code.
- Moved `IMaybeATransactionWrapper` so it's more accessible throughout the codebase. `IMaybeATransactionWrapper` already existed. It is what's returned by the `BeginTransactionIfNotInOne` function.

**Transaction refactor in `StackDbContext`**
- Moved transaction logic from `DBContext.Transactions.cs` into a new `StackDbContext.Transactions.cs`, implementing `BeginTransactionIfNotInOne` from `IModuleDbContext` on the concrete context. This makes it accessible both in legacy code and the modules.

### Feature flag

The outbox path is gated behind `SiteSettings.Global.ProductEvents.AllowPublishingViaOutbox`. When `false` (default), events fall back to the existing best-effort delivery so the flag can be enabled incrementally in production.

## Testing

I've tested this locally and the `load-test` environment with `AllowPublishingViaOutbox` set to both true and false. In all cases, the sign-up process worked and events were published to AEH.

author: mukunku
body:
# Summary

This is for https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-15537.

There is a period during document processing where we show q/a’s were created but there’re no review tasks yet because the scheduled job hasn't run yet.

This PR:
* Updates the scheduled job for ingestion review queue task generation to run every minute 
  * Runs will not overlap if it ends up running longer, guaranteed by the scheduler
* Shows the status as Processing if no review tasks or published posts exist for an ingested document yet.

# How to Test

To test this you'll need the `py_daemon` app and the `StackOverflow.KnowledgeIngestion.WebApi` projects running locally.

1. Upload a document locally for ingestion
2. Wait for your py_daemon to process the document and generate & post Q/A's to your local environment
3. Visit https://stackenterprise.local/ingestion and:
   * Confirm the Q&A created count is not zero
   * Also confirm the Needs review and Published counts are zero
   * Confirm the ingestion status is shown as Processing and not Completed
5. Next, visit https://stackenterprise.local/developer/review/sync/15 to create review tasks
   * This is needed because the scheduler doesn't run locally, so your review tasks will never get created otherwise 
   * This will also insert 100 random review tasks 🙃 You may need to run the route a couple times as well...
6. Confirm the Needs review count is not zero anymore and consequently that the status is now in the Completed state
title: TEAMS-15537: Show Ingestion State as Processing if Review Tasks Don't Exist Yet

author: daleksiuk
body:
TEAMS-15821

## Summary
I created site settings in the [original PR](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/25200) so that we could have ingestion enabled, but not show connector config. I broke the non-ingestion slack auto-answer configuration - it was hidden by default from the user.

## How to Test

#### Summary
All you're trying to test is that Slack auto answer shows the ingestion version when `SlackConnectorConfigEnabledFor` is set for the site, and shows the original version when unset. If that makes sense, you can ignore the instructions below.

To start, `Slack.AutoAnswer.Enabled` and `Ingestion.EnabledFor` should be both "on".

#### Scenario 1: Slack connector config disabled (default for private beta)

1. In site settings, ensure `SlackConnectorConfigEnabledFor ` is `None`
2. Verify the "Slack Auto-Answer App" nav item appears in the sidebar under "Integration and apps"
3. Navigate to /enterprise/slack/autoanswer and verify the original auto-answer page loads
4. Verify that the "Slack Ingestion" nav item does not appear
5. Navigate directly to /enterprise/ingestion/slack and verify it returns 404

#### Scenario 2: Slack connector config enabled

1. In site settings, enable `SlackConnectorConfigEnabledFor`
2. Verify the "Slack Ingestion" nav item appears in the sidebar
3. Navigate to /enterprise/ingestion/slack and verify the ingestion version of the page loads

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
This PR adds the "Add custom filter" modal to the questions list. Most of the behavior mirrors what is in production.

### What’s the same? 
- You can create a filter with all of the filterable elements from the existing experience. It also saves the sort as part of this filter. In code, these are called “user question lists”.
- In the existing experience, the URL is rewritten (but the page is not  reloaded) if a `uqlId` parameter is present. This is meant to make the URL sharable since an anonymous user cannot load the filter using only the `uqlId` query parameter.
- Filters with tags are redirected to `/questions/tagged*`

### What’s different?
- I believe this is a bug in the existing experience but if a saved custom filter is selected AND then the user updates the filter popover, the current page is reloaded with the updated filter values from the popover but subsequent pagination requests still use the custom filter previously selected. Here I have opted to reset everything.
- This new design does not have a way to edit or rename an existing filter so that functionality is missing and requires design.


## How to Test
**Anonymous**
1. Open https://localhost:7205/questions in a private window and verify the "+ Custom Filter" button is not visible

**Logged-In Users**
**Creating Filters**
1. Open https://localhost:7205/questions
2. Create at least 3 different filters: 1) One without any tags, 2) One with "My watched tags" (make sure you are following some tags) and one with 3) another one with the "Following tags"
3. When the filters are created, you will be redirected to the new filtered view
4. Now visit https://meta.stackexchange.local/questions and verify the new filters are present in the right-side widget. 

**Shareable URLs from Filters**
1. In the "Custom Filter" right sidebar widget visible on https://meta.stackexchange.local/questions, hover over each created filter and get the `uqlId` parameter
2. Visit https://localhost:7205/questions?uqlId={the_id} with the `uqlId` parameter and also click it on the https://meta.stackexchange.local/questions page, the URL will be re-written on both. This is so that it can be shared with other users (for example, loading it as an anonymous user)

**Navigation**
I believe the behavior in production is awkward and have opted to reset the search if a user modifies the filter popover while paginating through a saved custom filter. In production, it only updates the current page and then subsequent pages use the previously selected custom filter.
1. Select a custom filter and go to page 3 or so
2. Update the filter popover with a new value
3. Verify the page count is reset back to 1 and `uqlId` parameter is removed from the URL
title: YETI2-954 - Add "Add custom filter" modal to questions list

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
Migrated FBB2SOE customers are moving to a shared SQL Elastic Pool architecture, where multiple tenants share a SQL server. This requires unique database names per tenant (e.g., {ticker}-SitesEE, {ticker}-StackOverflowEE) to avoid collisions. The application itself is DB-name agnostic, so changes are scoped to the deployment pipeline. Existing customers remain on standalone SQL servers and are unaffected.

The infra will add to the tenant metadata the database names to use so the deployment pipeline can grab them. The value would be as follows:

| Database      | Existing SOE customer | FBB2SOE migrated customer |
|---------------|-----------------------|---------------------------|
| Sites         | SitesEE               | {prefix}-SitesEE          |
| StackOverflow | StackOverflowEE       | {prefix}-StackOverflowEE  |

As the infra is conditionally adding a prefix where it needs to, SOE's deployment pipeline doesn't need to do any checks, just use the db names variables instead of the hardcoded values. 

This PR depends on this [deployment pipelines PR](https://github.com/StackEng/deployment-pipeline-variables/pull/419) which depends on this [infra PR](https://github.com/StackEng/soe-terraform/pull/928). We'll need to merge the dependencies first.
title: PRODPLAT-650 Parametrize DB names in SOE's deployment pipeline to support SQL elastic pooling

author: aalear
body:
## Summary

Makes the .internal domain suffix used for internal routing configurable per deployment, so we can run the stackoverflow app in regions where a different suffix (e.g. `.internaldr`) is used.

The override value will come from Octopus via 

- `charts/stackoverflow/templates/ingress-internal.yaml` now uses `.Values.ingress.internalHostSuffix` for both the host rule and the `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-vhost` annotation. The nginx variable name is derived from the suffix ($trims_dot_<suffix>) so the two can't drift. The new annotation function is defined in https://github.com/StackEng/k8s-mgmt/pull/416.
- `Network:InternalDomainSuffixOverride` is read from configuration and passed to the `StackExchangeNetwork` singleton. A matching site setting (`Network.InternalDomainSuffixOverride`) recreates the network on change.
- `stackoverflow.generate-values.ps1` reads `$vars.vars.ingress.internalHostSuffix` (defaulting to `.internal`) and injects it into both the YAML values and the environment for the app config to pick it up.

Default behavior is unchanged: when Octopus deployment doesn't supply `internalHostSuffix`, the chart renders `.internal` and no env var is emitted, so the library's built-in `.internal` default applies.

## Testing

- [x] Deploy this PR to `ascn-dev` without setting `internalHostSuffix` in Octopus. Confirm nothing changes: ingress still exposes `<host>.internal`, annotation is `$trims_dot_internal`, container has no `Network__InternalDomainSuffixOverride` env var.
    - (Octopus is having issues right now, but I did get a successful pod deployment and verified that nothing changed there)
- [x] Deploy this PR to `main-dr` and verify that the domain override applies in all the places that were unchanged in the previous step.
    - [Successful deployment](https://stackeng.octopus.app/app#/Spaces-1/projects/stack-overflow-dr/deployments/releases/2026.4.29.143633-pr/deployments/Deployments-340730)
title: PRODPLAT-739 Override .internal domain name suffix for DR region deployments

author: animuson
body:
## Summary

This is a full re-implementation of the existing Legacy/Enterprise FormHelper code as Stimulus controllers.

Using controllers this way allows us to add scoped controllers for individual settings pages that extend off this easily without the need of adding inline JS on the page itself, and without needing to re-implement components in each controller. Most pages can be a single extra scoped controller for the page with its additional page-specific functionality added in, rather than an entirely new entry point.

This is added as a new entry point in the main Enterprise Admin wrapper. Since this uses Stimulus controllers and does not interact with the same `js-` classes as the FormHelper, they can co-exist on the same page while we work on stripping the old FormHelper usage from other settings pages. The ultimate goal is to remove FormHelper entirely, since it requires the introduction of more JQuery event handlers in order to extend its functionality.

In addition to the base form submission logic that existed before, it also adds controllers for:

- Automatically toggling the disabled state or visibility of sub-sections based on the checked/filled status of another input, something we commonly do across pages.
- Automatically handle item lists in a consistent format using add and remove paths, with the ability to insert rendered HTML returned from the server onto the page.
- A built-in auto-save method for smaller forms or toggles where having a Save button does not make sense.

Note: Writing documentation for this is on my cleanup list.

## How to Test

This only introduces the code needed to convert the admin settings pages. It has some vitests cases built in to ensure functionality, but there is otherwise nothing else to test as part of this PR. Testing will be done on the other PRs as we convert the pages to use these controllers.

You can, however, visit the PR environment as part of the base PR here: https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/25011 which has all the converted pages already running on the new Stimulus code, if desired. These commits will be split up into the individual PRs again soon.
title: TEAMS-15419: Enterprise admin settings refresh: Stimulus controllers

author: cguevaramx
body:
## Summary

Removes `.blur()` calls in `UpvoteButtonController` and `BookmarkButtonController` that fired immediately after button activation. Blurring the button caused JAWS and other screen readers to lose focus context and fall back to announcing the document title ("Home - Stack Internal 2.0 document") instead of the updated button state.

## Related Issue

SO_15 (A11Y spreadsheet ticket) — Screen reader announces page title instead of button state when clicking "Mark this post as useful and clear" or "Bookmark this post" on the "Top unanswered questions for you" section.

## Changes

- `StackOverflow/_Scripts/sprinkles/post/UpvoteButtonController.mod.ts` — Removed `target?.blur()` so focus stays on the upvote button after activation
- `StackOverflow/_Scripts/sprinkles/post/BookmarkButtonController.mod.ts` — Removed `target?.blur()` (and the existing TODO comment noting this was inaccessible) so focus stays on the bookmark button after activation

## WCAG Criteria

**1.3.1 — Info and Relationships (Level A)**
Focus retention ensures the updated `aria-pressed` state and `aria-label` on the button are announced by screen readers after activation, conveying the relationship between the button and its toggled state programmatically.

## Verification Steps

1. Navigate to a page with the "Top unanswered questions for you" section (e.g. the home/overview page on an Enterprise instance)
2. Enable JAWS (or NVDA)
3. Tab to the "Mark this post as useful and clear" upvote button and press Enter or Space
4. Verify the screen reader announces the updated state (e.g. "Mark this post as useful and clear, toggle button, pressed") rather than the page title
5. Tab to the "Bookmark this post" button and press Enter or Space
6. Verify the screen reader announces "You have bookmarked this post (click to undo), toggle button, pressed" rather than the page title
7. Activate each button again and verify the unpressed state is announced correctly

## Screenshots / Before & After

**Before:** JAWS announced "Home - Stack Internal 2.0 document" after clicking either button (focus was lost to document root).

**After:** JAWS announces the button's updated `aria-label` and `aria-pressed` state after click (focus remains on the button).

author: WouterDeKort
body:
This PR is for [PRODPLAT-724](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/PRODPLAT-724).

## Summary

- `SerilogBootstrapper.cs` was directing Serilog's internal `SelfLog` to `Console.Error` as raw plain text
- When Serilog's async `BackgroundWorkerSink` encounters an error, each line of the stack trace is written as a separate plain-text log entry — the Datadog agent reads pod logs line-by-line and has no way to group them
- This pollutes error queries across **all environments including production** with meaningless individual stack frame lines like `at Serilog.Sinks.Async.BackgroundWorkerSink.Pump()`
- **1,471 occurrences** seen across `env:prod` and `env:dev` in the last 30 days: [Datadog logs query](https://us3.datadoghq.com/logs?from_ts=1771408541124&live=false&query=service%3A%28stackoverflow+OR+stackoverflow-channels%29+%22at+Serilog.Sinks.Async.BackgroundWorkerSink.Pump%22&storage=flex_tier&stream_sort=desc&to_ts=1774000541124)

The fix wraps the SelfLog handler so each internal Serilog error is emitted as a single-line JSON object, which the Datadog agent parses as one structured log event.

author: daleksiuk
body:
## Summary

TEAMS-15511

For private beta, only file upload is shipping — connector setup should not be visible to customers.

This PR adds three new `SiteSelector` site settings (`ConfluenceCloudConnectorConfigEnabledFor`, `SlackConnectorConfigEnabledFor`, `MicrosoftTeamsConnectorConfigEnabledFor`) that independently control whether each connector's admin UI is shown. All default to `None` (hidden).

1. I chose to make three site settings because I suspect we will introduce the connectors one by one, and we can remove these site settings as they are no longer needed.
2. I intentionally didn't default these on for local or dev environments because I think it will be confusing when the UIs don't match up. I thought that when we start re-introducing the connectors we can do that.

Note that the slack ingestion admin page is a superset of the existing auto-answer admin page and they are mutually-exclusive. This PR hides the newer one completely.

Changes:
- The Ingestion Settings page conditionally renders each connector card and the "Connectors" heading based on the new settings
- `EnterpriseCanManageConfluenceCloud()` and `EnterpriseCanManageSlackIngestion()` now check the corresponding setting, which gates both the nav item and route access via `[CheckEnterpriseSecurity]`
- No dedicated MS Teams ingestion admin page exists yet — the setting only controls the "Coming soon" card visibility

## Automated tests
This is all very UI-focused and relies on existing checks (the controllers won't allow the actions to fire because of the `CheckEnterpriseSecurity` attribute). I couldn't find a place to write any tests. I thought about a Playwright test for the ingestion admin page but it seems like a lot for temporary functionality. If you see a place you think I can write an automated test let me know.

## How to Test

1. Navigate to `/enterprise/ingestion/settings` — verify the "Connectors" heading and all connector cards are hidden (settings default to `None`)
3. In site settings, enable `ConfluenceCloudConnectorConfigEnabledFor` for the current site — verify the Confluence card appears and `/enterprise/ingestion/confluence-cloud` is accessible
4. Disable it again — verify the card disappears, the nav item is gone, and navigating directly to `/enterprise/ingestion/confluence-cloud` returns 404
5. Repeat steps 2-3 for `SlackConnectorConfigEnabledFor` with the Slack card and `/enterprise/ingestion/slack`
6. Enable `MicrosoftTeamsConnectorConfigEnabledFor` — verify the "Coming soon" Teams card appears
7. With all connector settings disabled, verify the Ingestion Settings page still shows the file upload section but no connector UI
8. Verify that Slack Auto-Answer at `/enterprise/slack/autoanswer` remains independently accessible (controlled by its own `Slack.AutoAnswer.Enabled` setting, not affected by these changes)
9. Confirm that when the `SlackConnectorConfigEnabledFor` and `ConfluenceCloudConnectorConfigEnabledFor` are disabled, admin menu items do not show up.

author: sandermvanvliet-stack
body:
## Summary

- **`IngestionFeatureProviderBridge`**: Introduced a bridge pattern so that `Feature.cs` (static context) can access the scoped `IIngestionFeatureProvider` — replacing the previous direct `SiteSettings` lookups with a DI-aware approach that supports Statsig feature flags
- **Statsig-backed ingestion feature checks**: `IngestionFeatureProviderFromSiteSettings` now conditionally reads from Statsig (`IKnowledgeIngestionFeature`) when `UseStatsig` site setting is enabled, falling back to site settings otherwise. This applies to `IsIngestionEnabled`, `IsIngestionApiEnabled`, and `IngestionLimit`
- **Added `KnowledgeIngestionFeatureWithDefaultValues`**: Fallback implementation in the Statsig module that returns safe defaults (`IsEnabled = false`, `IngestionLimit = 100`)
- **Consolidated `IngestionModuleIntegrationExtensions`**: Moved from per-app (`StackOverflow/` and `Api.V3/`) into `StackOverflow.Common/ModuleIntegration/Ingestion/`, now also registers the `IngestionFeatureProviderBridge` as a hosted service

### Package updates

- Added `StackOverflow.Observability` package reference to `StackOverflow` and `StackOverflow.Api.V3` projects

## How `IngestionFeatureProviderBridge` works

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Application Startup                     │
│                                                              │
│  AddIngestionModule() registers:                             │
│    • IngestionFeatureProviderBridge as IHostedService         │
│    • IIngestionFeatureProvider → IngestionFeatureProviderFrom │
│      SiteSettings (scoped)                                   │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┘
                       │ StartAsync()
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│          IngestionFeatureProviderBridge (IHostedService)      │
│                                                              │
│  On startup, captures IHttpContextAccessor into a static     │
│  field so the static Instance property can access it later.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Static call site: Feature.cs                                │
│                                                              │
│  Feature.Ingestion =>                                        │
│      IngestionFeatureProviderBridge.Instance                 │
│          .IsIngestionEnabled                                 │
│                                                              │
│  Feature.IngestionApi =>                                     │
│      IngestionFeatureProviderBridge.Instance                 │
│          .IsIngestionApiEnabled                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┘
                       │ Instance property
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  IngestionFeatureProviderBridge.Instance (static)            │
│                                                              │
│  1. Gets HttpContext from static IHttpContextAccessor        │
│  2. If HttpContext exists:                                    │
│     → Resolves IIngestionFeatureProvider from RequestServices │
│     → Returns IngestionFeatureProviderFromSiteSettings       │
│       (which checks UseStatsig to decide: Statsig or         │
│        SiteSettings)                                         │
│  3. If no HttpContext (background thread, startup, etc.):    │
│     → Returns DefaultFalseIngestionFeatureProvider           │
│       (all features disabled, safe defaults)                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```


🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Testing - local

1. You'll need to configure a connection to Statsig
    a. Go to `environmentsettings.Local.Enterprise.json`
    b. add a section like the following. The value for `ServerSecret` can be found under `https://console.statsig.com/41UXiA1WJHBHVBsQmKMoUG/api_keys` and the cert should be in the Knowledge Ingestion path. Note, below is for my windows setup 
```
  "Statsig": {
    "ServerSecret": "secret-from-statsig-console",
    "LogLevel": "Debug",
    "CaCertPath": "C:\\code\\StackOverflow.KnowledgeIngestion\\src\\ZscalerRootCertificate-2048-SHA256.crt"
  }
```
   c. Rebuild

2. Enable Statsig in the app
    a. login as an admin that has access to site settings
    b. update the following site setting to `true` https://stackenterprise.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Ingestion.UseStatsig
3. Go to `https://stackenterprise.local/developer/statsig/get_current_user` and make sure instanceId is setup
4. Go to `https://stackenterprise.local/developer/statsig/check_gate?gateName=knowledge-ingestion_ingestion_enabled` this should return "True" that the user has access to the knowledge ingestion
5. Use swagger UI to test the ingestion values are being returned.  The `ingest/available` and `ingest/available-diagnostics` should return useful data and a 200 response.

author: dc9842
body:
## Summary

Fixes the ask page prefill flow used by trusted services (e.g., SKI claim links) so that prefilled draft data and correlation IDs survive model translation into the V3 ask experience.

### 1. Refactor AskPrefillHmacVerifier

Addresses review feedback from #25129:

- `VerifySignature` now returns `AskPrefillVerifyResult` enum with specific failure reasons instead of `bool`
- New `ResolveServiceKey` method separates key lookup from HMAC verification

No behavior change — the controller still returns 400 for all verification failures.

### 2. Carry prefilled draft through V3 ask page model

`AskViewAsync` translates from `AskModel` to `V3.AskModel` without carrying the `QuestionDraft` through. The V3 model lazily loads from the DB draft store, losing the HMAC-signed prefill data. This caused prefilled fields to render empty on the V3 ask page.

Fix: detect `PrefilledAskModel` in `AskViewAsync` and copy `Draft` + `AdditionalEventArgs` to the V3 model.

### 3. Carry correlation_id through V3 ask view

The V3 view generates a random `Guid` for `CorrelationId`, discarding the trusted-service `correlation_id` (e.g., `"ski:{token}"`) needed for the `question.asked` → AEH → `mark_posted` flow.

Fix: read `correlation_id` from `AdditionalEventArgs` with Guid fallback.

### 4. Pass AdditionalEventArgs through the V3 Svelte island

The V3 island submits `CorrelationId` as a top-level form field, but the `question.asked` product event reads from `AdditionalArgs` (populated by `add-*` prefixed form fields scanned by `ExtractInsertFromForm`). The V1 ask page handles this by rendering `AdditionalEventArgs` as hidden `<input name="add-{key}">` elements — V3 had no equivalent.

Fix: pass `AdditionalEventArgs` from the cshtml through the island args → Svelte context → `SubmitControls`, which appends each entry as `add-{key}` in the `FormData`. This ensures the `question.asked` event receives the correlation_id on both V1 and V3 paths.

### Prefill flow end-to-end

1. Trusted service generates a draft and signs `(service, title, body, tags, correlation_id)` with HMAC-SHA256
2. User visits claim link → auto-POST form to `/questions/ask/prefill` (unauthenticated users go through login redirect via `SessionState` and restore at `/questions/ask/prefill/restore`)
3. SO verifies HMAC → renders prefilled ask page with draft data and `AdditionalEventArgs`
4. User submits → `question.asked` event fires to AEH with the trusted-service `CorrelationId`
5. Downstream listener matches the correlation_id prefix and marks the draft as posted

Steps 3 and 4 were broken on V3: step 3 because the draft was lost in model translation, and step 4 because the correlation_id was replaced by a random Guid (view) and never submitted as an `add-*` field (island).

## Files changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `AskPrefillVerifyResult.cs` | New 7-value result enum |
| `AskPrefillHmacVerifier.cs` | `ResolveServiceKey` + two `VerifySignature` overloads |
| `QuestionsController.Ask.cs` | Enum comparison + carry `Draft`/`AdditionalEventArgs` to V3 model |
| `V3/Ask.Model.cs` | Add `set` accessor to `Draft` property |
| `V3/Ask.cshtml` | Read `correlation_id` from `AdditionalEventArgs`; pass `AdditionalEventArgs` to island |
| `index.mod.ts` | Map `AdditionalEventArgs` to island props |
| `types.ts` | Add `additionalEventArgs` to `AskQuestionProps` and `SubmitFormData` |
| `AskQuestion.svelte` | Thread `additionalEventArgs` through Svelte context |
| `SubmitControls.svelte` | Append `add-{key}` form fields from `additionalEventArgs` |
| `SubmitControls.test.ts` | 3 new tests for `add-*` field submission |
| `AskPrefillHmacVerifierTest.cs` | Assert specific enum values + new tests (30 total) |

## Test plan

- [x] All 30 `AskPrefillHmacVerifierTest` tests pass
- [x] All 9 `SubmitControls` tests pass (6 existing + 3 new)
- [x] Solution builds clean
- [ ] Deploy to PR environment → open claim link → verify fields are prefilled
- [ ] Submit prefilled question → verify `question.asked` event has trusted-service `CorrelationId` (not a random Guid)
- [ ] Verify normal `/questions/ask` still generates a Guid correlation_id and does not submit `add-*` fields

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

body:
## Summary
While load testing I noticed a flurry of exceptions that say:
```
System.Exception: Got a null site in GetSet with an ImmediateSiteCache; expected site 1 (redis db: 0) - Check for ImmediateCache (not ImmediateSiteCache).GetSet usages.

Full Trace:

   at StackOverflow.CommonExtensionMethods.GetSet<T>(ImmediateCache cache, String key, Func<T1,T2,T3> lookup, Int32 durationSecs, Int32 serveStaleDataSecs, GetSetFlags flags, Site site, Server server) in /app/StackOverflow.Common/ExtensionMethods.GetSet.cs:line 153
``` 
I confirmed we are also getting these in prod and probably have been for a while. The issue is that the `GetSet` call in the homepage service is expecting a site but `ImmediateCache` is a global cache so `Site` is null. We should use `ImmediateSiteCache` which loads the site.

https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/e75fa642eb81ee4a9ed2aa6218281cf16574551d/StackOverflow.Common/Helpers/CommonCache/ImmediateSiteCache.cs#L12-L19

## How to Test

1. Using `main` load the new homepage as an anonymous user
2. In another browser, impersonate a developer and visit `https://localhost:7205/admin/errors`. You will see the exception above.

author: nhu-van
body:
## Summary

Jira: TEAMS-15386

- We introduced `IngestionStatusId` column to the `IngestionFileUploads` table. This column is nullable for legacy data. We won't have null values in the future (productions). But in existing testing environments, it will appear in a strange state.
- This PR is to create a scheduled route to fetch status from the ingestion side and update records with null status. This should only run once, based on a new site setting. After the scheduled route runs, it will disable the site setting and won't rerun.
- This PR also adds the return count for total records updated to the `fetch-ingestion-status` scheduled route. 

## How to Test
**Preparation**
- If you don't have any records in the `IngestionFileUploads` table, try to upload a few files and run the ingestion pipeline (pydaemon). Then run the below SQL to set status to null.
- If you have records in the `IngestionFileUploads` table and no null status, run the below SQL to set to null.
- If you already have any null records, ignore this preparation steps.
```
update IngestionFileUploads
set IngestionStatusId = null
where IngestionStatusId  not in (5, 7)
``` 

**Testing steps**
1. Run the [Ingestion Status WebApi](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow.KnowledgeIngestion/tree/main/src/StackOverflow.KnowledgeIngestion.WebApi)(run directly from your editor, running through docker may have some issue in local) 
2. Make sure the [Ingestion.ShouldRunIngestionStatusBackfill](https://stackenterprise.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Ingestion.ShouldRunIngestionStatusBackfill) site setting is set to **false**.
3. Run the backfill scheduled [route](https://stackenterprise.local/scheduled/backfill-ingestion-status).
4. Check the `IngestionFileUploads` table -> Null status records are still there
5. Set the [Ingestion.ShouldRunIngestionStatusBackfill](https://stackenterprise.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Ingestion.ShouldRunIngestionStatusBackfill) site setting is set to **true**.
6. Check the `IngestionFileUploads` table -> Null status records are updated with a value.
7. Check the [Ingestion.ShouldRunIngestionStatusBackfill](https://stackenterprise.local/developer/site-settings/edit?name=Ingestion.ShouldRunIngestionStatusBackfill) site setting, it should be updated to **false**
title: TEAMS-15386 Add scheduled route to backfill null status

author: ycantu
body:
## Summary
This PR aims to prevent the startup spikes seen in Internal API from Collectives by replacing the get membership function with a query from the database.

Collectives membership is central to the Collectives product and changing the code in one place, usually means the membership cache is still being accessed elsewhere. For this reason, activity notifications have been dropped as the cache membership is accessed in both get activity notification statements (`collectiveActivityCountsService.GetActivitySummaryAsync` and `(new CollectiveArticleService(collective)).GetPendingArticlesUnviewedActivity(Current.User)`)

Further improvements can include:
- Caching the result from the database in the Internal API
- Refactoring Collective membership and creating an alternative or new cache object that performs better for per user membership rather than collective membership. This should be done carefully to prevent cache invalidation bugs. It will also result in a large number of new keys (one per logged in user). This would allow us to bring activity notifications back.

## How to Test
1. Place a breakpoint in SubCommunityMembership.cs `CreateCacheableEntry`
https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/blob/27bd8d9f825624d6e89a1e3896b6b2b40784c06f/StackOverflow.Common/Models/SubCommunities/Membership/SubCommunityMembership.cs#L16-L23
2. Start up the Internal API
3. Get a JWT token from an impersonated user with Collectives and enter in the Swagger page `https://meta.stackexchange.local/developer/users/get-impersonation-jwt/{userId}`
4. Confirm collectives are returned from the collectives endpoint and that the SubCommunityMembership.cs breakpoint is not hit. The activity notifications should always be 0.

author: so-tooling
body:
## Summary

Interactive elements across the site (downvote button, accept answer button, accepted answer indicator, close/reopen, delete, share, and flag buttons) had `title` attributes that only showed tooltips on mouse hover. Keyboard users could not access this tooltip information when navigating with Tab/focus. This violates **WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard (Level A)**.

**Jira:** https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/A11Y-148

## What changed

### `StackOverflow/Views/Shared/Vote.cshtml`
- **Downvote button**: Added `data-controller="s-tooltip"` and `data-s-tooltip-placement="right"` to match the upvote button pattern. The tooltip describing the downvote action now appears on keyboard focus.
- **Accept answer button**: Added `data-controller="s-tooltip"`, `data-s-tooltip-placement="right"`, and a `title` attribute that dynamically reflects the current state (accept vs. unaccept). Previously had no tooltip controller at all.
- **Accepted answer indicator**: Added the missing `data-controller="s-tooltip"` (already had `data-s-tooltip-placement="right"` and `tabindex="0"`).

### `StackOverflow/Views/Posts/Render/Menu/Menu.cshtml`
- **Close/Reopen button**: Added `data-controller="s-tooltip"` and `data-s-tooltip-placement="top"`. Tooltip text explaining close/reopen behavior now visible on keyboard focus.
- **Delete button**: Added `data-controller="s-tooltip"` and `data-s-tooltip-placement="top"`. Tooltip with deletion context now visible on keyboard focus.
- **Share link (Q&A)**: Added `s-tooltip` to the existing `se-share-sheet` controller (`data-controller="se-share-sheet s-tooltip"`) and `data-s-tooltip-placement="top"`. "Short permalink" tooltip now visible on keyboard focus.
- **Share link (Articles)**: Same change as Q&A share link.
- **Flag button**: Added `data-controller="s-tooltip"` and `data-s-tooltip-placement="top"`. "Flag this post..." tooltip now visible on keyboard focus.

## How to verify

1. Navigate to any question page on an Enterprise instance (e.g., `bofa-uat.stackenterprise.co`).
2. Use **Tab** to move focus through the voting buttons, post menu items (Share, Edit, Follow, Close, Flag), and accept answer button.
3. Verify that **tooltips appear on keyboard focus** for each of these interactive elements, matching the hover tooltip behavior.
4. Optionally, run **axe** or a screen reader (JAWS/NVDA) to confirm tooltip content is exposed to assistive technology.

## Conformance

- **WCAG:** 2.1.1 Keyboard (Level A) — https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/keyboard.html
- **Fix approach:** Uses the Stacks design system `s-tooltip` controller which shows tooltips on both mouse hover and keyboard focus events. See [Stacks tooltip documentation](https://stackoverflow.design/product/components/popovers/#hover-tooltips).

**Agent run**: https://github.com/StackEng/Accessibility/actions/runs/23012848726
title: A11Y-148: add keyboard-accessible tooltips to interactive elements

author: dc9842
body:
## Summary

Adds a generic, HMAC-signed prefill endpoint to the ask page. Trusted services (initially SKI — Stack Knowledge Intelligence) sign draft question fields with HMAC-SHA256 and POST-redirect users to the SO monolith, which verifies the signature and renders a prefilled ask page.

The design is **generic and reusable** — a `service` identifier selects the HMAC key from a JSON map (`AskPagePrefillHMACKeys`), so future services can prefill the ask page without monolith changes.

We use a POST form redirect (auto-submitting hidden form) rather than a GET redirect with query parameters because question bodies routinely exceed browser URL length limits (~2,000 characters).

## HMAC signature scheme

```
String-to-sign: {service}\n{title}\n{body}\n{tags}\n{correlation_id}
Key lookup:     AskPagePrefillHMACKeys[service]  (JSON map → base64-encoded key)
```

The `service` field is included in the signature to prevent cross-service forgery. The `correlation_id` is opaque to the monolith — just passed through to the `question.asked` Event Hub event.

**Browser CRLF normalization:** Browsers convert `\n` to `\r\n` in form values during POST submission (per HTML spec). The verifier canonicalizes `\r\n` → `\n` before computing the HMAC so signatures match regardless of transport.

## How it works

```
Calling service (e.g. SKI)           SO monolith
──────────────────────────           ───────────
GET /claim/{token}
  ├─ sign_draft(service="ski", title,
  │  body, tags, correlation_id, key)
  └─ render auto-submit POST form
       │
       ▼
                              POST /questions/ask/prefill
                                ├─ AskPrefillHmacVerifier.VerifySignature(service, ...)
                                ├─ Key lookup: AskPagePrefillHMACKeys[service]
                                ├─ if authenticated → PrefilledAskPageAsync()
                                └─ if not → PendingFormPush + redirect to login
                                              │
                                              ▼
                                     GET /questions/ask/prefill/restore
                                       └─ PendingFormPop → PrefilledAskPageAsync()
                                              │
                                              ▼
                                     User submits question
                                       └─ QuestionSubmitEvent.CorrelationId = correlation_id
                                            → Event Hub → calling service tracks conversion
```

## Tasks
- **Task 1**: `AskPagePrefillHMACKeys` site setting (JSON map of service→key) + `AskPrefillHmacVerifier` static helper using `CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals`
- **Task 2**: `POST /questions/ask/prefill` (XSRF-exempt, HMAC-protected) and `GET /questions/ask/prefill/restore` endpoints on `QuestionsController` with `PendingFormPush`/`Pop` for unauthenticated users
- **Task 3**: Nullable `CorrelationId` on `QuestionSubmitEvent` so the `question.asked` Event Hub event includes the draft claim token

## Files changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `SiteSettings.AskPage.cs` | Added `AskPagePrefillHMACKeys` with `[Secret]` — JSON map of service name → base64 key |
| `AskPrefillHmacVerifier.cs` | **New.** Generic HMAC-SHA256 verifier: looks up service key from JSON, CRLF canonicalization, constant-time comparison |
| `DataKeys.cs` | Added `FormTypeKeys.AskPrefill` |
| `QuestionsController.Ask.cs` | Added `AskPrefill` (XSRF-exempt, `service` param), `AskPrefillRestore`, `RenderPrefilledAskPageAsync` |
| `QuestionEvents.cs` | Added nullable `CorrelationId` to `QuestionSubmitEvent` + `CreateEvent` |
| `EventRecording.QandA.cs` | Extracts `prefill_correlation_id` from `AdditionalArgs`, passes to event |
| `AskPrefillHmacVerifierTest.cs` | **New.** 16 tests (valid, tampered fields, CRLF normalization, service isolation, multi-service keys, unknown service, null/invalid JSON) |

## Bugs found and fixed during E2E testing

| Bug | Root Cause | Fix |
|-----|-----------|------|
| Browser POST returned "Suspicious request" (fkey missing) | SO's anti-CSRF check rejects cross-origin POSTs | Added `EnsureXSRFSafe = false` — endpoint is protected by HMAC instead |
| Browser POST returned 400 (HMAC mismatch) | Browsers normalize `\n` → `\r\n` in form values per HTML spec | Added `\r\n` → `\n` canonicalization in `AskPrefillHmacVerifier` before verification |

## E2E test results

Tested against SO PR environment (`25129.stackoverflow.cloud`) and SKI dev gateway (`api.ascn-dev.stackoverflow.dev`).

| Test | Result |
|------|--------|
| Claim page renders auto-submitting POST form with all fields | **PASS** |
| Missing draft → 404 | **PASS** |
| Invalid/tampered HMAC → 400 | **PASS** |
| Valid HMAC + unauthenticated → login redirect with PendingFormPush | **PASS** |
| Valid HMAC + authenticated → prefilled ask page (title, body, tags) | **PASS** |

## Test plan

- [x] `AskPrefillHmacVerifierTest` — 16 tests pass
- [x] Solution builds clean (`dotnet build -c Debug`)
- [x] Provision `AskPagePrefillHMACKeys` in dev site settings
- [x] E2E: SKI gateway claim link → auto-submit form → prefilled ask page with correct title/body/tags
- [x] E2E: Unauthenticated flow → login redirect → prefilled ask page
- [x] E2E: Invalid/tampered HMAC → 400
- [ ] E2E: `AskPagePrefillHMACKeys` not configured → 404
- [ ] E2E: Submit prefilled question → verify `question.asked` event has `CorrelationId`

## Deployment notes

- **No new NuGet packages** — uses built-in `System.Security.Cryptography` and `System.Text.Json`
- **Feature-gated**: returns 404 when `AskPagePrefillHMACKeys` is empty (safe to deploy before key provisioning)
- **XSRF-exempt**: prefill endpoint skips fkey validation since it's authenticated via HMAC (same pattern as `/oauth/access_token`)
- **Backwards compatible**: `CorrelationId` is nullable, null for all non-prefill questions
- **Multi-service ready**: add a new service by adding a key to the JSON map — no code changes needed
- SKI gateway side can be deployed independently; E2E testing requires both sides deployed with matching HMAC key

## References

- Proposal: [027-prefilled-ask-page-via-so-module.md](https://github.com/StackEng/ml-stack-knowledge-intelligence/blob/feat/027-prefilled-ask/docs/proposals/027-prefilled-ask-page-via-so-module.md)
- Plan: [027 plan](https://github.com/StackEng/ml-stack-knowledge-intelligence/blob/feat/027-prefilled-ask/docs/plans/027-prefilled-ask-page-via-so-module.md) (Tasks 1–3)
- SKI gateway PR: https://github.com/StackEng/ml-stack-knowledge-intelligence/pull/71

The 'Expanded' layout displays 3 excerpt lines and 'Condensed' layout displays 1 excerpt line. The default layout is Expanded. The layout preference is saved using a dedicated route (`users/set-post-summary-layout-mode`). The layout updates (via event emmission) when a new selection is made. ### Notes * Added a `layout-popover` island and a partial `LayoutPopover.cshtml` so it can be easily reused on other pages. * Created a new route `users/set-post-summary-layout-mode` to set and save preferences * Used the `MenuItem` component instead of `MenuCheckItem` for the layout options. While `MenuCheckItem` seemed like the cleaner approach, it was causing multiple issues such as allowing multiple selections, not updating the layout, and the layout option being defaulted on reload. If I fixed one thing, something else wasn't working. I tried many different ways (also some help from Gemini) but was unable to resolve the issues. See [Stacks Svelte doc](https://beta.svelte.stackoverflow.design/?path=/docs/components-menu--docs) * Initially showed the update layout by reloading the page but then changed it to event emission for more responsive behavior (locally, updating the user preference can take over 10 seconds). ## How to Test ### Anonymous user **Default layout** 1. On the beta site, confirm you see the layout button next to the `Customize your feed` button. Icon should be `IconWindowExpanded` since that's the default option. 2. Click the layout button and confirm the default option 'Expanded' is checked 3. Click any empty space outside of the popover to dismiss it 4. Confirm the post summary is displaying 3 excerpt lines **Selecting new layout and saving preference in a cookie** 1. Open DevTools to inspect cookies 2. On the beta site, click the layout button and choose 'Condensed' option 3. Confirm that you see the cookie name `localusr` > click it and you will see the parsed value `[229|1]` 4. Confirm the layout button icon changes to `IconWindowCompact` 5. Notice the page reloads with updated layout 6. Confirm the post summary is displaying 1 excerpt line 7. Click the layout button and confirm 'Condensed' option is still checked 8. Click any empty space outside of the popover to dismiss it 9. Open the layout popover and click 'Condensed' again > should not reload ### Logged in user **Default layout** 1. On the beta site, confirm you see the layout button in the **Interesting posts for you** section. Icon should be `IconWindowExpanded` since that's the default option 2. Click the layout button and confirm the default option 'Expanded' is checked 3. Click any empty space outside of the popover to dismiss it 4. Confirm the post summary is displaying 3 excerpt lines **Selecting new layout and saving user preference** 1. Add a breakpoint on line 574 in `C:\Code\StackOverflow\StackOverflow\Controllers\UsersController.cs` to confirm preferences are being saved. 2. On the beta site, click the layout button and choose 'Condensed' option 3. Make sure you hit the breakpoint and confirm key is `StacksPostSummaryLayoutMode` and setValue is "condensed" 4. Confirm the layout button icon changes to `IconWindowCompact` 5. Notice the page reloads with updated layout 6. Confirm the post summary is displaying 1 excerpt line 7. Click the layout button and confirm Condensed option is still checked 8. Click any empty space outside of the popover to dismiss it 9. Open the layout popover and click 'Condensed' again > should not reload [YETI2-896]: https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/YETI2-896?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

author: qheaden-stack
body:
## Summary

Fixes a race condition where badge cache updates (on community badge create/edit) only refreshed the in-memory cache on the server that handled the request. Other servers in the pool continued to serve stale badge data until their process restarted.

- Added a Redis key (`badge:cache-bust`) that stores the Unix timestamp of the last badge cache bust, scoped per-site via `SiteCache`
- Added an in-memory `_SiteId_LastHydratedAt` tracker so each server knows when it last hydrated its own cache
- `IsBadgeCacheStale()` compares the Redis bust timestamp against the local hydration timestamp — if Redis is newer, the cache is considered stale
- Replaced direct `HydrateCache(forceHydration: true)` calls in `CommunityController.Badges.cs` with the new `BustBadgeCache()`, which writes the bust timestamp to Redis (with `broadcastRefresh: true` to invalidate L1 on all servers) and immediately re-hydrates locally
- Added integration tests covering bust/stale detection behavior

## How to Test

- Create or edit a community badge via `/cm/community-badges`
- Verify the success flash notice appears and the badge list reflects the change
- In a multi-server environment, verify other servers pick up the updated cache on their next badge lookup (they will detect the Redis bust timestamp and re-hydrate)
- Run the new integration tests in `BadgeCacheBustTests.cs`
title: MOD-521: Track badge cache refresh across server pool

## Summary

author: juanrodriguezcen
body:
After running a 6 month period backfill, I noticed that it was doing just 1 page (less than 10K), which showed that there might be a problem in the query, which isn't returning the full page size, although there is more data. 

The problem is that the `TagSetRows` doesn't have a FK on the `Tags` table, so there is no integrity enforced. After doing some queries, I found out that there are `TagSetRows` with no matching `Tags`. This generated that on the first 10K accountIds in the period, there are accountIds with only `TagSetRows` with no matching `Tags`, the result will be less than 10K users, which the backfill treats as "this is the last page". 

This PR updated the `ActiveUsers` CTE to filter out those in that situation.

author: sandermvanvliet-stack
body:
## Summary This PR introduces **Statsig as a dynamic source for Knowledge Ingestion feature availability and quota**, replacing the static SiteSettings-based approach. A new `UseStatsig` site setting acts as a feature flag to toggle between the two sources, enabling a safe, gradual rollout. ### Key changes - **New `IKnowledgeIngestionFeature` interface** in the Statsig module — exposes `IsEnabled` (gate: `knowledge-ingestion_ingestion_enabled`) and `IngestionLimit` (dynamic config: `knowledge-ingestion_ingestion_limits` → `quota`) - **New `IngestionFeatureProviderFromSiteSettings`** — conditional dispatch layer that routes to Statsig or SiteSettings based on the `UseStatsig` flag - **New `UseStatsig` site setting** — `GlobalOnly`, defaults to `false`, requires `EnterpriseDeveloperReadWrite` permission - **Statsig SDK wired with Redis** datastore and Salesforce context (`sf:{accountId}`) - **Removed diagnostic Statsig endpoints** from API V3 (added then cleaned up during development) - **Dependency validation** — Ingestion module startup asserts exactly one `IIngestionFeatureProvider` is registered ## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Ingestion Controller
(availability check)"] --> B["IIngestionFeatureProvider"] B --> C{"UseStatsig
site setting"} C -- "true" --> D["Statsig SDK"] D --> E["Gate: ingestion_enabled"] D --> F["Config: ingestion_limits → quota"] C -- "false" --> G["SiteSettings"] G --> H["EnabledFor / APIEnabledFor"] G --> I["IngestionLimit"] style C fill:#f9f,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px style D fill:#4da6ff,stroke:#333 style G fill:#ffa64d,stroke:#333 ``` ### Availability decision flow ```mermaid flowchart LR R["Request"] --> P{"IsIngestionApiEnabled?
(Statsig or SiteSettings)"} P -- No --> X["❌ Unavailable"] P -- Yes --> Q{"Admin activated
ingestion?"} Q -- No --> X Q -- Yes --> L{"Quota exceeded?
(limit from Statsig
or SiteSettings)"} L -- Yes --> X L -- No --> V["✅ Available"] ``` ### Statsig context setup ```mermaid flowchart LR S["Statsig Init"] --> R["Redis datastore
(local DC)"] S --> U["Statsig User"] U --> P1["product = env"] U --> P2["salesforce_instance_number"] U --> P3["instanceID = sf:accountId"] U --> P4["companyID = sf:accountId"] ``` ## Failsafe design | Scenario | Behavior | |---|---| | `UseStatsig = false` (default) | All decisions use SiteSettings — **no behavioral change** | | Statsig gate check throws | Logs monitoring event, returns `false` (ingestion disabled) | | Statsig quota check throws | Logs monitoring event, returns `100` (default quota) | | Rollback needed | Set `UseStatsig = false` — instant revert, no deployment | ## Test plan - [x] Unit tests for `IngestionFeatureProviderFromSiteSettings` conditional routing - [x] Unit tests for availability controller with mocked provider (both Statsig-on and Statsig-off paths) - [x] Unit tests for `IngestionStatusHelpers` (deletion allowed only for Adhoc + Failed/Completed) - [x] Integration test for dependency resolution (`IIngestionFeatureProvider` must be registered) - [x] Availability data provider covers all combinations (API enabled/disabled × admin enabled/disabled × within/over quota) - [ ] Manual: toggle `UseStatsig` on a test instance and verify gate/config are read from Statsig - [ ] Manual: verify fallback behavior when Statsig is unreachable 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
title: PSLT-58: Source feature availability and quota from Statsig

author: alexwarren
body:
## Summary

- The `getJSPath()` function in `stub.js` finds the base JS URL by searching for a `<script src>` tag matching `/stub.*\.js/`
- This regex was too broad — it matched `cdn.cookielaw.org/scripttemplates/gpp.stub.js` (OneTrust), which now appears earlier in the DOM after OneTrust scripts were moved to the `<head>` in #25042
- With the wrong base URL, all lazy-loaded JS files (including `full.js`) were requested from the OneTrust CDN, resulting in 404s and `StackExchange.initialized` never resolving
- Keyboard shortcuts (and anything else gated on `StackExchange.initialized`) silently broke on the Shine beta as a result

## Fix

Tighten the filter regex from `/stub.*\.js/` to `/\/stub.*\.js/` to require a path separator before `stub`. This matches `/stub.en.js` but not `/gpp.stub.js`. The replace regex on the very next line already had this leading slash — the filter just needed to agree with it.

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify `StackExchange.initialized.state()` returns `"resolved"` on https://beta.stackoverflow.com/
- [ ] Verify keyboard shortcuts work on https://beta.stackoverflow.com/ (press `g` or `?`)
- [ ] Verify no regression on https://stackoverflow.com/ — keyboard shortcuts still work for users with the preference enabled

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
title: MOD-534: Fix getJSPath() matching OneTrust gpp.stub.js instead of stub.js

author: troygould-stack
body:
## Summary

*New endpoints to handle user clicking on Show Classic or Beta link in the old and new sites.*

Note: This the first of three PRs. These endpoints need to exist before we merge the next PR. The last PR will make use of these cookies/preferences. 

There is a button on the beta site to "Switch to Classic." This takes a user from the beta site to the old site. There is also a button on the old site to "Try new [beta] Site" which takes a user from the old site to the beta site. 
Updating these links to point to one of two new endpoints in the monolith first, followed by a redirect to either the beta site or the old site. Depending on the user type, the endpoint will first do one of the following two things::
* Anonymous users: add a value to the anonymous cookie saying marking if the user prefers the beta or old site
* Authenticated user: add a new value to the `PreferencesRaw` column in the User table stating if the user prefers the beta or old site

The cookie/preference will be used later ([another PR](https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/pull/24989)) when we start directing a subset of traffic from the old site to the new site. If the preference or cookie states that a user prefers the old/classic site, then we will ignore if they are part of the subset of users (via the PeopleSelector) that gets redirect from the old site to the beta site.

## How to Test (anonymous user)

1. As an anonymous user, you may have a cookie like `localusr`  This will not initially have a value for Preference `228` in the string
2. Go to the old site
3. Click on "try new [beta] site"
4. You will be first directed to an endpoint on the old site that sets the anon cookie to include `228:true`
5. You will then be forwarded from the exact same page you are on in the monolith (i.e. https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/php) to the equivalent page in the beta site (i.e. https://beta.stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/php)
6. Click on the "Switch to classic" button
7. The anon cookie will now have `228:false`
8. You will end up on the same page on the monolith


## How to Test (authenticated user)

1. As an authenticated user, you may have a PreferenceRaw value in the User tableThis will not initially have a value for Preference `228` in the string
2. Go to the old site
3. Click on "try new [beta] site"
4. You will be first directed to an endpoint on the old site that sets the Preference value in the User table to include `228:true`
5. You will then be forwarded from the exact same page you are on in the monolith (i.e. https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/php) to the equivalent page in the beta site (i.e. https://beta.stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/php)
6. Click on the "Switch to classic" button
7. The preferences will now have `228:false`
8. You will end up on the same page on the monolith
title: adding endpoint for setting preference/cookie for classic/beta

author: SignalRichard
body:
In enterprise instances on new account creation, the `account.verifiedemailchanged` internal event throws a null reference exception because it was unable to find the user with the associated site.  This exception is triggered from 2 different code paths for enterprise instances (`CreateAndConfigureAccountAsync` and `CreateEnterpriseUserAsync` used by Enterprise SCIM) because the user has not yet been added to the `AccountSites` table before the `EnterpriseHelper.AfterAccountCreationAsync` function is called which saves the new verified email triggering the event.

This PR changes the order of operations for Enterprise user creation so that the `EnterpriseHelper.AfterAccountCreationAsync` function is not called until after the `AccountSites` table has been populated.

See [Datadog logs](https://us3.datadoghq.com/logs?query=product%3Asoe%20env%3Adev%20status%3Aerror%20%40ExceptionDetail.TargetSite%3A%22Void%20Init%28StackOverflow.Models.User%29%22&agg_m=count&agg_m_source=base&agg_t=count&clustering_pattern_field_path=message&cols=host%2Cservice%2Cclient&messageDisplay=inline&refresh_mode=sliding&storage=hot&stream_sort=time%2Cdesc&viz=stream&from_ts=1771354942540&to_ts=1772650942540&live=true) for current list of errors

author: ocorona92
body:
## Summary

Replace non-interactive `<a>` elements (no `href`) used for IP address lookups and PII reveals with `<button type="button" class="s-link">` elements. This makes them natively keyboard-focusable and activatable without requiring `tabindex` or custom `keydown` handlers.

## Related Issue

[ZAMB-30](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/ZAMB-30)

## Changes

- **`StackOverflow/_Scripts/legacy/scoped/moderator/moderator.ts`** — `wrapInner('<a/>')` → `wrapInner('<button type="button" class="s-link"/>')` for dynamically created IP address links; removed redundant `tabindex="0"` attribute
- **`StackOverflow/Views/Users/History.cshtml`** — 3× `<a class="pii">` (no `href`) → `<button type="button" class="pii s-link">` for "show ip" and "show comment" links
- **`StackOverflow/Views/Review/SuggestedEditTaskV2.cshtml`** — `<a class="pii">` (no `href`) → `<button type="button" class="pii s-link">` for "show IP" link

## WCAG Criteria

**2.1.1 — Keyboard Only (Level A)**
Native `<button>` elements are focusable via Tab and activatable via Enter and Space by default — no custom workarounds needed. The `s-link` class preserves the visual appearance of a link.

## Verification Steps

1. Navigate to a user's Dashboard → all IPs view
2. Press Tab — verify focus moves to each IP address link
3. Press Enter or Space on a focused IP link — verify the info popup opens
4. Navigate to `/users/history/<id>` — verify "show ip" and "show comment" links are Tab-focusable and activatable with Enter/Space
5. Navigate to a Suggested Edit review — verify "show IP" link is keyboard accessible

## Screenshots / Before & After

**Before:** `<a>` with no `href` — invisible to keyboard, not reachable via Tab
**After:** `<button class="s-link">` — looks identical, fully keyboard accessible natively

body: TEAMS-15358 ## Summary The email, Slack, and ME Teams digests (private digests) are including ingested posts. This PR adds a where clause to various queries to only include published posts. ## Code Review I did each of five changes below in a separate commit. It may be helpful to look at each commit individually. ## How to Test I updated five queries in this PR in the following functions in TeamActivityRespository: 1. **CreatedPostsCountAsync** - the "8324 new pieces of knowledge" count. 2. **GetUserWithActivityCountAsync** - the "6 users" count. The first subquery (posts authored by users) is missing the PostState filter. The second subquery (votes received) doesn't count posts directly so it's less of a concern. 3. **GetPostCountPerDepartmentAsync** - the "10 contributions from your department" count. Missing filter on p.PostState. 4. **GetTotalHelpedUsersAsync** - counts users who were helped via upvotes/follows/bookmarks. The votes are on posts that could be non-published. 5. **GetHelpedUsersPerUserIdAsync** - same as above, per-user variant. Numbers four and five above doesn't matter _right now_ because you can't vote, follow, nor bookmark posts in the review queue UI. ### Manual Testing _Controversial opinion: I think the integration tests are good enough for this one. You may just want to read the code and maybe generate an email to make sure there are no obvious errors._ Consider testing the scenario below before switching to the PR branch so you can see it picking up unpublished posts. You can then build the PR branch and see that the digest does not include them. - Make sure this site setting is enabled (set to MainSites): Newsletters.EnableDigestV2TroubleshootEndpointFor - You need to have at least one ingested QA pair from the last 7 days. Careful - if you add one right now, you may need to manually subtract a day from the CreationDate because everything is in UTC and it might be late enough in the that your post is created tomorrow in UTC time. If needed: ```sql UPDATE Posts SET CreationDate = DATEADD(day, -1, CreationDate) WHERE Id IN () ``` - Ingest a QA pair for two users. I used testengadmin@soelocal.onmicrosoft.com and testquestionasker@soelocal.onmicrosoft.com Alternatively, you should also be able to just find any ingested post (PostState = 50) and set the CreationDate on the question and answer to yesterday. - Run the scheduled route for email. The account id param is necessary to force it to run: https://stackenterprise.local/enterprise/private-digest-send?accountIds=1 The same queries are used for email, Slack, and MS Teams. I tested email and Slack - Slack (if desired) Don't forget to delete the webhook history if needed. https://stackenterprise.local/enterprise/support/slack-team-digests-send?force=true - Look at the EmailMessages table in the Local.Enterprise.Sites.Teams table: ```sql select * from EmailMessages order by CreationDate desc; ``` Before the fix, you should have an email or Slack with something similar to the below (the Slack message is janky for other reasons unrelated to this PR): `2 users added 6 new pieces of knowledge.` or - Switch to the PR branch and run the digest route again and you should see the correct number with the ingested posts removed and the right number of users, ie: `1 user added 2 new pieces of knowledge this week` or If you don't have any published posts from the last week, you will see the "quiet week" message. ### Departments I suggest just looking at the query in IngestionReviewQueueRepository.GetPostCountPerDepartmentAsync and the integration test in `TeamActivityRepositoryTests.WhenGettingPostCountPerDepartment_ShouldNotCountNonPublishedPosts`. You can comment out the line "AND p.PostState = {=Published}" and watch the test fail if desired. ### Helped user count We don't currently allow upvoting and downvoting on helped users, but we may in the future so I think it's correct to include it. There is an integration test that checks that it works ### Helped users: `GetHelpedUsersPerUserIdAsync` returns a per-user count of how many distinct people interacted with that user's posts. The user will get a different header, like `TopReputationHeader` based on that info. Similar to the helped user count above, I don't think it's possible to manually test this but there is an integration test. --------------------------------------------------- ## Things to verify [[Context and rationale](https://stackoverflow.com/c/stack-overflow/articles/16418)] - [x] The PR Title includes its JIRA issue number and there are links to the relevant material at the top of the PR description. - [x] I've given a good description above that describes the changes and why they're needed. - [x] I've added instructions on how to test this PR. - [x] I've added unit and integration tests as appropriate, or justified their absence. - [x] This PR can be reviewed in a few hours at most. author: mukunku
body:
# Summary

This PR is for [TEAMS-15361](https://stackoverflow.atlassian.net/browse/TEAMS-15361). Special thanks to Mandy and Kirti for doing all the discovery ahead of time.

This PR addresses two issues mentioned in the ticket:
* Emails being sent during answer creation and answer acceptance: https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/commit/c2078be6458b6aaf42af400c039744e9ba27652e
  * There are other email generating sources in the code but we're not triggering any of them for now. Such as ForYou, Mentions, and other private teams emails.
* When processing a `/ingestion/question` or `/ingestion/questionandanswer` request we don't validate if the `FileUploadId` in the request actually exists. Not sure why the api caller is putting a non existing id but this is happening occaisonally and we end up with foreign key validation errors in the code: https://github.com/StackEng/StackOverflow/commit/ce566ce1098418ac1806b57730dc49750215be93
    ```
    System.Data.SqlClient.SqlException: 
    The INSERT statement conflicted with the FOREIGN KEY constraint "FK_IngestionSourcePostMetadata_IngestionFileUploadId_IngestionFileUploads_Id". 
    The conflict occurred in database "StackOverflowEE", table "dbo.IngestionFileUploads", column 'Id'. 
    The statement has been terminated.
    ```
  * This error happens after we've bothered to insert the question & answer and accepted it.
  * I think we should have some kind of validation before we start processing the request so we don't get this error at the very end of all the database operations. For this reason I added a validation that uses a DB call with some Redis cache to offset the performance hit. Please let me know what y'all think. 
  * I put the caching logic in the individual calling services but wondering it makes sense to embed the logic into `IngestionFileUploadRepository` instead?
  
# How to Test

Not much to test, the tests have been updated and there's no easy way to test the static event handlers.
